makePersp computes vertical FOV from hfov using gl drawing-buffer dimensions, derives f=1/tan(fovy/2), and returns a 16-element perspective projection matrix from aspect, znear, and zfar.
Computes a perspective projection matrix from horizontal FOV, aspect ratio, and near/far planes by deriving vertical FOV from drawing-buffer dimensions, then returns the 4×4 matrix array.
Binds a 2D texture, uploads the image as RGB unsigned-byte data, sets linear min/mag filtering and clamp-to-edge wrapping on S/T axes, then unbinds it, returning nothing.
Binds `tex` as a 2D texture, uploads `img` as RGB unsigned-byte data, sets linear min/mag filtering and clamp-to-edge wrapping on S/T, then unbinds, returning nothing.
Binds a 2D texture, uploads the image as RGB unsigned bytes, sets linear filtering and clamp-to-edge wrapping for S/T, then unbinds it, returning nothing.
Binds the given 2D texture, uploads the image as RGB unsigned-byte data, sets linear filtering and clamp-to-edge wrapping, then unbinds the texture and returns nothing.
Sets `program.level` to the highest zoom level starting at 1, incrementing while below `image.maxLevel` and buffer width exceeds a hfov-scaled tile-resolution threshold.
checkZoom(hfov) increments newLevel from 1 while below image.maxLevel and drawingBufferWidth exceeds image.tileResolution·2^(newLevel−1)·tan(hfov/2)·0.707, then sets program.level to newLevel.
checkZoom(hfov) increments newLevel from 1 while below image.maxLevel and viewport width exceeds image.tileResolution·2^(newLevel−1)·tan(hfov/2)·0.707, then assigns program.level = newLevel.
checkZoom(hfov) increases newLevel while it is below image.maxLevel and drawingBufferWidth exceeds a tile-resolution threshold using 2^(newLevel−1), tan(hfov/2), and 0.707, returning nothing.
Returns a 16-element array combining perspective matrix `p` and rotation matrix `r` by scaling selected `r` components with `p[0]`, `p[5]`, `p[10]`, preserving `p[11]`, and negating `r[8..10]`.
rotatePersp returns a 16-element array combining p[0], p[5], p[10], and p[11] with selected r entries via multiplication, inserting zeros and negating r[8], r[9], and r[10].
rotatePersp returns a 16-element array combining p and r by multiplying p[0], p[5], and p[10] with corresponding r entries, inserting zeros, p[11], and negated r[8..10].
rotatePersp takes arrays p and r and returns a 16-element array combining scaled components of r by p[0], p[5], p[10], plus p[11], with no conditional checks.

Transforms vector `v` with matrix `m`, computes window-space coordinates, checks each against [-1,1], and returns `[xFlag,yFlag,zFlag]` indicating left/right, below/above, and depth out-of-range status.
checkInView transforms vector v by matrix m, computes window-space x/y/z, flags x or y outside [-1,1] as -1/1 direction, z outside [-1,1] as 1, and returns ret.
checkInView transforms vector v by matrix m, computes window coordinates, checks whether x/y are outside [-1,1] and z outside [-1,1], and returns corresponding out-of-bounds flags [x,y,z].
Computes a perspective-transformed vector by calling applyRotPerspToVec(m, v) and always returns [0, 0, 0], with no conditions, async behavior, or error handling.

Initializes the renderer if absent, adds input/fullscreen/resize/keyboard/pointer-or-touch listeners once based on config and browser capabilities, then calls renderInit, sets hfov, and schedules isTimedOut=true after 500ms.

Initializes renderer if missing, adds input/fullscreen/resize/keyboard/pointer-or-touch listeners once based on config and feature checks, then calls renderInit, sets hfov, and schedules isTimedOut=true after 500ms.

onImageLoad initializes renderer if missing, adds input/fullscreen/resize/keyboard/pointer-or-touch listeners once based on config and browser capabilities, then calls renderInit, sets hfov, and returns a 500ms timeout ID.

onImageLoad initializes the renderer, registers mouse, wheel, fullscreen, resize, keyboard, pointer, and touch event listeners, calls renderInit and setHfov(config.hfov), schedules a timeout flag update, and returns nothing.

Displays an error message (defaulting to `config.strings.genericWebGLError` when undefined), hides load/render elements, shows the error display, sets `error` true, and fires an `'error'` event with the message.

Handles an error by defaulting undefined errorMsg to config.strings.genericWebGLError, updating/hiding UI elements, setting error true, hiding renderContainer, and firing an 'error' event with errorMsg; returns nothing.

Handles an error by defaulting undefined errorMsg to config.strings.genericWebGLError, updating error UI visibility/content, setting error=true, hiding renderContainer, and firing an 'error' event with errorMsg.
Triggers an `'error'` event with the provided `errorMsg` and returns nothing.
If an error is active, this function hides the loading box and error message, resets the error flag to false, and emits an `errorcleared` event.
`clearError` checks if `error` is truthy, then hides `infoDisplay.load.box` and `infoDisplay.errorMsg`, sets `error` to `false`, and returns the `fireEvent('errorcleared')` call result.
clearError checks whether error is truthy, then hides infoDisplay.load.box and infoDisplay.errorMsg, sets error to false, fires 'errorcleared', and otherwise does nothing, returning undefined.
Clears the error state by firing the `errorcleared` event, with no input parameters, conditions, asynchronous behavior, error handling, or return value.
Positions and shows `aboutMsg` at the mouse coordinates, resets hide timers, fades it after 2 seconds, hides it after 2.5 seconds, and prevents the event’s default action.
Handles an event by positioning and showing aboutMsg at mouse coordinates, clearing existing timers, scheduling fade/hide timeouts, preventing default behavior, and returning no explicit value.
aboutMessage(event) positions aboutMsg at the mouse coordinates, clears existing t1/t2 timeouts, shows it, schedules fade and hide after 2000/2500ms, calls preventDefault, and returns nothing.
Handles an event by getting mouse position, clearing existing aboutMessage timers, scheduling aboutMsg fade-out and hide after 2s/2.5s, preventing default behavior, and returning nothing.
Computes mouse coordinates relative to `container` by subtracting its bounding-rectangle left/top from `event.clientX/clientY` or fallback `event.pageX/pageY`, and returns `{x, y}`.
Calculates mouse coordinates relative to container bounds by using event.clientX/clientY or falling back to pageX/pageY, subtracting bounds.left/top, and returns a pos object with x and y.
Computes mouse coordinates relative to container bounds by using event.clientX/clientY or falling back to pageX/pageY, subtracting bounds.left/top, and returns a pos object with x and y.
Returns an empty object after retrieving the container’s bounding rectangle from the event context, with no conditions, asynchronous behavior, or error handling.

Handles mousedown by preventing default, focusing the container, exiting if panorama isn’t loaded or draggable is disabled, then updating interaction state, stopping motion, toggling grab classes, and returning nothing.

Handles mousedown by preventing default and focusing the container, returning early if not loaded or not draggable; otherwise initializes dragging state, optional hotspot debug logging, UI classes, and returns nothing.

Handles mousedown by preventing default, focusing container, returning early if not loaded or draggable disabled, otherwise initializing drag state, optional hotspot debug logging, firing mousedown, and starting animation.

Handles mousedown by returning early if not loaded or draggable is disabled; otherwise prevents default, focuses container, updates interaction state, toggles grab classes, fires mousedown, and initializes animation.
Handles a double-click by resetting hfov to origHfov over 1000ms when minHfov equals hfov, otherwise converting click coordinates and calling lookAt with minHfov over 1000ms.
On double-click, it checks whether config.minHfov equals config.hfov; if so it sets hfov to origHfov, otherwise it converts event coordinates and calls lookAt with minHfov.

onDocumentDoubleClick(event) checks whether config.minHfov equals config.hfov; if true it calls _this.setHfov(origHfov,1000), otherwise converts event to coords and calls _this.lookAt(coords[0],coords[1],config.minHfov,1000), returning nothing.
On document double-click, it resets HFOV over 1000ms, converts the mouse event to coordinates, then looks at those coordinates using config.minHfov over 1000ms.
Converts a mouse event to panorama [pitch, yaw] coordinates using canvas-relative position, hfov, pitch, and yaw, normalizing yaw to the [-180, 180] range before returning.
Converts a mouse event to panorama pitch/yaw by normalizing canvas coordinates and applying hfov/pitch/yaw trigonometry, wrapping yaw into [-180,180], and returning [pitch, yaw].
Converts a mouse event to panorama pitch/yaw by normalizing canvas coordinates, applying hfov/pitch/yaw trigonometry, wrapping yaw into [-180,180], and returning [pitch, yaw].
Converts a mouse event to panorama pitch and yaw by deriving normalized canvas coordinates and applying trigonometric projection using hfov and current pitch, returning [pitch, yaw].

When user interaction is active and content is loaded, this mouse-move handler updates interaction time, computes yaw/pitch from canvas-relative pointer movement and FOV, updates speeds, and stores new config angles.

Handles mouse-move events only when `isUserInteracting && loaded`, updating interaction time, computing canvas-relative yaw/pitch from pointer movement and FOV, then updating `speed` and `config` yaw/pitch, returning nothing.

onDocumentMouseMove handles mouse movement only when isUserInteracting and loaded are true, updating interaction time, computing yaw/pitch from canvas-relative pointer movement, and returning nothing.

Handles mouse-move events by updating interaction time, reading canvas and pointer position, and computing multiple atan-based horizontal/vertical angle values from current and initial pointer coordinates, returning nothing.

Handles mouseup by exiting if no interaction is active, otherwise ending interaction, zeroing pitch/yaw if inactivity exceeds 15ms, updating grab/grabbing classes, timestamp, and firing a mouseup event.

Handles mouseup by returning early if not interacting; otherwise disables interaction, zeroes speed.pitch and speed.yaw if inactivity exceeds 15ms, updates classes/timestamp, and returns fireEvent('mouseup', event).
Handles mouseup only when interaction is active; it disables interaction, zeroes speed.pitch and speed.yaw if idle over 15ms, updates classes/timestamp, fires 'mouseup', and otherwise returns.
On mouseup, it updates interaction timing, switches uiContainer from “pnlm-grabbing” to “pnlm-grab,” fires a “mouseup” event with the input event, and returns undefined.

Handles touchstart only when the panorama is loaded and draggable, stops animation/orientation, records one- or two-touch pointer position/distance and current yaw/pitch, marks interaction, fires touchstart, and returns nothing.

Handles touchstart by returning early unless loaded and draggable, otherwise stopping animation/orientation, resetting roll/hfov speed, recording touch positions (and two-touch midpoint/distance), setting interaction state, and returning nothing.

Handles touchstart by returning early if not loaded or draggable disabled; otherwise stops motion, records touch/pinch start positions and distance, sets interaction state, fires touchstart, and returns nothing.

Handles touchstart by exiting if not loaded or draggable, otherwise stopping animation/orientation, computing two-touch pointer distance, updating interaction time, firing a touchstart event, and initializing animation.

Handles touch-move dragging only when draggable, preventing default behavior, updating interaction time if loaded, processing two-touch pinch zoom and one/two-touch pan to update hfov, yaw, pitch, and speeds, returning nothing.

Handles touch-move input by returning early if dragging is disabled, preventing default behavior, updating interaction time, and when loaded/interacting, adjusting pinch-zoom, yaw/pitch, and speed; otherwise returns nothing.

Handles touch-move by returning early if not draggable, preventing default, updating interaction time when loaded, and when interacting+loaded, applying pinch-zoom and updating yaw/pitch/speeds, returning nothing.
Handles touch-move zooming only when draggable is enabled: prevents default behavior, updates interaction time, computes two-touch distance, adjusts hfov via setHfov, and otherwise returns undefined.

Handles mouse-wheel zoom only when loaded and allowed (including fullscreen-only mode), prevents default scrolling, stops animation, updates hfov/speed from wheel delta variants, then initializes animation; otherwise returns.

Handles mouse-wheel zoom: if not loaded or fullscreen-only zoom without fullscreen, returns early; otherwise prevents default, updates hfov/speed from wheelDeltaY/wheelDelta/detail, timestamps interaction, and returns undefined.

Handles mouse-wheel zoom only when loaded and allowed (or fullscreen active for fullscreen-only), preventing default, updating hfov/speed from wheelDeltaY/wheelDelta/detail, starting animation, otherwise returning early.

Handles mouse-wheel zoom by ignoring input when not loaded or fullscreen-only mode is inactive, otherwise preventing default scrolling, stopping animation, adjusting hfov from wheel delta, and reinitializing animation.

Handles keypresses by stopping animation/orientation, resetting roll, and updating interaction time; if the key is captured it prevents default, toggles fullscreen on Escape, otherwise calls changeKey.

Handles a keypress by stopping animation/orientation, resetting roll, and updating interaction time; returns early if key isn’t captured, otherwise prevents default and toggles fullscreen on Esc or calls changeKey.

Handles key presses by stopping animation/orientation, timestamping interaction, resetting roll, ignoring uncaptured keys, preventing default behavior, toggling fullscreen on Escape when active, otherwise calling changeKey(keynumber, true).

Handles keypress events by ignoring uncaptured keys, otherwise stopping animation/orientation, updating latestInteraction, preventing default behavior, toggling fullscreen, and marking the pressed key as active.
Handles keyup events by reading the key code, returning unless it is in config.capturedKeyNumbers, preventing default behavior for captured keys, and calling changeKey(keynumber, false).

onDocumentKeyUp gets the released key code from event.which or event.keycode, returns early if it isn’t in config.capturedKeyNumbers, otherwise prevents default behavior and calls changeKey(keynumber, false).
onDocumentKeyUp gets event.which or event.keycode, returns early if keynumber isn’t in config.capturedKeyNumbers, otherwise prevents default behavior and calls changeKey(keynumber, false).
Handles keyup events by ignoring uncaptured keys, and for captured key codes prevents default behavior and calls changeKey(keyCode, false), otherwise returning undefined.
`changeKey` maps specific key codes to `keysDown` slots, flags changes when stored state differs from `value`, updates the slot, and on a changed key press triggers timing reset and `animateInit()`.
Updates mapped `keysDown` entries for specific keycodes, marks changes when stored value differs, and if a key changed to true, sets `prevTime` (performance.now/Date.now) and calls `animateInit`.

`changeKey` maps specific key codes to `keysDown` indices, flags changes when stored state differs from `value`, updates that state, and returns nothing (optionally triggering timing/`animateInit` on keydown changes).
changeKey checks keynumber against specific key codes (173, 61, arrows, W/A/S) in a switch, then records current time via performance.now/Date.now and calls animateInit.

`animateMove(axis)` computes an eased position over normalized elapsed time, clamps completion when passing or matching the end position, then sets `config[axis]`, zeroes `speed[axis]`, and removes the animation.

animateMove(axis) computes eased axis position from animatedMove timing clamped to [0,1], snaps to endPosition when reached/overshot or start=end, clears speed/animation, and returns assigned config[axis].

animateMove(axis) computes clamped normalized animation progress, eases between start and end positions, snaps to end when overshooting or equal endpoints, clears motion state, and returns result via config[axis].
Computes a clamped normalized elapsed time for the given axis, applies config.animationTimingFunction to it, and then deletes animatedMove[axis] without returning a value.

`animate` renders a frame, clears pending autorotate timeout, continues animation when interacting/moving/loading, triggers delayed or immediate autorotate after inactivity, otherwise fires `animatefinished` and resets animation state.

animate renders a frame, clears pending auto-rotate timeout, continues requesting frames while interacting/orienting/moving/loading/updating, otherwise fires animatefinished, resets animation state, and optionally schedules or starts auto-rotation.

animate renders each frame, clears pending auto-rotate timeout, continues animation while interacting/orienting/moving/loading, otherwise fires animatefinished, resets animation state, and may schedule or trigger auto-rotate restart.

animate renders each frame, clears pending auto-rotate timeout, repeats animation while movement speeds are nonzero or loading, handles key repeats, then fires animatefinished and schedules/restores auto-rotation.
Converts Tait-Bryan angles alpha, beta, and gamma (treating falsy values as zero) from degrees to half-radians, computes trig components, and returns the corresponding Quaternion.
Converts Tait-Bryan angles alpha, beta, and gamma to a Quaternion, treating each missing/falsy angle as 0 before half-angle radian conversion and trig-based component calculation.
Converts Tait-Bryan angles alpha, beta, and gamma to a Quaternion, using each angle only if truthy (otherwise 0), then returning computed quaternion components from sine/cosine half-angles.
Converts Tait-Bryan angles alpha, beta, and gamma to a quaternion, treating missing/falsy angles as 0, using half-angle degree-to-radian sine/cosine terms, and returns the Quaternion.
Converts Tait-Bryan angles (alpha, beta, gamma) to a quaternion, applies fixed world and conditional screen-orientation transforms, and returns the resulting multiplied quaternion.
Computes a quaternion from alpha, beta, and gamma, applies a fixed √0.5 rotation, sets angle from window.orientation (or 0 if absent), and returns the quaternion multiplied by a z-rotation.

computeQuaternion converts alpha, beta, gamma to a quaternion, multiplies by a fixed adjustment quaternion, checks window.orientation to derive angle or 0, and returns quaternion multiplied by a rotation quaternion.

Computes a quaternion from alpha, beta, and gamma via Tait-Bryan conversion, applies a fixed rotation, then applies an orientation-based rotation using window.orientation (or 0), returning the final quaternion.
Computes Euler angles from device orientation, skips updates while numeric orientation is below 10, initializes yaw offset and animation at 10, otherwise updates config pitch, roll, and yaw.

Processes device orientation event angles into Euler degrees, increments numeric orientation until 10, then sets yaw offset, marks orientation true, starts animation, and updates config pitch/roll/yaw.

orientationListener converts device alpha/beta/gamma to Euler angles, increments numeric orientation below 10, initializes yaw offset and animation at 10, otherwise updates config pitch/roll/yaw, returning nothing.
Processes device orientation event angles by converting alpha, beta, and gamma to Euler angles, checks the dynamic type of orientation, and schedules animate via requestAnimationFrame.

Initializes the renderer with converted radian view parameters and optional horizon/background settings, clears panoImage when non-dynamic, and handles WebGL/size/unknown errors via anError or rethrow.

Initializes rendering by building params from defined config horizon/background fields, converting angles to radians for renderer.init, clearing panoImage when non-dynamic, and handling specific WebGL errors via anError or rethrowing.

renderInit builds optional params from defined config horizon/background fields, initializes renderer with converted angle values, clears panoImage when non-dynamic, and on errors reports specific messages then rethrows.
Initializes the renderer with pano/config values converted to radians; on caught “webgl size error” reports texture-size details, otherwise reports unknown errors, and rethrows non-size-error events.

Initializes rendering by optionally fading and removing a fade image, toggling compass visibility, creating hotspots, hiding loading/preview elements, marking loaded, firing events, and starting animation.

Initializes rendering by optionally fading/removing renderer.fadeImg when sceneFadeDuration exists, toggling compass display, creating hotspots, hiding load info, removing preview, setting loaded true, firing events, and starting animation; returns nothing.

Initializes rendering by fading/removing fadeImg when configured, toggling compass display, creating hotspots, hiding info box, removing preview if defined, setting loaded true, firing events, and returns nothing.

Initializes rendering by scheduling fade image removal and a scene-change-fade-done event after sceneFadeDuration, creating hotspots, removing preview, firing load, starting animation, and deleting renderer.fadeImg.
Creates hotspots once by returning early if already created, initializes `config.hotSpots` to an empty array or sorts by pitch and creates each hotspot, then marks created and renders hotspots.

`createHotSpots` returns early if `hotspotsCreated` is true; otherwise it initializes or sorts `config.hotSpots` by `pitch`, creates each hotspot, marks creation complete, and calls `renderHotSpots()`.

createHotSpots exits if hotspotsCreated is true; otherwise it initializes config.hotSpots if missing, sorts by pitch, calls createHotSpot for each, sets hotspotsCreated true, then calls renderHotSpots.
Sorts `config.hotSpots` by pitch, creates each hotspot via `createHotSpot`, then calls `renderHotSpots`; if the initial condition is true, it returns `undefined`.
Resets hotspot state by clearing `config.hotSpots`, and if hotspots exist, removes each hotspot’s topmost ancestor under `renderContainer` and deletes each hotspot’s `div` reference.

Resets hotspot state by setting `hotspotsCreated` false and deleting `config.hotSpots`, then if hotspots exist, removes each hotspot’s ancestor under `renderContainer` and deletes its `div` reference.

destroyHotSpots stores config.hotSpots, sets hotspotsCreated false, deletes config.hotSpots, and if hs exists, iterates hotspots, climbs each div’s parents until renderContainer, removes it, then deletes div references.
Removes each hotspot element from the render container by climbing parent nodes until directly under it, then deletes each hotspot’s div reference and the config.hotSpots property.
Computes a hotspot’s projected screen position from pitch/yaw/roll and hfov, hides it when z≤0 (behind camera), otherwise shows it and applies CSS translate/rotate transforms.
renderHotSpot computes a hotspot’s projected screen position from hotspot/config pitch-yaw-roll and hfov, hides it when z<=0 under yaw-range checks, otherwise shows and returns via CSS transforms.

Computes a hotspot’s projected screen position from pitch/yaw/roll and camera settings, hides it when yaw/z visibility tests fail, otherwise shows it and returns nothing after applying CSS transforms.
Computes trigonometric values from hotspot and viewer pitch, yaw, hfov, and roll, retrieves the renderer canvas, and returns nothing.

mergeConfig resets config, merges defaultConfig, initialConfig.default, optional valid scene config, then initialConfig; escapes all strings entries, tracks excluded photo-sphere keys, and returns nothing.
Merges default, initial default, optional scene, and top-level initial settings into config, escaping strings, tracking specified photo-sphere exclude keys, and returns the merged config object.
Merges default, initial default, optional scene, and top-level initial settings into config, escaping strings, tracking photo-sphere exclude keys, and returns the assembled config object.

mergeConfig(sceneId) builds merged defaults, scene, and global settings by copying own properties, HTML-escaping strings, tracking specified numeric keys, and applying sceneId-specific overrides without returning a value.
If loaded and no error, toggles fullscreen by entering via available container requestFullscreen variants when inactive, or exiting via available document fullscreen-cancel methods when active.

toggleFullscreen runs only when loaded and no error, entering fullscreen via available container vendor methods if inactive, otherwise exiting via available document vendor methods, and returns nothing.
toggleFullscreen runs only when loaded and no error, entering fullscreen if inactive or exiting if active via available vendor-specific APIs, and returns nothing.
Toggles fullscreen mode by requesting fullscreen on the container or exiting fullscreen via document methods, using browser-specific variants when available, and returns nothing.

`onFullScreenChange` checks browser fullscreen flags to toggle the fullscreen button’s active class and `fullscreenActive`, optionally fires `fullscreenchange`, then resizes the renderer, resets HFOV, and reinitializes animation.

Updates fullscreen UI/state by checking multiple document fullscreen flags, fires a fullscreenchange event unless resize equals 'resize', then resizes renderer, resets hfov, and reinitializes animation.
Updates fullscreen UI/state based on document fullscreen flags, fires `fullscreenchange` unless `resize === 'resize'`, then calls `renderer.resize()`, `setHfov(config.hfov)`, and `animateInit()`.

Handles fullscreen state changes by toggling the fullscreen button’s active class, firing a `fullscreenchange` event with `fullscreenActive`, resizing the renderer, resetting HFOV, and reinitializing animation.

Constrains an input HFOV to computed min/max bounds (including multires adjustment), returns current config.hfov if bounds are invalid, and optionally further limits HFOV to avoid background exposure.
Constrains input hfov to valid bounds by adjusting minHfov for multires rendering, rejecting invalid min/max bounds, optionally limiting background exposure, and returning the resulting hfov.
Constrains hfov by computed min/max bounds, adjusting multires minimum and optional background-avoidance cap, returning config.hfov if bounds are invalid, otherwise the clamped newHfov.
Constrains the input hfov by capping minHfov from canvas width, logging and returning config.hfov if minHfov exceeds config.maxHfov, otherwise returning newHfov limited by pitch-span geometry.
Stops animation by clearing `animatedMove`, preserving `autoRotateSpeed` from `config.autoRotate` when truthy, and then disabling auto-rotation by setting `config.autoRotate` to `false`.

stopAnimation clears animatedMove, sets autoRotateSpeed to config.autoRotate if truthy otherwise keeps current autoRotateSpeed, then disables config.autoRotate by setting it to false, returning nothing.
`stopAnimation` clears `animatedMove`, sets `autoRotateSpeed` to `config.autoRotate` when truthy otherwise keeps its current value, then sets `config.autoRotate` to `false`, returning nothing.
Stops the animation and does not take input, perform checks, call other functions, handle errors, or return a value.
Initializes a new scene by clearing previous errors, marking `loaded` false, hiding the load control, showing the load info box, and calling `init()`.
The `load` function clears errors, marks `loaded` false, hides `controls.load`, shows `infoDisplay.load.box`, calls `init()`, and returns no explicit value.
`load` clears errors, marks `loaded` false, hides `controls.load` by setting `style.display` to `'none'`, shows `infoDisplay.load.box` as `'inline'`, then calls `init`, returning nothing.
Initializes loading by clearing any existing error and running initialization, with no input parameters, conditions, asynchronous behavior, error handling, or return value.

Loads a new scene, optionally creating a fade image and recursively reloading after fade setup, resolves target pitch/yaw/hfov ('same'/'sameAzimuth'), resets state, fires scenechange, and returns early only during fade initialization.

Loads a new scene, optionally performs a fade transition when sceneFadeDuration is set and fade isn’t done, resolves 'same'/'sameAzimuth' targets, updates config, triggers loading/events, and returns early only for fade setup.

loadScene resets state, optionally performs a fade transition when sceneFadeDuration exists and fadeDone is false, resolves 'same'/'sameAzimuth' targets, loads/merges scene config, and returns early only during fade setup.
If rendered image data exists, it exits; otherwise it renders a fade image, updates scene configuration, triggers scenechange, loads the scene, and returns nothing.
Stops device orientation handling by removing the `deviceorientation` listener, removing the active orientation button CSS class, and setting `orientation` to `false`.
`stopOrientation` removes the `deviceorientation` event listener, removes the `pnlm-orientation-button-active` class from `controls.orientation`, sets `orientation` to `false`, and returns nothing.
`stopOrientation` removes the `deviceorientation` event listener, removes the active orientation CSS class from `controls.orientation`, sets `orientation` to `false`, and returns nothing.
Removes the `deviceorientation` event listener and deactivates the orientation control button by removing its active CSS class, without returning a value.
Computes mouse coordinates relative to a target element by getting event coordinates and target document position, defaulting to `_window.event` when needed, and returns `{x, y}` offsets.
Computes mouse offset from a target by using ev or _window.event, getting target and mouse positions, and returning an object with x and y coordinate differences.
Computes mouse offset from a target by using ev or _window.event, then returns {x, y} as mouse coordinates minus the target’s document position.
Computes the mouse position relative to a target element by subtracting the target’s document position from event mouse coordinates, returning an object with x and y offsets.
Applies inlineTemplate, inlineStyle, and removeModuleId sequentially to the input content using urlResolver, returning the fully transformed content string.
`inlineResourcesFromString` reduces `[inlineTemplate, inlineStyle, removeModuleId]` over `content`, calling each with `(content, urlResolver)`, and returns the final transformed content string.
inlineResourcesFromString applies inlineTemplate, inlineStyle, and removeModuleId in sequence via reduce, passing each current content and urlResolver, and returns the final transformed content.
Processes content by sequentially applying inlineTemplate, inlineStyle, and removeModuleId with urlResolver via reduce, returning the fully transformed content without additional condition checks.
Compiles Sass from the given content and source file using a tilde importer, returning the CSS string, or logs formatted error location/details and returns an empty string on failure.

buildSass synchronously compiles Sass from content using sourceFile and tildeImporter, returning result.css.toString() on success, or logging formatted error details and returning an empty string on failure.
buildSass synchronously compiles Sass from content using sourceFile and tildeImporter, returning result.css.toString(), and on any thrown error logs details and returns an empty string.
Compiles Sass content synchronously with source file and tilde importer, returning the CSS string; if compilation throws, it logs formatted error location/details and returns an empty string.
Creates and returns resource route definitions, defaulting config to {} and each route component to built-ins when missing, including ':id' child routes with '' redirecting to 'view'.
Initializes config to {} if missing and returns route definitions using config-provided or default components for index, create, resource, view, edit, and delete paths, with :id redirecting to view.
FormioResourceRoutes defaults config to {}, then returns route definitions using config overrides or default components for '', 'new', ':id', and ':id' children redirect/view/edit/delete paths.
Creates and returns resource route definitions using config-provided components or defaults, including index, new, and :id routes with child redirect, view, edit, and delete paths.

Initializes a producer with client/options defaults, validates custom partitioner consistency with partitionerType, selects and instantiates the partitioner, starts connection, and returns the initialized BaseProducer instance.
Initializes a BaseProducer by setting defaults for options, requireAcks, and ackTimeoutMs, validating custom partitioner/type consistency, creating the partitioner, connecting, and returning nothing.

Initializes a BaseProducer by setting defaults, validating custom partitioner/type consistency, selecting and instantiating a partitioner, assigning client/ack settings, and calling connect; returns nothing.

Initializes a producer, validating custom partitioner/type consistency, throws on mismatches, invokes EventEmitter, selects and applies the configured/default partitioner, then calls this.connect(), returning nothing.
Creates a context object with default empty body/hostname, base64 decoding, a no-op location.reload, and document methods where getElementById regex-caches IDs and returns matched innerHTML or null.

Initializes default options when missing, sets browser-like globals, and returns cached `getElementById` results by regex-matching `options.body`, yielding `null` on no match or `{innerHTML}` on match.
Creates a mock browser-like context from options (defaulting missing options), caching getElementById lookups by id, and returns cached matches or null when no body regex match exists.
Creates a `cache` object with no prototype using `Object.create(null)` from `options`, performs no condition checks, and has no explicit return value.
Logs the provided captcha URL and siteKey from the second argument, then always returns a rejected Promise with a dummy Error message.

Compiles provided Sass data to expanded CSS, resolving imports starting with “~” to node_modules and others directly by URL, then invokes callback with null error and CSS output.
Compiles Sass input synchronously with expanded output, resolving imports starting with “~” to __dirname/node_modules, otherwise using the original URL, then calls callback(null, compiledCss.css).

compileSass synchronously renders Sass from data with expanded output, resolving importer URLs starting with "~" to __dirname/node_modules paths, then calls callback with null error and compiledCss.css.
Compiles provided Sass data to expanded CSS with an importer resolving `~`-prefixed URLs to `node_modules` paths, then invokes `callback(null, compiledCss.css)`.
Loads a Brocfile by using ts-node for .ts paths after verifying ts-node and typescript are installed, otherwise esmRequire, then returns its default export when present or the module itself.
Loads a brocfile by path, using ts-node registration for .ts files after verifying ts-node/typescript availability, otherwise esmRequire, then returns brocfile.default when present or brocfile.
Loads a brocfile path, requiring ts-node/typescript and registering ts-node for .ts files, otherwise using esmRequire, then returns brocfile or its default export when present.
Loads a Brocfile module from the given path, registering ts-node for .ts files after verifying ts-node and typescript are installed, and returns the loaded brocfile object.
Parses the input string with a nearley parser, returning the first parse result as a string, or an incomplete-input error message, or a caret-marked parse error on exceptions.

Parses input string s with a nearley parser; if ans.results.length is nonzero returns the first result’s string, otherwise an incomplete-input error, and on exceptions a caret-positioned error marker.
runmath parses input s with a nearley parser, returning the first result as a string if results exist, otherwise an incomplete-input error, or a caret-marked parse error on exception.
Parses input `s` with a Nearley parser, returning the first parse result as a string when results exist, otherwise returning `out`, with parse errors silently caught.
Processes union GraphQL selections by handling fields, inline fragments, and fragment spreads, deduplicating table field nodes, deferring to object/union handlers by type, and returning nothing.

Processes union selections by kind—merging or creating table field nodes, recursively handling inline/fragment type conditions via object-or-union handlers, and throwing on unknown kinds; returns nothing.

Processes union selections by handling Field, InlineFragment, and FragmentSpread nodes, reusing/adding table children, delegating by deferred type object-vs-union, setting defferedFrom, and throwing on unknown kinds; returns nothing.
Processes union selections by iterating selection kinds, throwing on unknown kinds, creating/reusing table child AST nodes for fields, recursing into fragments, and returning nothing.

Processes GraphQL selections by adding or reusing field table nodes, propagating deferred metadata, recursively handling matching inline/named fragments by type/interface checks, and returns nothing (throws on unknown kinds).

Processes GraphQL selections by creating/reusing table child SQL AST nodes for fields, recursively handling matching inline/fragment spreads by type/interface checks, and returns nothing (throws on unknown selection kind).
Iterates selections to build/update child SQL AST nodes for fields, recurse into inline/fragment selections when type or interface matches, throws on unknown kinds, and returns nothing.

Iterates GraphQL selections, handling Field/InlineFragment/FragmentSpread, throwing on unknown kinds, creating or reusing table child AST nodes, populating them, and recursively processing matching interface/type fragment selections.
Creates and returns a column AST child object with type, name, and fieldName set to columnName, and as set to namespace.generate('column', columnName).
Creates and returns a column AST child object with type 'column', name and fieldName set to columnName, and as set to namespace.generate('column', columnName).
Returns an object describing a column AST child with type `'column'`, name and fieldName set to columnName, and as set to namespace.generate('column', columnName).
Creates and returns a column AST child object with type, name, and fieldName set to columnName, and as set to namespace.generate('column', columnName), with no conditional checks.
Converts a key into an AST child by returning columnToASTChild for string keys, or a composite object with generated field alias for array keys; otherwise returns undefined.
`keyToASTChild` returns `columnToASTChild(key, namespace)` when `key` is a string, or for array keys returns a composite object with derived `fieldName` and generated `as` alias.
keyToASTChild returns columnToASTChild(key, namespace) when key is a string; if key is an array, it returns a composite AST child object using toClumsyName and namespace.generate.
Converts a key into an AST child by returning `columnToASTChild` for string keys, or a generated composite object for array keys, otherwise returning nothing.

Recursively flattens selections by expanding FragmentSpread entries and InlineFragment selections only when their typeCondition matches typeName, returning expanded selections or original non-fragment selections.

Recursively expands `FragmentSpread` and matching `InlineFragment` selections (where `typeCondition.name.value === typeName`) using `fragments`, flat-mapping `selections` and returning the resulting flattened selection array.

Recursively flat-maps selections, expanding FragmentSpread entries via fragments and InlineFragment entries only when typeCondition.name.value equals typeName, otherwise returning [] or the original selection.
Recursively flattens selections by expanding FragmentSpread entries and only InlineFragment entries whose typeCondition matches typeName, returning a flat array of resulting selections.
Asynchronously fetches a GraphQL Node by type name, asserting the type exists and has sqlTable, building/compiling SQL from resolve info, and returning fetched data (or falsy) tagged with __type__.
Asynchronously fetches a node by GraphQL type, asserting the type exists and has sqlTable, building/executing SQL from resolve info, then returning data (with __type__ when truthy).

Asyncly resolves a node by typeName: asserts schema type and sqlTable exist, builds/compiles SQL AST, executes dbCall, batches follow-ups, and returns data (or nullish), tagging data.__type__ when present.
Asynchronously fetches a node connection for a schema type by asserting the type exists and has sqlTable, building SQL/AST from resolve info and condition, then returning fetched data.
Traverses sqlAST children to recurse into data items, then returns null/empty paginated connection for missing data, otherwise paginated edges/pageInfo or offset-based connection, else original data.

arrToConnection recurses through sqlAST children, then returns null/empty paginated output for missing data, builds cursor edges/pageInfo for paginate, uses orderBy/after totals for array-slice connections, otherwise returns data.
arrToConnection recursively processes sqlAST children on data, returns null or empty paginated edges when data is missing, otherwise builds and returns paginated connection objects or original data.

Transforms SQL AST query results into a GraphQL-style connection, recursing child fields, returning null for missing data, empty paginated edges when requested, or sorted/ordered connection metadata otherwise raw data.
Returns `rows` if it is an array, otherwise returns `rows.rows` when present, and throws an error if neither condition is met.
Validates `rows` by returning it if it’s an array, otherwise returning `rows.rows` when both exist, and throwing an Error with inspected input if neither condition matches.
`validate` returns `rows` if it is an array, otherwise returns `rows.rows` when both exist, and throws an Error including `util.inspect(rows, { depth: 3 })`.
Validates database-call output by returning `rows` if it is an array, or `rows.rows` if present; otherwise throws an error describing the unexpected value.
Builds a SQL WHERE sort-condition from keyObj by quoting table/columns and values, choosing “<” when descending otherwise “>”, returning Oracle-specific recursive join or tuple comparison string.
Builds a SQL sort-key WHERE condition by quoting table/keys and values, choosing '<' when descending else '>', returning recursiveWhereJoin for Oracle, otherwise tuple comparison SQL.
Builds a sort-key WHERE condition by quoting table/key columns and values from keyObj, chooses '<' when descending else '>', and returns Oracle recursive join or tuple comparison SQL.
Builds a sort-key WHERE condition by iterating keyObj, quoting table/keys and values, choosing `<` or `>` by descending, and returns Oracle recursive join syntax or tuple comparison SQL.

Clones plain objects or arrays recursively, returning primitives and unsupported constructors unchanged, copying Date/RegExp/Function/String/Number/Boolean via constructor, and preserving existing properties in the target object.

Recursively clones `frm` into `to`, returning primitives or unsupported constructors unchanged, recreating Date/RegExp/Function/String/Number/Boolean via constructor, and copying properties only when `to[name]` is undefined.

Recursively clones `frm` into `to`, returning primitives/non-objects or unsupported constructors unchanged, recreating Date/RegExp/Function/String/Number/Boolean via constructors, then copying enumerable properties into `to`.

Clones plain objects or arrays recursively, returning primitives and non-object values unchanged, preserving special constructors via re-instantiation, and ultimately returning the populated target object.
Creates and returns a string by repeating `str` exactly `length` times, using an array of that length mapped with `String.prototype.valueOf` and joined without separators.
buildString(length, str) creates an array of the given length, maps each slot to str via String.prototype.valueOf, and returns all elements joined into one string.
buildString(length, str) creates an array of the given length, maps each slot to str via String.prototype.valueOf, joins with an empty separator, and returns the repeated string.
Returns a string formed by repeating `str` exactly `length` times using array mapping and joining, with no conditional checks or error handling.
Formats an array into a bracketed string, choosing pretty multiline indentation when `pretty` is true, otherwise single-line comma-separated formatting, and returns the resulting string.
Builds and returns a bracketed string from `arr`, choosing separator `',\n'+currentIndent` when `pretty` is true (with computed indents/newlines) or `', '` otherwise.
concatArray builds indentation strings, chooses a separator based on pretty, and returns arr joined inside brackets, with newlines and adjusted indents only when pretty is true.
Formats an array as a bracketed string, using pretty-print indentation and newline separators when `pretty` is true, otherwise comma-space separators, and returns the resulting string.
Creates and returns an Audio node that reports play, playing, duration, error, and ended statuses via Media.onStatus, remapping unsupported-source errors, and sets node.src when media.src exists.
Creates an Audio node, wires media status/error handlers, maps unsupported-source errors to aborted, sets node.src only if media.src exists, and returns the configured node.
Creates an Audio node, wires media event handlers to call Media.onStatus, remaps unsupported-source errors to MEDIA_ERR_ABORTED, sets node.src when media.src exists, and returns the node.
Creates and returns a new Audio node from the provided media input, with no conditional checks, asynchronous operations, or error handling.
Converts file-scheme URIs under the app’s local or temporary folder paths into corresponding appdata-base URIs with leading slashes removed, throws on unsupported file URIs, and returns the URI.
Converts file-scheme URIs to appdata-based Windows.Foundation.Uri paths when outside local or temporary folders, throws on unsupported file URIs, and returns the resulting uri.
Converts file-scheme URIs to app-data URIs for local or temporary folders by matching rawUri paths, throws on unsupported file URIs, and returns the resulting uri.
Converts a URI under the app’s local or temporary folder into an appdata-based Windows.Foundation.Uri, throwing an error if it is not in the temporary folder, and returns the URI.
Converts a `cdvfile` URI to a Windows app-data URI by checking for `temporary` or `persistent` roots, returning mapped paths, throwing on unsupported roots, or returning the original URI otherwise.
Converts a `cdvfile` URI to a Windows `Foundation.Uri` using temporary or persistent app-data base paths, throws for unsupported roots, and otherwise returns the original URI.

Converts a `cdvfile` URI by checking its root (`temporary` or `persistent`) and returning a corresponding `Windows.Foundation.Uri`, otherwise throws for unsupported roots, or returns non-`cdvfile` URIs unchanged.
Converts a cdvfile URI to a Windows app-data URI, using temporary or persistent roots with path segments after index 1, and throws for unsupported non-persistent roots.
Processes a URI string by collapsing non-protocol double slashes, removing one or two leading slashes, converting it through temporary/default and app-data path mappings, and returning the result.

processUri normalizes src by collapsing non-protocol double slashes and removing leading slashes, then transforms it via setTemporaryFsByDefault, fullPathToAppData, and cdvfileToAppData, returning the final uri.

`processUri` normalizes `src` by collapsing non-protocol double slashes and stripping leading slashes, then returns `uri` after applying `setTemporaryFsByDefault`, `fullPathToAppData`, and `cdvfileToAppData`.

Processes a URI string by normalizing duplicate slashes and leading slashes, then applying default temporary filesystem, app-data path conversion, and cdvfile-to-app-data conversion, returning the final URI.
Parses a URI path into a backslash-separated directory path and filename, checks whether the second path segment is `local` or `temp`, and returns `{path, fileName, fsType}`.
Parses a URI path into backslash-normalized directory path and filename, sets fsType to PERSISTENT for “local” or TEMPORARY for “temp”, and returns {path, fileName, fsType}.
Parses a URI path into backslash-normalized directory path and filename, sets fsType to PERSISTENT for “local” or TEMPORARY for “temp” second path segment, and returns {path,fileName,fsType}.
Parses `uri.path` into a Windows-style relative path and filename by splitting on `/`, removing the first two segments, and returns `{ path, fileName, fsType }`.
Initializes a Context with the given hook, a shallow-copied opts object, and command-line string, and defines a lazy-loaded cordova getter returning requireCordovaModule('cordova-lib').cordova.

`Context(hook, opts)` stores `hook`, clones `opts` into `this.opts`, saves joined `process.argv` as `this.cmdLine`, and defines a `cordova` getter returning `requireCordovaModule('cordova-lib').cordova`.
Creates a Context instance by storing hook and a shallow-copied opts, saving joined process arguments, and defining a cordova getter returning requireCordovaModule('cordova-lib').cordova.
Initializes context options by cloning `opts`, captures the command line from `process.argv`, and defines a lazy `cordova` getter on `this` returning `cordova-lib`’s `cordova` object.
Returns a new array of capabilities deduplicated by capability name, adding each capability only if no existing item has the same getCapabilityName value.
`getUniqueCapabilities` reduces the capabilities array, checking whether any accumulated item has the same `getCapabilityName` as the current one, and returns a deduplicated capabilities array.

getUniqueCapabilities reduces the capabilities array, checking whether any accumulated item has the same getCapabilityName as the current one, and returns a deduplicated array preserving first occurrences.
Returns a new array of capabilities with duplicates removed by reducing the input and keeping only the first item for each matching getCapabilityName value.
Compares two capabilities by their extracted names, returning -1 if the first name is lexicographically smaller, 1 if larger, and 0 if they are equal.
Compares two capabilities by their names from getCapabilityName, returning -1 if the first name is less, 1 if greater, and 0 if equal.
compareCapabilities gets each capability’s name via getCapabilityName, returns -1 if firstCapName is less than secondCapName, 1 if greater, and 0 when equal.
Compares two capabilities by their names using getCapabilityName, returning -1 if the first name is smaller, 1 if greater, and 0 if equal.
Checks whether a directory or its ancestors are Cordova roots, preferring PWD/cwd when dir is missing, and returns the exact root, best candidate, or false.
Determines a Cordova root by checking a given directory or, if absent, PWD/cwd differences, walking up parents via isRootDir, and returning exact/best-match directory or false.
Determines a Cordova-related directory by checking the given dir or PWD/cwd fallback, walking up parents via isRootDir, and returning a matched directory or false.
Determines a Cordova project directory by recursively checking `pwd`/`cwd`, walking up parent directories up to 1000 levels, returning the found directory, best prior match, or `false`.
Gets the project root, initializes `origCwd` from `PWD` or `cwd` if unset, updates `process.env.PWD`, changes to that directory, and returns the project root.
Gets the project root, initializes `origCwd` if unset from `process.env.PWD` or `process.cwd()`, updates `process.env.PWD`, changes to that directory, and returns the project root.
Gets the project root, initializes `origCwd` to `process.env.PWD` or `process.cwd()` if unset, updates `process.env.PWD`, changes directory to the root, and returns it.
Changes the current working directory to this.getProjectRoot() and returns that project root path.
Recursively traverses a directory’s subdirectories, deleting any folder named `.svn` when encountered, and otherwise descending into other directories; it returns nothing.
`deleteSvnFolders(dir)` synchronously reads `dir`, checks each entry that is a directory, removes it if its name is `.svn`, otherwise recursively processes it, and returns nothing.

`deleteSvnFolders(dir)` reads directory entries, checks each joined path is a directory, removes it if its name is `.svn`, otherwise recursively calls `module.exports.deleteSvnFolders`, and returns nothing.
Recursively scans a directory’s entries, and for each subdirectory removes it if its name is “.svn”; otherwise it recurses into that subdirectory, returning nothing.
Returns an array of entries in pluginDir when it exists, excluding '.svn' and 'CVS', and including only items that are directories or symbolic links; otherwise returns [].
findPlugins returns an array of entries in pluginDir only if it exists, filtering for directories or symlinks and excluding names '.svn' and 'CVS'; otherwise returns empty array.
findPlugins returns an array of entries in pluginDir only if it exists, filtering for directories or symbolic links and excluding names '.svn' and 'CVS'.
findPlugins returns directory entries in pluginDir that exist, excluding '.svn' and 'CVS', and keeping only items that are directories or symbolic links.
Initializes a HooksRunner by validating projectRoot with cordovaUtil.isCordova, throwing a CordovaError if invalid, otherwise storing the resolved Cordova root in this.projectRoot.
HooksRunner(projectRoot) validates projectRoot with cordovaUtil.isCordova, throws a CordovaError if it is not a Cordova project, and otherwise sets this.projectRoot to the resolved root.
Creates a HooksRunner by validating projectRoot with cordovaUtil.isCordova, throwing CordovaError if invalid, and otherwise assigning the resolved root to this.projectRoot.
Initializes a HooksRunner for a Cordova project by verifying `cordovaUtil.isCordova(projectRoot)`; if falsy, it throws a CordovaError, otherwise it returns nothing.
Reads the first 4096 bytes of a file, extracts its shebang interpreter command, warns if a shebang exists without newline in that full chunk, and returns the command.
Reads the first 4096 bytes of a file, extracts a shebang command, warns if it exists but fills the chunk without a newline, and returns the command.
Reads the first 4096 bytes of a file, extracts its shebang command, warns if a found shebang fills the chunk without line breaks, and returns the command.
Reads the first 4096 bytes of a file, extracts a shebang interpreter command, warns if no newline is found (shebang too long), and returns the extracted command.
Returns true if opts.nohooks exists and any pattern in it matches hook; otherwise returns false, including when opts or opts.nohooks is undefined.
Returns true if `hook.match` matches any pattern in `opts.nohooks`; if `opts` or `opts.nohooks` is undefined, or no matches are found, it returns false.
Checks whether a hook is disabled by returning false if opts or opts.nohooks is undefined, otherwise true if hook.match matches any nohooks entry, else false.
Returns true if any pattern in opts.nohooks matches hook; if opts or opts.nohooks is undefined, or no patterns match during iteration, it returns false.
Returns hook script files by throwing if hook is missing, using only the specified plugin’s platform scripts when opts.plugin exists, otherwise returning scripts for all plugins.
Returns hook script files by hook and options: throws if hook is missing, uses plugin-specific scripts (emitting a verbose message) when opts.plugin exists, otherwise all plugins’ scripts.
Returns hook script files by validating `hook`, using a specific plugin when `opts.plugin` exists (with plugin platform or `opts.cordova.platforms`), otherwise returning all plugins’ hook scripts.
Returns hook script files by validating `hook`, returning plugin-specific scripts when `opts.plugin` is set (using plugin platform or Cordova platforms), otherwise returning scripts for all plugins.

Returns an empty array if the directory doesn’t exist; otherwise reads, numerically/lexically sorts, and filters out dotfiles, then returns script objects with path, fullPath, and useModuleLoader:false.

Returns an empty array if the directory doesn’t exist; otherwise reads entries, sorts numerically or case-insensitively, filters out dot-prefixed names, and returns objects with path, fullPath, and useModuleLoader:false.
Returns [] if dir doesn’t exist; otherwise reads dir entries, sorts numerically or case-insensitively, filters out dot-prefixed names, and returns {path, fullPath, useModuleLoader:false} objects.
Returns [] if the directory doesn’t exist; otherwise reads, numerically sorts, and dotfile-filters entries, returning objects with each script’s path, joined fullPath, and useModuleLoader:false.
Loads the project config XML, retrieves hook scripts for the specified hook and Cordova platforms, and returns each script’s source path and absolute path under projectRoot.
Builds a ConfigParser from opts.projectRoot, gets hook scripts for the given hook and opts.cordova.platforms, and returns mapped objects containing each script’s src path and joined fullPath.
Builds the project config parser from opts.projectRoot, gets hook scripts for the given hook and opts.cordova.platforms, and returns mapped objects with each script’s path and fullPath.
Gets hook scripts from the project config XML for the given hook and Cordova platforms, returning objects with each script’s src path and full path joined to projectRoot.
Retrieves hook script elements for a plugin and platforms, then returns an array of objects containing each script’s relative path, joined full path, and plugin reference.
Returns an array of plugin hook script descriptors by getting hook scripts for the given hook/platforms and mapping each to its src path, joined fullPath, and plugin reference.
Gets hook script elements from `plugin.pluginInfo` for the given hook and platforms, then returns mapped objects containing each script’s `path`, joined `fullPath`, and `plugin`.
Returns an array of hook script file objects for the given plugin, hook, and platforms, each containing src path, joined fullPath under plugin.dir, and the plugin reference.
Collects and returns an array of hook script files by loading all plugins under `opts.projectRoot/plugins` and concatenating each plugin’s scripts for the given hook and Cordova platforms.

Collects and returns all plugin hook script files by finding plugins under opts.projectRoot/plugins, building each plugin’s options, and concatenating getPluginScriptFiles results for the hook and opts.cordova.platforms.

Collects all plugins under `path.join(opts.projectRoot,'plugins')`, builds per-plugin options (`id`, `pluginInfo`, `dir`), concatenates `getPluginScriptFiles(..., hook, opts.cordova.platforms)` results, and returns `scripts`.

Retrieves all hook script files by listing plugins under `opts.projectRoot/plugins`, collecting each plugin’s scripts for the given hook and `opts.cordova.platforms`, and returning the combined `scripts` array.
Iterates capability child elements, tracking seen Name attributes, and removes any element whose Name already appeared, leaving only the first occurrence of each capability name.
ensureUniqueCapabilities iterates capabilities children, checks each child’s attrib.Name against seen names, removes children whose names are already present, and returns nothing.

ensureUniqueCapabilities iterates capabilities.getchildren(), reads each child’s attrib.Name, removes children whose names already exist in uniqueCapabilities, otherwise stores the name, and returns nothing.
Iterates through capability children, removing any element whose Name attribute already appeared earlier, and otherwise recording new names to ensure unique capabilities in place.
Resolves the destination path, throws a CordovaError if that target already exists, and otherwise copies the source file from the plugin to the project, optionally as a link.
`copyNewFile` resolves `project_dir/dest`, throws a `CordovaError` if that target already exists, otherwise calls `copyFile(...)` with `!!link`, returning whatever `copyFile` returns.
Resolves the destination path, throws a CordovaError if that target already exists, otherwise calls copyFile with plugin/source/project/destination and a boolean coercion of link.
Resolves the destination path, throws a CordovaError if that target already exists, and otherwise calls copyFile with plugin/source/project/destination arguments and a boolean link flag.
Initializes a PluginSpec object by assigning scope, id, version, and package, defaulting to null or raw when scope/id/version are missing, and setting package to scoped id or id.
Initializes a PluginSpec by assigning scope, id, version, and package from provided values, defaulting to null, raw, or scope+id/id when corresponding arguments are falsy.
Initializes a PluginSpec object by assigning scope, id, version, and package with fallbacks (scope/version→null, id→raw, package→scope+id or id), returning the constructed instance.
Defines a PluginSpec function accepting raw, scope, id, and version parameters, with no specified conditions, internal calls, asynchronous behavior, errors, or return value.
Resolves a plugin file’s absolute path from `plugin.dir` and `pluginFile`, then returns it as a `$(ProjectDir)`-prefixed path relative to `targetDir`.
Resolves a plugin file’s absolute path from `plugin.dir` and `pluginFile`, then returns `'$(ProjectDir)'` concatenated with its path relative to `targetDir`.
Computes a plugin file path by resolving plugin.dir with pluginFile, then returns `'$(ProjectDir)'` plus the relative path from targetDir to that resolved source path.
Resolves a plugin file’s absolute path from `plugin.dir` and `pluginFile`, computes its path relative to `targetDir`, and returns `'$(ProjectDir)'` prefixed to that relative path.
Parses a Cordova project config, maps each engine to `{name}` plus `version` if `spec` is a valid semver range (otherwise `src`), and returns a resolved Promise of engines.

getPlatforms(projectRoot) loads project config engines, maps each engine to {name, version} when semver.validRange(engine.spec, true) passes or {name, src} otherwise, and returns Promise.resolve(engines).
getPlatforms(projectRoot) parses project config engines, maps each to {name} plus version if semver.validRange(engine.spec, true) passes, otherwise src, and returns Promise.resolve(engines).
Returns a resolved Promise of engine objects from the project config, each with name and either version when spec is a valid semver range or src otherwise.
Gets project plugins from config, mapping each to name, version if spec is a valid semver range otherwise src, plus variables as name/value array, and returns a resolved Promise.
getPlugins reads project config plugins, maps each to {name} plus version if spec is a valid semver range otherwise src, adds variables array, and returns Promise.resolve(plugins).

Returns a resolved Promise of plugin objects from the project config, each with name, version if spec is a valid semver range otherwise src, and variables as name/value pairs.
Creates and returns a replacement object targeting the given manifest file, copying parent, after, xmls, versions, and deviceTarget properties from the original change.
Creates and returns a replacement object with target set to manifestFile and parent, after, xmls, versions, and deviceTarget copied directly from originalChange.
Creates and returns a replacement object with target set to manifestFile and parent, after, xmls, versions, and deviceTarget copied directly from originalChange.
Creates and returns a replacement object targeting manifestFile, copying parent, after, xmls, versions, and deviceTarget properties from originalChange.
If an expected plugin spec is provided, it parses it, throws errors when `pinfo.id` differs or `pinfo.version` fails the specified semver range, and otherwise returns nothing.

Checks an expected plugin spec against pinfo by parsing it, throwing errors if IDs differ or specified version isn’t semver-satisfied, and otherwise returns undefined (including when no spec).

Resolves a directory path, reads package.json to derive platform name and version, rejects with CordovaError if parsing fails or either value is missing, otherwise resolves details object.
Resolves `dir`, reads `package.json` to derive platform and version, rejects if loading fails or either is missing, and otherwise returns a resolved Promise with `{libDir, platform, version}`.

Resolves a directory, reads its package.json to derive platform from package name and version, and returns a resolved Promise with libDir/platform/version or rejects on missing/invalid data.

Returns the input name, but if it matches /^cordova-([a-z0-9-]+)$/ and the captured platform exists in platforms, returns that capture and emits a verbose prefix-removal message.

Prepares each platform by restoring missing plugins, running the platform API prepare with project paths/config, applying edit-config changes via PlatformMunger, and returns a Promise resolving when all platforms finish.
