Initializes message tracking/parsing for a socket, polyfills setKeepAlive when missing, routes parsed messages to matching callbacks or logs unsolicited ones, and on parser errors emits error, disconnects, and ends socket.

initSocket creates a MessageTracker with parser/id, polyfills socket.setKeepAlive if missing, routes socket data to the parser, dispatches matched message callbacks, and returns callback results or false.

initSocket creates a MessageTracker/Parser, polyfills socket.setKeepAlive if missing, routes socket data into the parser, dispatches messages to tracked callbacks (or logs/returns false), and emits parser errors then closes.

Initializes socket message tracking, logs and parses incoming data, dispatches parsed messages to fetched callbacks or logs unsolicited ones, and on parser errors emits an error, marks disconnected, and ends the socket.

`setupClient` wraps `cb` once, bails on socket close/error/end/timeout by destroying the socket and returning an error, runs setup listeners sequentially with limited client methods, emits `setupError` on failure, then calls `cb(err)`.

setupClient wraps cb once, installs bail on socket close/error/end/timeout to destroy socket and callback with err or default error, sets self socket/tracker, runs setup listeners, and returns via cb(err).

setupClient wraps cb once, registers socket close/error/end/timeout bail handlers, stores socket/tracker, runs setup listeners with a basic client wrapper, emits setupError on error, and calls cb(err).
setupClient wraps cb to run once, attaches bail handlers for close/error/end/timeout on socket, runs setup listeners sequentially on basicClient, emits setupError on failure, and invokes cb(err).
Constructs a Graph from a 2D grid by creating GridNode objects for each cell, setting diagonal movement from options, initializing nodes/grid arrays, and calling init().
Constructs a Graph from gridIn by defaulting options, setting diagonal from options.diagonal, creating GridNode objects for each cell, storing them in grid/nodes, and returning via initialization.

Initializes a Graph from gridIn, defaulting options to {}, setting diagonal from options.diagonal truthiness, creating GridNode objects for each cell, storing them in grid/nodes, then calling this.init().
Constructs a graph by iterating every cell in gridIn, creating a GridNode for each (x, y, value), pushing nodes to this.nodes, then calling this.init().
Iterates over a truthy array, calling callback(element, index) for each item, and returns the first truthy callback result; otherwise returns undefined.
Iterates over array only if it is truthy, calls callback with each element and index, returns the first truthy callback result, otherwise returns undefined.
Iterates over array if it exists, calling callback(element, index) for each item, and returns the first truthy callback result; otherwise returns undefined.
Iterates through array elements, calling callback(element, index) for each, and stops early by returning callback’s result when it is truthy; otherwise returns undefined.
Creates and returns an object mapping each array element’s generated key (`makeKey(value)`) to that element by iterating through the array.
arrayToMap creates an object by iterating over array with forEach, assigning each value to result[makeKey(value)], and returns the resulting key-to-value map object.
Creates an object map by iterating over array values, using makeKey(value) as each computed property key, assigning the original value, and returning the result object.
Creates and returns an object mapping each array element’s generated key from makeKey(value) to the original value by iterating through the array with forEach.
Creates a polling-based watched-file set that periodically stats up to chunkSize files every interval, invokes callbacks on stat errors or mtime changes, and returns watch-management methods.
Creates a watched-file set, defaulting undefined interval/chunkSize to 2500/30, polling files for stat errors or mtime changes, invoking callbacks, and returning watcher utility methods.
Creates a watched-file polling set, defaulting undefined interval/chunkSize to 2500/30, polling files in chunks for stat errors or mtime changes, and returning watcher management methods.
Creates and returns a watched-file set object exposing getModifiedTime, poll, startWatchTimer, addFile, and removeFile methods, with no explicit conditions, calls, async behavior, or error handling.
Starts an interval timer that polls up to chunkSize watched files per tick, cycling indices with wraparound until returning to the first checked file, then updates nextFileToCheck.
startWatchTimer sets watchTimer to a setInterval callback that polls files from nextFileToCheck, looping while count<chunkSize and not back to firstCheck, then returns updated nextFileToCheck.
startWatchTimer sets watchTimer to a setInterval callback that polls files up to chunkSize while count<chunkSize and nextToCheck!==firstCheck, wrapping at watchedFiles.length, then returns undefined.
Starts a repeating interval timer that polls up to chunkSize watched files per tick, cycling indices from nextFileToCheck until wrapping or returning to the first checked, and returns nothing.

Scans a template literal segment, handling backticks, `${` boundaries, escapes, and CR/CRLF-to-LF normalization, and returns the appropriate template token while setting tokenValue and unterminated-error state.

Scans a template literal from pos, handling closing backticks, `${` substitutions, escapes, CRLF normalization, and end-of-input untermination errors, then sets tokenValue and returns the appropriate token kind.
Scans a template segment, checking for end-of-input, closing backtick, `${` start, escapes, and CRLF normalization, then sets `tokenValue` and returns the corresponding template token kind.
Scans template text until end, backtick, or `${`, handling escapes and carriage returns, reports unterminated literals when needed, and returns the resulting token after asserting it exists.
Encodes a validated Unicode code point (0 to 0x10FFFF) as a UTF-16 string, returning one code unit for BMP values or a surrogate pair otherwise.
Encodes a Unicode code point to a UTF-16 string, asserting it is between 0x0 and 0x10FFFF, returning one code unit if ≤65535, otherwise a surrogate pair.
Encodes a Unicode code point to a UTF-16 string, asserting it is 0x0–0x10FFFF, returning one code unit if ≤65535, otherwise a surrogate pair via String.fromCharCode.
Encodes a Unicode code point as a UTF-16 string, returning a single code unit if ≤65535; otherwise asserts 0..0x10FFFF and returns the surrogate pair string.
Checks whether the current position starts a `\u` escape with four following hex digits, temporarily scans it, restores position, and returns the parsed value or -1.
Checks that `pos + 5 < end` and `text.charCodeAt(pos + 1) === 117` (`u`), then scans four hex digits from `pos + 2`, restores `pos`, and returns the value or `-1`.
peekUnicodeEscape checks that `pos + 5 < end` and `text.charCodeAt(pos + 1) === 117` (`u`), scans four hex digits after advancing, restores `pos`, and returns the value or `-1`.
Checks if there is room for a Unicode escape and the next character is 'u'; if so returns four scanned hex digits, otherwise returns -1.
If the current token is an identifier or keyword, it advances through subsequent JSX identifier characters (including '-') and appends them to tokenValue, then returns token.
Scans a JSX identifier when the current token is an identifier/keyword, consuming hyphens and valid identifier start/part characters until invalid or end, appending to tokenValue, then returns token.

Scans a JSX identifier when token is an identifier/keyword, consuming '-' and valid identifier start/part characters until end or invalid character, appending substring to tokenValue, then returns token.
Scans characters while within bounds and valid JSX identifier rules (allowing hyphens), stopping otherwise, then returns the token after identifier/keyword handling and substring extraction.

Returns a declaration name by using node.name text, quoting string-literal module names, resolving well-known computed symbol names, or mapping specific unnamed declaration kinds to internal names or default/undefined.

Returns a declaration name string by using node.name text, quoting string-literal module names, resolving well-known computed symbols, handling special declaration kinds, or undefined for non-default exports.

Returns a declaration name by preferring node.name (quoting string-literal names, mapping well-known symbol computed names), otherwise handling specific node kinds with fixed names or default/export/undefined.

Returns a declaration name string by checking node kind and name kind, handling quoted names, well-known symbols, special signature kinds, export/default cases, or undefined for default-export assignments.

bindChildren saves and restores parent/container state, updates container or block-scope locals based on container flags, binds children (tracking InterfaceDeclaration this-usage), and returns nothing.

bindChildren saves/restores parent/container state, sets container and block-scope locals based on containerFlags bits 1/2/4, handles kind 215 this-keyword flagging, traverses children with bind, and returns nothing.
bindChildren saves/restores parent/container scopes, sets parent=node, checks containerFlags bits 1/2/4 and node.kind===215, binds children, updates locals/flags, and returns nothing.
Binds a node’s children by obtaining its container flags, adding the current container to the container chain, and invoking `ts.forEachChild(node, bind)` twice, returning nothing.
Converts a node’s position to a string by finding its source file and line/character at node.pos, returning `fileName(line,column)` with 1-based indices.
`nodePosToString` gets a node’s source file and position, computes line and character via `ts.getLineAndCharacterOfPosition`, and returns `fileName(line+1,character+1)` as a string.
`nodePosToString` gets a node’s source file and line/character at `node.pos`, then returns `file.fileName + "(" + (loc.line+1) + "," + (loc.character+1) + ")"`.
Returns a string like `fileName(line,character)` for a node by getting its source file and converting `node.pos` to 1-based line and character coordinates.
Returns the identifier with one leading underscore removed when it starts with at least three underscores; otherwise, it returns the original identifier.
Returns `identifier.substr(1)` when the string length is at least 3 and its first three characters are underscores (`charCodeAt(0..2) === 95`); otherwise returns `identifier`.
Returns `identifier.substr(1)` only when the identifier length is at least 3 and its first three characters are underscores (`charCodeAt(0..2) === 95`); otherwise returns `identifier`.
Returns the identifier unchanged unless it is at least three characters and starts with three underscores (char codes 95), in which case it returns identifier.substr(1).

Traverses a node’s ancestors to return the nearest enclosing function-like node or block-scope container (SourceFile, CaseBlock, CatchClause, ModuleDeclaration, loop statements, or non-function Block), otherwise undefined.
Starting from node.parent, it walks ancestors and returns the first function-like node or specific kind (248,220,244,218,199,200,201, or 192 when parent isn’t function-like), otherwise undefined.
Starting from node.parent, it walks ancestors and returns the first function-like node or specific block-scope container kinds, with kind 192 returned only when its parent isn’t function-like.
Traverses up from a node and returns the first function-like ancestor, a kind-201 ancestor, or an ancestor whose parent is not function-like; otherwise returns none.
Checks whether a node is an Identifier/StringLiteral/NumericLiteral used as a declaration name, returning true for Import/ExportSpecifiers with propertyName or when it equals its declaration’s name.
Checks whether a node is a declaration name by requiring kind 69/9/8, then returns true for propertyName in parent kind 226/230 or parent declarations naming that node, else false.
Checks whether a node is a declaration name: validates name.kind is 69/9/8, handles parent kinds 226/230 with propertyName, compares declaration parent.name, and returns true/false accordingly.
Checks whether a node is a declaration name: it rejects kinds other than 69, 9, or 8, returns true for propertyName parents, otherwise verifies declaration parent name equality.

Determines whether a node is used as an identifier name by checking specific parent kinds and positions, returning true for matching name/property cases, qualified type-query RHS, and export specifiers.
Determines whether a node is used as an identifier name by checking parent kind and position (name/propertyName, JSX attribute, or nested qualified names), returning true or false accordingly.
Determines whether a node is an identifier name by checking parent.kind cases, returning true for specific property/name positions, assignment-target patterns, kind 230, otherwise false.
Determines whether a node is used as an identifier name by checking parent kind cases (166, 226, 230), handling nested kind-135 parents, and otherwise returns false.
Converts each input string character code into UTF-8 byte values, branching by code-point ranges (<0x80, <0x800, <0x10000, <0x20000), asserting on larger values, and returns the byte array.
Iterates each input character code, encoding it by thresholds (<0x80, <0x800, <0x10000, <0x20000) into 1–4 UTF-8-style bytes, asserting otherwise, and returns the output array.

Iterates through input characters, checks charCode ranges (<0x80, <0x800, <0x10000, <0x20000), pushes corresponding UTF-8 byte values into output, asserts on unexpected code points, and returns output.

Iterates through input characters, gets each char code, conditionally pushes UTF-8-style byte sequences for different code-point ranges, asserts false on unexpected code points, and returns the byte array.
Returns true if `other` starts at or after `span.start` and ends at or before `span`’s end (`textSpanEnd(span)`); otherwise returns false.
Returns true if `other` is fully contained within `span` by checking `other.start >= span.start` and `textSpanEnd(other) <= textSpanEnd(span)`; otherwise returns false.
Returns true if `other` starts at or after `span.start` and `textSpanEnd(other)` is at or before `textSpanEnd(span)`, otherwise returns false.
Returns true if `other` starts at or after `span.start` and ends at or before `span`’s end, otherwise returns false.
`isListTerminator(kind)` returns true when EOF or a kind-specific closing/delimiter token (including some error-recovery tokens and JSX/JSDoc checks) indicates the current parsed list should end.
Determines whether the current token terminates a list for a given kind, checking kind-specific token codes (and one lookahead/helper call), and returns a boolean.
Determines whether the current token terminates a list for a given kind, with kind-specific token checks (and one lookahead/helper call), returning a boolean result.
Determines whether the current token terminates a list for a given kind, first returning true on token 1, otherwise checking kind-specific token matches or helper-call results.
Parses an identifier into an entity name, repeatedly extending it with dot-qualified right-side names while dots are present, and returns the final identifier or qualified-name node.

Parses an initial identifier, then while optional dot tokens exist builds and finishes chained member-access nodes using parseRightSideOfDot(allowReservedWords), and returns the resulting entity expression.
Parses an identifier into an entity, repeatedly while optional token 21 exists builds finished dot-access nodes with parsed right sides honoring allowReservedWords, and returns the final entity.

Parses an entity name by consuming optional token 21 separators, parsing an identifier with a diagnostic message, parsing the right side of a dot with reserved-word handling, and returning the finished node.

Resets cached node state, traverses sourceFile children, and when position lies within node/array bounds finds the highest list element starting exactly at position, updating current references, then returns.
Traverses sourceFile children to find the deepest list element whose child.pos equals position, recursing only when position lies within node/array or child ranges, and returns current.

Traverses sourceFile children to find the deepest list element whose child.pos equals position, recursing only into ranges containing position, and returns via updated current/currentArray/currentArrayIndex state.
Traverses sourceFile children using visitNode and visitArray to find the highest list element starting at the given position, returning undefined if none is found.

Returns the resolved symbol for an import-equals right-hand entity, finding the declaration if missing, adjusting right-side identifiers, and resolving as Namespace or as Value/Type/Namespace based on syntax context.

Resolves and returns an import-equals RHS symbol by finding/asserting the import declaration, adjusting right-side qualified/property names, then calling resolveEntityName with flags based on entity/parent kinds.
Finds and resolves the relevant import-equals RHS entity name, adjusting for qualified/property access, and returns resolveEntityName with either 1536 or 107455|793056|1536 based on node-kind checks.
Returns `resolveEntityName` for an import-equals RHS entity, using meaning `1536` when the name is an identifier or in a qualified name, otherwise `107455|793056|1536`.

Resolves an entity name to a symbol, handling identifiers and qualified/property accesses, returning undefined for missing/unresolvable parts or errors, otherwise the matching symbol or its resolved alias.

Resolves an entity name to a symbol by handling identifiers and qualified/property names, returning undefined for missing/invalid/unresolved parts, optionally reporting errors, otherwise returning symbol or resolved alias.
Resolves an entity name to a symbol, handling missing nodes, identifiers and qualified names, optionally reporting lookup/export errors, and returns undefined, the symbol, or its resolved alias.
Resolves an entity name to a symbol, returning undefined if nodes/symbols/namespaces are missing, reporting missing namespace exports, and otherwise returning a matching symbol or its resolved alias.
Checks whether a name starts with exactly two underscores and the third character is neither underscore nor '@', returning true if reserved-member format matches, otherwise false.
Returns true if `name` starts with two underscores and its third character is neither underscore nor `@`; otherwise it returns false.
Checks whether a name starts with two underscores and its third character is neither underscore nor “@”, returning true only when all these char-code conditions hold.
Returns true if a name starts with two underscores and its third character is neither underscore nor “@”; otherwise returns false.
Returns true if the symbol matches the export-assigned symbol, its resolved alias, or appears in an ancestor chain of the resolved alias’s declarations; otherwise returns undefined.
Checks whether a symbol is used by an export assignment, returning true if it matches directly, matches a resolved non-flagged alias, or appears in that alias’s declaration ancestry.
Checks whether a symbol is used in an export assignment by direct equality, resolved alias equality, or declaration ancestry to node, returning true when matched, otherwise forEach’s result.

Checks whether a symbol is used in an export assignment by direct equality or, after alias resolution when needed, by finding `node` in resolved export symbol declaration ancestry, returning true if found.
Returns the type of a named property on a given type by looking up the property symbol, or undefined if the property does not exist.
Returns the symbol type for a named property on a given type by first retrieving the property; if found, it returns getTypeOfSymbol(prop), otherwise undefined.
Gets a property by name from a type, and returns that property’s symbol type if found; otherwise it returns undefined.
Returns the type of a named property on a given type by retrieving the property symbol, and returns undefined if the property does not exist.
Returns the bound element’s type by checking its symbol and linked type, or falls back to the variable-like declaration type when unavailable.
Gets a node’s symbol via getSymbolOfNode, returns getSymbolLinks(symbol).type when a symbol exists and has linked type, otherwise returns getTypeForVariableLikeDeclaration(node).
Gets a node’s symbol via getSymbolOfNode, then returns getSymbolLinks(symbol).type when symbol exists and has a linked type, otherwise returns getTypeForVariableLikeDeclaration(node).
Returns the symbol’s linked type for a binding element parent when a symbol exists, otherwise returns the variable-like declaration type for the node.

Determines a binding element’s type from its parent pattern/type, handling unknown/any/missing parent types and initializers, object/array destructuring, tuple/rest/index/property checks, returning inferred type or unknownType.

Determines a binding element’s type from its parent pattern/type, returning unknownType for unknown/missing members, initializer type when parent is absent/any, otherwise computed property/element/array type.

Computes a binding element’s type from its parent pattern/type, returning unknownType for unknown/missing properties, using initializer when parent is absent/any, otherwise property/element/array-derived type.

Determines a binding element’s type by using initializer or parent type, handling any/unknown, object/array property and index lookups, tuple bounds errors, and returning the resolved type or unknownType.

Determines a variable-like declaration’s type by checking for-in/for-of, binding patterns, annotations, parameter accessor/context types, initializer or shorthand/binding-name inference, returning inferred type, anyType, or undefined.

Determines a variable-like declaration’s type by checking loop/context kinds, binding patterns, explicit type, parameter/accessor/initializer/import cases, returning the inferred type, anyType fallback, or undefined.

Determines a variable-like declaration’s type by checking loop/binding contexts, explicit type, parameter/property/initializer/identifier/binding-pattern cases, returning the inferred type, anyType fallback, or undefined.

Returns a variable-like declaration’s type by checking for-in/for-of contexts, binding patterns, explicit annotations, getter/contextual/initializer-derived types, special kind 246 identifiers, or binding-pattern names, otherwise undefined.
Returns the widened type of an element’s initializer if present; otherwise, if the name is a binding pattern, returns its pattern type, else returns anyType.
Returns a binding element’s type by widening its initializer expression type if present, otherwise deriving from a binding-pattern name when applicable, and falling back to anyType.
Returns a binding element’s type by preferring widened cached initializer type, otherwise using binding-pattern type when element.name is a binding pattern, and falling back to anyType.
Returns the widened type of an element’s initializer if present, otherwise the binding-pattern type when the name is a binding pattern, and defaults to anyType.

Builds an anonymous object type from a binding pattern by creating transient property symbols for each element, marking initialized elements optional, optionally attaching the pattern, and returning the type.
Builds an anonymous type from an object binding pattern by creating member symbols for each element, conditionally adding initializer flags and the original pattern, then returns that type.
Builds an anonymous type from an object binding pattern by creating member symbols for each element, setting initializer-based flags, and returns it, optionally attaching the original pattern.
Iterates object-binding pattern elements to create member symbols with flags (including initializer and property/name handling), assigns each element’s type, and returns a created anonymous type.
Collects and returns appended type parameters from a symbol’s declarations when each node is an interface, class, class expression, or type alias and has typeParameters.
Iterates a symbol’s declarations, collects typeParameters from declarations whose kind is 215, 214, 186, or 216 using appendTypeParameters, and returns the accumulated result.
Iterates through symbol.declarations, and for declarations whose kind is 215, 214, 186, or 216 with typeParameters, appends them to result and returns result.
Iterates through a symbol’s declarations, appends each declaration’s typeParameters to a result collection, and returns the accumulated local type parameters.

Returns a class type’s cached base constructor type, resolving it from the base type expression, detecting circular base references, validating constructor-ness, and yielding undefinedType or unknownType on failures.
Returns and caches a class type’s base constructor type, handling missing base type nodes, resolution cycles, and non-constructor bases by returning undefinedType or unknownType with errors.

Computes and caches a class type’s base constructor type, handling missing base nodes, resolution cycles, and non-constructor bases with errors, returning undefinedType, unknownType, or the resolved constructor type.
Computes and caches a class’s base constructor type, returning undefined/unknown for missing base, resolution cycles, or non-constructor bases, otherwise the checked base constructor type.
Checks whether a type reference’s typeArguments are all independent types by validating each with isIndependentType, returning false on the first failure and true otherwise.
Checks whether a node’s typeArguments are all independent types by calling isIndependentType on each, returning false on the first failure and true otherwise.
Checks a node’s typeArguments, returning false if any argument fails isIndependentType(typeNode), and otherwise returns true (including when node.typeArguments is absent).
Checks each type argument in `node`; returns false if any argument is not an independent type via `isIndependentType`, otherwise returns true.
Creates and returns an object mapping each symbol’s name to either the original symbol when `mappingThisOnly` is true and it is independent, or an instantiated symbol via `mapper`.
Creates an object mapping each symbol’s name to either the original symbol when mappingThisOnly and isIndependentMember(symbol) are true, or instantiateSymbol(symbol, mapper), then returns it.
Creates an object mapping each symbol’s name to either the original symbol when mappingThisOnly and isIndependentMember(symbol) are true, or instantiateSymbol(symbol, mapper), then returns it.
Creates and returns an object mapping each symbol in `symbols` to `instantiateSymbol(symbol, mapper)` only when `isIndependentMember(symbol)` is true, iterating through all symbols.
Builds a union type’s signatures by collecting each type’s signatures of a given kind, deduplicating by parameter-list matches, merging matching sets, and returning the result or emptyArray.
Builds union signatures for a given kind across types by collecting each type’s signatures, skipping already-matched ones, combining matches, and returning the accumulated signatures or emptyArray.

Builds union-compatible signatures from each type’s signatures of a given kind, adding unmatched signatures with matching counterparts, cloning when multiple matches exist, and returns result or emptyArray.
Maps each type to signatures of the given kind, finds matching signatures across lists, clones and accumulates unique matches, and returns the collected signatures or an empty array.
Returns the named member symbol from an object-typed input only if the type is an ObjectType, the member exists, and the symbol represents a value; otherwise returns undefined.
Returns a property symbol from a structured object type when type.flags & 80896, resolved.members contains name, and symbolIsValue(symbol) is true; otherwise returns undefined.
Returns a property symbol for an object type by name when `type.flags & 80896`, the resolved members contain that name, and `symbolIsValue(symbol)` is true; otherwise returns nothing.
Returns the symbol if it is a value after resolving the object type’s structured members and confirming the named property exists; otherwise returns none.

Returns a type’s apparent form by resolving type-parameter constraints (defaulting to emptyObjectType if unresolved), then mapping StringLike, NumberLike, Boolean, or ESSymbol flags to corresponding global types.

Resolves a type’s apparent form by unwrapping type-parameter constraints, defaulting missing constraints to emptyObjectType, mapping flagged primitive-like types to global types, and returning the resulting type.

Resolves a type’s apparent form by unwrapping type-parameter constraints, defaulting missing constraints to emptyObjectType, mapping specific flag combinations to global primitive types, and returning the resulting type.
Returns the input type after repeatedly replacing it with its type-parameter constraint while the type exists and has flag 512 set.
Gets a named property symbol from a type by checking apparent object members and value symbols, then function/object fallback properties, union/intersection handling, otherwise returning undefined.
Gets a named property from a type’s apparent form, returning a value symbol from structured members or global function/object fallbacks, union/intersection lookup, or undefined when unavailable.

Gets a named property symbol from a type by apparent-type normalization, checking structured-type members/value symbols, function-like fallbacks, and union/intersection flags, returning the found symbol or undefined.
Returns a named property symbol for a type, preferring value symbols, handling object/union/intersection flags and apparent structured members, otherwise returning undefined.
Iterates through all types, bitwise-ORs their `flags` into an accumulator, and returns only the bits matching `PropagatingFlags` (`14680064`).
getPropagatingFlagsOfTypes iterates through all types, bitwise-ORs each type.flags into result, and returns result masked with 14680064 to keep only propagating flag bits.
Iterates through the types array, bitwise-ORs each element’s flags into result, then returns result masked with 14680064 after checking loop index is less than types.length.
Iterates through the given types and returns the accumulated propagating flags masked with 14680064.

Returns a class/interface symbol’s declared type, validating generic arity by requiring matching local type arguments, reporting errors and returning unknownType on mismatch or non-generic arguments, otherwise returning the type/reference.

Gets a symbol’s declared type, validates generic type-argument presence/count against local type parameters, returns unknownType on errors, otherwise returns a created type reference or the original type.

Gets a symbol’s declared type, validates generic type-argument presence/count, returns unknownType with diagnostics on mismatches or non-generic arguments, otherwise returns a created type reference or the plain type.
Returns a symbol’s declared type or a created type reference, validating generic type-argument presence/count and reporting errors for missing, mismatched, or non-generic type arguments.

Returns a symbol’s declared type from a type-alias reference, validating generic type-argument presence/count, reporting errors for mismatches or non-generic arguments, and returning unknownType or instantiated/base type accordingly.

Gets a symbol’s declared type for a type-alias reference, validates generic type-argument presence/count, returns cached or newly instantiated mapped type, otherwise reports errors and returns unknownType or base type.

Gets a symbol’s declared type, validates generic type-argument presence/count, returns cached or newly instantiated mapped type for valid aliases, otherwise reports errors and returns unknownType or the base type.

Returns a symbol’s declared type from a type-alias reference, validating generic arity, instantiating and caching mapped type arguments when valid, otherwise reporting errors and returning unknownType or type.
Iterates through the `types` array, adding each type to `typeSet` by calling `addTypeToSet` with the provided `typeSetKind`, and returns nothing.
Iterates through the `types` array, calling `addTypeToSet(typeSet, type, typeSetKind)` for each element, and returns nothing.
Iterates through the `types` array, assigning each element to `type` and calling `addTypeToSet(typeSet, type, typeSetKind)` for each item, returning nothing.
Iterates through all elements in `types` and calls `addTypeToSet(typeSet, type, typeSetKind)` for each, adding each type to the specified set kind.
Checks whether a property name is known on a type: for object types it validates assignable/global/empty or index/property presence, for unions/intersections any member match, otherwise returns true.
Checks whether a property name is known on a type by testing object-like flags and members or recursively union/intersection constituents, returning true if found, otherwise false.
Checks whether a property name is known on a type: for structured types via members/index signatures/property lookup, for union/intersection types recursively; returns true if found, otherwise false.

Returns true if a property exists or index signatures/assignable-global-empty-object conditions apply, recursively checks union members, returns false for specific flag sets, otherwise resolves members and returns true.

Determines whether two object types are related by caching pair checks, handling recursion/depth overflow and nested-generic expansion, then combining property/signature/index compatibility, returning True, False, or Maybe.

Determines whether two object types are related, short-circuiting on overflow/cached relations/depth limits, recursively comparing members and signatures, and returning relation status codes (-1,0,1,2,3).
Determines whether source and target object types are related, checking overflow, cached relation state, recursion/depth and nesting flags, then returning a relation result code and updating caches.

Compares source and target object types, short-circuiting on overflow, cached/error states, recursion markers, and depth limits, then checks nested generics/properties/signatures/index types and returns relation status.
Returns true when, at depth at least 5, the given reference/instantiated type’s symbol appears at least five times among similarly flagged types in stack[0..depth-1]; otherwise false.
Checks whether, at depth ≥5, a flagged generic type’s symbol appears at least five times among similarly flagged stack entries, returning true if so, otherwise false.
Checks whether a generic-flagged type at depth ≥5 has at least five stack entries before that depth with matching generic flags and symbol, returning true or false.
Checks whether a generic type is deeply nested by looping up to depth and returning true if count reaches at least 5; otherwise returns false.

Checks and caches whether a given symbol is assigned within a node by traversing allowed child syntax, returning true for matching assignment operators or initialized variable declarations, otherwise false.

Determines whether a symbol is assigned within a node by checking assignment operators and initialized matching variable declarations, recursively traversing allowed child kinds, caching and returning the boolean result.

Determines whether a symbol is assigned within a node by checking assignment operators, variable declarations with initializers, recursively traversing relevant child nodes, and returning a cached or computed boolean.
Determines whether a symbol is assigned within a node, returning a cached result when available; otherwise computes assignment status and stores/returns it in links.assignmentChecks by symbol ID.
Narrows a type based on expression kind, handling calls, parentheses, binary operators (===, !==, &&, ||, instanceof), and negation by flipping assumeTrue, otherwise returning the original type.

Narrows a type based on expr.kind and operators, delegating to predicate/equality/and/or/instanceof or recursive expression/negation handling, and returns the narrowed type or original type when unmatched.

narrowType dispatches by expr.kind, handling predicates, parenthesized expressions, binary/unary operators (equality, &&, ||, instanceof, !), recursively narrowing type, and otherwise returns the original type.
`narrowType` narrows a type from an expression by handling predicate, parenthesized, equality, logical-and/or, instanceof, and negation cases, otherwise returning the original `type`.

Returns a parameter’s contextual type for context-sensitive function expressions, arrow functions, or object literal methods by matching its index (including valid rest-parameter cases), otherwise undefined.

Returns a parameter’s contextual type for context-sensitive function expressions/arrows or object-literal methods, using positional type or matching rest-parameter type from the contextual signature, otherwise undefined.

Returns a parameter’s contextual type for function expressions/arrows or object-literal methods when context-sensitive and signature exists, using position or matching rest-parameter type; otherwise undefined.

Returns a parameter’s contextual type for context-sensitive function expressions, arrow functions, or object literal methods, using positional type or rest-parameter symbol type when applicable; otherwise undefined.

Returns an initializer expression’s contextual type when it is the declaration initializer, preferring explicit type annotations, then parameter contextual type, then binding-pattern type; otherwise returns undefined.

Returns a contextual type for an initializer node by checking it is the declaration’s initializer, then using declaration.type, parameter kind 138 contextual type, or binding-pattern type; otherwise undefined.
Returns a contextual initializer type when node is declaration.initializer, preferring declaration.type, then kind===138 parameter type, then binding-pattern name type; otherwise returns undefined.
Returns a contextual initializer type by preferring the parent’s explicit type, then a contextually typed parameter type, then a binding-pattern-derived type, otherwise undefined.
Applies mapper to a type; if non-union returns mapper(type), otherwise maps each union member, keeps truthy results, and returns their union or the single mapped type.
Applies mapper to type directly unless flag 16384 is set; then maps each type.types member, collecting truthy results, and returns their union or the single mapped type.
Applies mapper to a type; if not a union (flags & 16384 unset) returns mapper(type), otherwise maps union members, collects truthy results, and returns their union or single mapped type.
Applies mapper to a type, immediately mapping non-union types, otherwise mapping each union member and returning a union of mapped results or the single mapped type.
Returns true if the type, or any union member when `type` is a union, has an index signature of the specified kind; otherwise returns false.
Returns true if `type` or any union constituent has an index type of `kind`, checking `type.flags & 16384` to decide between iterating `type.types` or checking `type` directly.
Returns whether `type` has an index signature of `kind`, checking if `type.flags & 16384` to search union `type.types` via `ts.forEach`, otherwise checking `type` directly.
Returns true if the type has an index signature of the specified kind, checking each constituent for union types (flag 16384), otherwise checking the type directly.
Asserts the node is an object literal method, returns undefined if it is inside a with-statement body, otherwise returns its contextual type for object literal elements.
Asserts the node is an object literal method, returns undefined if it is inside a with-statement body, otherwise returns getContextualTypeForObjectLiteralElement(node).
Asserts the node is an object literal method, returns undefined if it is inside a with-statement body, otherwise returns getContextualTypeForObjectLiteralElement(node).
Returns undefined for object literal methods inside a with-statement body; otherwise asserts the node is an object literal method and returns its contextual object-literal-element type.
Returns an element expression’s contextual type by checking its array literal’s contextual type, then property-by-index, numeric index type, or ES6 iterable element type; otherwise undefined.
Gets an element expression’s contextual type by checking its parent array literal’s contextual type and index, returning property/index/iterable element type (languageVersion ≥ 2) or undefined.

Returns an element expression’s contextual type by checking its parent array literal’s contextual type and index, then property/index/iterable element types (if languageVersion>=2), otherwise undefined.

Gets an element expression’s contextual type by parent context, checking tuple/property index, numeric index signature, and iterable element type (for languageVersion ≥ 2), otherwise returns undefined.
Returns the sole call signature of a structured type only when exactly one signature exists and it has no type parameters; otherwise it returns nothing.
Gets structured-type call signatures for a type, and returns the sole signature only when exactly one exists and it has no typeParameters; otherwise returns nothing.
Returns the sole structured-type signature for a type when exactly one signature exists and that signature has no typeParameters; otherwise it returns nothing.
Returns the first structured-type signature for `type`, but if that signature has no type parameters, it returns that non-generic signature directly.

Returns a node’s contextual non-generic signature: gets contextual type (object-literal method-specific), returns undefined if absent or union member signatures differ, otherwise clones and unions matching signatures.

Returns a contextual signature for a function/object-literal method node by deriving contextual type, handling non-union types directly, requiring comparable non-generic union signatures, and otherwise returning undefined.
Returns a contextual signature for a node by deriving its contextual type, requiring compatible non-generic signatures across union members, and returning a cloned union signature or undefined.
Returns undefined if no contextual type exists or signatures differ, otherwise returns a cloned common non-generic contextual signature, using object-literal-method contextual typing when applicable.
Retrieves a JSX attribute’s property symbol by looking up its name in the parent element’s attributes type, returning that symbol or `unknownSymbol` if none is found.
Gets the JSX attribute’s property symbol by deriving the parent element’s attributes type and looking up attrib.name.text on it, returning that symbol or unknownSymbol if absent.
Returns the JSX attribute property symbol by getting the parent element’s attributes type and looking up attrib.name.text on it, returning that property or unknownSymbol if absent.
Returns the symbol for a JSX attribute name from its parent element’s attributes type, or unknownSymbol if no matching property symbol is found.

Checks whether a class property access is valid by enforcing super-method, abstract, private/protected, subclass, static, and instance-base-type rules, returning true if accessible, otherwise reporting errors and false.

Validates class property access (including super), checking method/abstract restrictions, visibility flags (public/private/protected), enclosing/subclass and instance-type relationships, returning true if allowed, otherwise reporting errors and false.

Checks class property access validity for super/private/protected/static contexts, reporting errors for invalid method kind, abstract super calls, class mismatch, or inheritance/instance violations, and returns true/false accordingly.

Checks class property access validity by declaration kind and visibility flags (private/protected/public, static/super, inheritance/type constraints), reporting specific errors on violations and returning true or false accordingly.
Returns an indexed-access property name by using literal text, constant element/property access values, or known symbol references; otherwise returns undefined when none of these conditions match.
Returns a property name string by checking index expression kinds (9/8 direct text, 167/166 constant value, or proper symbol reference via known symbol name), otherwise returns undefined.
Returns an indexed property name by checking expression kind (9/8 => text, 167/166 => constant value string), or valid symbol reference => known symbol property name; otherwise undefined.
Returns a property name for indexed access by using literal text for string/numeric kinds, constant value stringification, or known symbol-name mapping, otherwise returning undefined.
Returns the sole call signature of an object type only when it has exactly one call signature and no construct signatures, properties, or string/number index types; otherwise undefined.
Returns the sole call signature of a type after resolving members when `type.flags & 80896` and it has exactly one call signature, no constructors/properties/index types; otherwise `undefined`.

Returns the sole call signature of a type only if type.flags includes 80896 and resolved members have exactly one call signature, no constructors/properties, and no string/number index types; otherwise undefined.
Returns the sole call signature of a type after resolving members, only when exactly one call signature exists and there are no construct signatures, properties, or index types; otherwise undefined.
Returns the effective decorator argument type based on argIndex (0, 1, or 2) using node.parent helpers; otherwise triggers a debug failure and returns unknownType.
Returns the effective decorator argument type by argIndex (0/1/2) using node.parent helper functions, otherwise calls ts.Debug.fail for a fourth synthetic argument and returns unknownType.
Returns a decorator argument’s effective type by checking argIndex 0, 1, or 2 and calling the corresponding helper on node.parent; otherwise it fails and returns unknownType.
Returns the effective decorator argument type by argIndex (0, 1, or 2) via corresponding helper calls on node.parent; otherwise triggers Debug.fail and returns unknownType.

Returns a decorator-specific argument type for Decorator nodes, TemplateStringsArray for first arguments of TaggedTemplateExpression nodes, and undefined otherwise so callers must check the argument type.
Returns the effective argument type by delegating to getEffectiveDecoratorArgumentType for kind 139, returning globalTemplateStringsArrayType for first argument of kind 170, otherwise undefined.
Returns decorator argument type when node.kind is 139, returns globalTemplateStringsArrayType when argIndex is 0 and node.kind is 170, otherwise returns undefined.

Returns a decorator argument type for kind 139 nodes, returns globalTemplateStringsArrayType for first arguments of kind 170 nodes, otherwise calls getEffectiveDecoratorArgumentType and finally returns undefined.
Returns undefined for decorator nodes or index 0 of tagged template expressions; otherwise returns the argument at argIndex from args.
Returns undefined when node.kind is 139, or when argIndex is 0 and node.kind is 170; otherwise returns args[argIndex].
Returns undefined if node.kind is 139 or if argIndex is 0 and node.kind is 170; otherwise returns args[argIndex].
Returns undefined if node.kind is 139 or if argIndex is 0 and node.kind is 170; otherwise returns args[argIndex].
Returns the error-reporting node by using a decorator’s expression, a tagged template’s template when the first argument is checked, or otherwise the original argument node.
Returns node.expression when node.kind is 139, node.template when argIndex is 0 and node.kind is 170, otherwise returns the provided arg.
Returns node.expression when node.kind is 139, node.template when argIndex is 0 and node.kind is 170, otherwise returns the provided arg.
Returns node.expression when node.kind is 139, node.template when argIndex is 0 and node.kind is 170, otherwise returns the provided arg.

Returns a decorator-resolution diagnostic based on `node.parent.kind`: class/class expression, parameter, property, or method/get/set accessor, returning the corresponding “Unable to resolve signature…when called as an expression” message.

Returns a decorator-resolution diagnostic based on `node.parent.kind`, mapping class, parameter, property, and method-related kinds to corresponding `ts.Diagnostics` “Unable to resolve signature …” messages.

Returns a specific ts.Diagnostics “unable to resolve signature” message based on node.parent.kind, handling class (186/214), parameter (138), property (141), and method/accessor (143/145/146) decorators.
Returns a decorator-resolution diagnostic message based on `node.parent.kind`, selecting class (186), parameter (138), property (141), or method (146) decorator signature resolution errors.

Resolves a decorator call by checking expression and apparent types, handling unknown/untyped or missing call signatures with errors, and otherwise returning resolved call information from matching signatures.

Resolves a decorator call by checking expression/apparent types, handling unknown, untyped, or missing-call-signature cases with diagnostics/error resolution, otherwise returning resolveCall with signatures and candidates.

Resolves a decorator call by checking expression/apparent type, unknown/any/untyped-call conditions and call-signature presence, returning resolveErrorCall, resolveUntypedCall, or resolveCall with diagnostics when signatures are missing.

Resolves a decorator call by checking expression type and call signatures, returning untyped/error resolution for unknown, any, or non-callable cases, otherwise resolving the call with diagnostics context.

Returns a node’s cached resolved signature, recomputing when missing or when candidatesOutArray is provided, by resolving Call, New, TaggedTemplate, or Decorator nodes, otherwise triggering an unreachable-branch failure.

Gets node links and, if no cached resolvedSignature or candidatesOutArray is provided, resolves by node.kind (168 call, 169 new, 170 tagged template, 139 decorator), then returns links.resolvedSignature.

Gets node links and, if no cached resolvedSignature or candidates array is requested, resolves by node.kind (168 call, 169 new, 170 tagged template, 139 decorator), then returns links.resolvedSignature.

Gets a node’s links, attempts to resolve signatures for call, new, tagged template, and decorator expressions, then returns links.resolvedSignature, otherwise triggering an unreachable-branch debug failure.

Recursively traverses a node’s binding pattern elements, skipping omitted expressions, assigns types to identifier elements via symbol links, and returns nothing unless the node lacks a binding pattern.
Recursively processes binding-pattern elements in node.name, skipping kind 187, assigning symbol link types for elements whose name.kind is 69, and returns nothing.

Recursively assigns types to binding elements when node.name is a binding pattern, skipping elements with kind 187 and setting symbolLinks.type for elements whose name.kind equals 69; returns nothing.
If node.name is a binding pattern, it iterates through node.name.elements, computes each element’s binding type, and recursively assigns binding element types to each element.

Validates a type parameter by reporting an error if it has an expression, checking its constraint source element, and, when diagnostics are enabled, enforcing constraint/reference and reserved-name rules.
Checks a type-parameter node by reporting an error if it has an expression, checking its constraint, and, when diagnostics are enabled, validating constraint references and reserved names.

checkTypeParameter reports a “Type expected” grammar error if node.expression exists, checks node.constraint, and when produceDiagnostics is true validates illegal constraint references and reserved type-parameter names.
Validates a type parameter by reporting a missing type in its expression, checking its constraint source element and illegal constraint references, and rejecting reserved parameter names.
Returns a promise’s resolved value type by extracting the first parameter type of `then`’s `onfulfilled` callback, unless types are `any`, non-PromiseLike, or missing required call signatures.

Returns a promise’s resolved value type by analyzing then/onfulfilled signatures, but returns undefined if flags indicate undefined, Promise target mismatch, non-PromiseLike assignability, or missing signatures.

Returns a promise’s resolved value type by validating promise-like assignability and callable `then`/`onfulfilled` signatures, otherwise `undefined`, with a fast path for matching global Promise type arguments.

Returns a promise’s resolved value type, rejecting undefined/invalid, direct global Promise special-cases, PromiseLike assignability, valid then signatures, and onfulfilled callback parameter signatures; otherwise returns undefined.
Checks a decorator call’s resolved return type, skips `any`, selects expected type by parent kind (class, parameter/property, method/accessor), and returns the assignability check result/diagnostic.
Checks a decorator call’s resolved return type, skips validation if it is any, otherwise selects expected type by parent kind and validates assignability, returning nothing.
checkDecorator resolves a decorator’s signature return type, exits if it is any, selects expected return type by parent kind, then returns checkTypeAssignableTo’s result with diagnostics.
Validates a decorator’s return type unless already any/unknown, branching by parent kind to compute expected types, then checks assignability and reports chained diagnostic messages on mismatch.
Checks a TypeReference node’s root identifier, resolves aliases as type or namespace, and if an alias targets a non-const-enum value symbol, marks that alias as referenced.
Checks whether a node is kind 151, resolves its root identifier and symbol meaning, and returns nothing while conditionally marking a referenced alias symbol when flags match.
Checks a node of kind 151, resolves its type-name identifier and symbol, and returns by marking the alias symbol referenced when alias-target flags match and const-enum checks fail.
Checks a type node’s first identifier, resolves and aliases its symbol with a specific meaning flag, tests whether the alias target is a const enum/module, and returns nothing.
Checks a node’s kind for property, parameter, method, get, or set accessor declarations, validates the corresponding type annotation as an expression, and returns nothing.
Checks node.kind for cases 141, 138, 143, 145, or 146, then validates the corresponding type annotation expression via checkTypeNodeAsExpression, returning nothing.
`checkTypeAnnotationAsExpression` switches on `node.kind`, and for kinds 138, 141, 143, 145, or 146 checks a related type node as an expression, returning nothing.
Checks a node’s kind against cases 141, 138, 143, 145, and 146, then validates associated type annotation expressions via checkTypeNodeAsExpression, returning nothing.
Checks a node’s decorators: exits if absent or undecoratable, warns if experimentalDecorators is off, validates metadata type annotations when enabled, sets emit flags, and returns nothing.

Checks a node’s decorators: returns early if absent or undecoratable, warns when experimentalDecorators is off, validates metadata-related type annotations by kind, sets emit flags, and checks each decorator.

Checks a node’s decorators by returning early if none or undecoratable, warning when experimentalDecorators is off, validating metadata-related type annotations, setting emit flags, and forEach-checking decorators.

Checks a node’s decorators only if decorators exist and the node can be decorated, warns about experimental decorators, validates type annotations, checks constructor parameters for classes, and returns undefined otherwise.
Traverses a node’s parent chain, and if any ancestor has the CaptureThis flag, reports a duplicate/declaration or expression error based on whether the node is an Identifier, then returns.
Traverses from a node up its parent chain, and if any ancestor has check flag 4, reports a duplicate/captured `this` diagnostic based on whether `node.kind !== 69`, then returns.
Traverses node’s parent chain, and if any current node has check flag 4, reports one of two “captured this” diagnostics based on whether node.kind !== 69, then returns.
Traverses enclosing nodes and, if any has check flag 4, returns undefined; otherwise reports duplicate/captured-`this` identifier errors on `node.name` and `node`.
Checks a parameter’s initializer for illegal local references, allowing only earlier parameters, and reports errors for self-reference or identifiers declared later; otherwise returns nothing.
Checks a parameter declaration’s initializer, traverses identifiers, and reports errors if it references itself or later local parameters in the containing function; otherwise returns without value.
Checks a parameter initializer by traversing identifiers, and if in a parameter declaration, reports errors for self-reference or references to later-declared locals; otherwise returns without value.
Checks whether a node’s root declaration kind is 138; if not, returns undefined, otherwise gets the containing function and visits the node’s initializer without returning a value.

Validates variable-like declarations by checking decorators/source, computed names, binding patterns, parameter-initializer legality, initializer type assignability, merged-declaration type consistency, and name/export collisions, returning early on specific errors/pattern cases.

Checks a variable-like declaration by validating decorators/type/name patterns and initializers, enforcing parameter-initializer context and merged-declaration type consistency, reporting collisions/exports issues, and returns early on specific errors otherwise nothing.

Checks a variable-like declaration’s decorators, name/initializer validity, binding patterns, parameter-initializer context, type consistency/assignability across declarations, and merge/export/name-collision rules, reporting errors and returning nothing.

Validates a variable-like declaration by rejecting invalid parameter initializers or binding-pattern names, checking decorators/type/name/initializer and type assignability/consistency, then performing export, shadowing, and capture-collision checks.
Determines an iterable’s element type, optionally verifies assignability to an Iterable of that type when both `errorNode` and element type exist, and returns that type or `anyType`.
Gets an iterable’s element type, optionally checks assignability to an iterable of that type when both errorNode and elementType exist, and returns elementType or anyType.
Computes an iterable’s element type, optionally checks assignability to `Iterable<elementType>` when both `errorNode` and `elementType` exist, and returns `elementType` or `anyType` if falsy.
Determines an iterable’s element type, verifies the iterable is assignable to an iterable of that element type at the error node, and returns that element type or anyType.
Checks each type parameter declaration, validates it via checkTypeParameter, and when diagnostics are enabled, reports an error for duplicate identifiers sharing the same symbol.
Checks a type-parameter declaration array, validates each with checkTypeParameter, and when produceDiagnostics is true reports duplicate symbols among earlier entries; it returns nothing.
Checks each type parameter declaration, optionally reports duplicate symbols among earlier declarations when diagnostics are enabled, and returns nothing.
Iterates through type parameter declarations, checks each against earlier ones for duplicates, reports a duplicate-identifier error when found, and calls checkTypeParameter on each node.
Checks a source file once unless already TypeChecked, skips default libs when configured, performs grammar/element/module checks, updates emit/typecheck flags, and otherwise returns early/undefined.
Checks a source file once unless already flagged, skips default libs when configured, performs grammar/statement/module checks, sets emit-related link flags, and returns early or undefined.
Checks a source file once unless already flagged, skips default libs when configured, performs grammar/semantic/export/this-collision checks, updates emit-related link flags, and returns undefined.

Checks a source file by skipping default libraries when configured, then validating grammar, statements, expression bodies, external-module exports, and potential `this` collisions, returning `undefined` only when skipped.
Adds a symbol to `symbols` by its name only when `symbol.flags` includes `meaning` and `symbols` lacks that key; otherwise it leaves `symbols` unchanged.
copySymbol checks whether symbol.flags shares bits with meaning, and if so stores symbol in symbols[symbol.name] only when symbols lacks that property; it returns nothing.
If symbol.flags bitwise-AND meaning is truthy, it gets symbol.name and, when symbols lacks that key, assigns symbols[id] = symbol; otherwise it does nothing and returns undefined.
Checks whether `symbols` has property `id` using `ts.hasProperty`, and returns nothing.
Returns the parent class element’s type by getting its symbol and, if the node has the Static flag, returning the symbol’s type; otherwise its declared type.
Gets the parent class symbol from `node.parent`, checks whether `node.flags & 128` is set, and returns `getTypeOfSymbol(classSymbol)` or otherwise `getDeclaredTypeOfSymbol(classSymbol)`.
Gets the parent class symbol’s type for a class element node, returning getTypeOfSymbol(classSymbol) when node.flags & 128 is truthy, otherwise getDeclaredTypeOfSymbol(classSymbol).
Returns the parent class element’s type by getting its parent symbol, returning getTypeOfSymbol when node.flags includes 128, otherwise getDeclaredTypeOfSymbol.
Gets a type’s apparent properties, adds global function properties when it has call or construct signatures and missing names, then returns the named members list.
Gets a type’s apparent properties, and if it has call or construct signatures, adds missing global function-type properties by name, then returns the named members table.
Gets a type’s apparent properties, and if it has call or construct signatures, adds missing global function-type properties by name, then returns the named members table.
Gets a type’s apparent properties, forces signature retrieval for call/construct kinds, adds missing global function properties by name, and returns the resulting named members list.
Returns the source file or enclosing module/enum declaration containing a node’s referenced value symbol, unless an exported symbol has ExportHasLocal, in which case it returns undefined.

Gets a node’s referenced export container by resolving its symbol, handling alias/export-symbol flags, and returning undefined for disallowed exports, otherwise the parent module declaration or matching ancestor node.

Gets a node’s referenced value symbol, resolves export aliases unless excluded by flags, then returns the parent module/source-file declaration or matching enclosing import/export node, otherwise undefined.

Returns the parent export container declaration for a referenced value symbol unless exportSymbol has flags 944, checking parentSymbol module declaration or matching ancestor kinds 218/217, otherwise undefined.
Returns the alias import declaration for a node’s referenced value symbol when that symbol exists and has the Alias flag; otherwise returns undefined.
Gets a node’s referenced value symbol, and if the symbol exists and has flag 8388608 set, returns getDeclarationOfAliasSymbol(symbol); otherwise returns undefined.
Gets a node’s referenced value symbol, and if it exists and its flags include 8388608, returns getDeclarationOfAliasSymbol(symbol); otherwise returns undefined.
Returns the alias declaration for a node’s referenced value symbol when the symbol exists and has flag 8388608 set; otherwise returns undefined.
Returns the symbol’s valueDeclaration when getReferencedValueSymbol(node) yields a symbol that is a nested redeclaration; otherwise returns undefined.
Gets the referenced value symbol for a node and returns its valueDeclaration only if the symbol exists and is a nested redeclaration symbol; otherwise returns undefined.
Returns `symbol.valueDeclaration` for a node when `getReferencedValueSymbol(node)` yields a symbol and `isNestedRedeclarationSymbol(symbol)` is true; otherwise returns `undefined`.
Returns the symbol’s valueDeclaration when getReferencedValueSymbol(node) yields a symbol recognized by isNestedRedeclarationSymbol; otherwise returns undefined.
Returns "_default" if that identifier is unused in currentSourceFile.identifiers; otherwise increments suffixes ("_default_1", "_default_2", etc.) until finding and returning an unused name.
Returns "_default" if currentSourceFile.identifiers lacks it; otherwise loops appending incrementing suffixes ("_default_1", etc.) until finding and returning the first unused name.
Returns a unique default export temp name by checking currentSourceFile.identifiers: returns "_default" if unused, otherwise loops generating "_default_1", "_default_2", etc. until unused.
Returns "_default" if that identifier is unused; otherwise loops checking generated names (name_18) until finding an unused identifier, which it returns.
Generates a unique temporary variable name, preferring “_i” or “_n” when matching unused flags, otherwise incrementing a counter (skipping i/n slots) until a unique name is found and returned.

Generates a unique temporary variable name by first trying `_i` or `_n` when flags are set and unused, otherwise looping through `_a`/numbered names excluding counts 8 and 13, returning the first unique name.

Generates a unique temporary variable name by first reusing `_i`/`_n` when flags are set and unused, otherwise incrementing tempFlags to return `_a`-style or numeric suffix names excluding counts 8 and 13.
Generates temporary variable names from sequential lowercase letters, returning the first unique name found by repeatedly checking uniqueness in an infinite loop until a unique candidate is returned.
Ensures `baseName` ends with “_”, then increments a positive integer suffix until `isUniqueName` is true, returning and storing the first unique generated name in `generatedNameSet`.
makeUniqueName appends “_” to baseName if it doesn’t end with char code 95, then increments numeric suffixes until isUniqueName succeeds, stores, and returns the generated name.
Generates a unique name by appending “_” if baseName doesn’t end with “_”, then incrementing numeric suffixes until isUniqueName succeeds, storing and returning the chosen name.
Generates candidate names from baseName in an infinite loop, checking isUniqueName(generatedName), and when unique, stores it in generatedNameSet under that key and returns it.

Encodes and appends the last recorded source-map span only when present and changed, adding comma/line delimiters, VLQ-encoding relative fields (and optional name index), then updating tracking state.
Encodes and appends the latest source-map span only when present and changed, inserting line/segment separators as needed, updating last-encoded state, and returning undefined.
Encodes and appends a new source-map span only when one exists and differs from the last encoded span, handling same/new emitted lines and optional nameIndex, then returns undefined.
Encodes and records the last source-map span unless absent or unchanged, handling intervening emitted lines, encoding mapping deltas, pushing decoded mappings, and otherwise returning undefined.
Creates and returns a synthesized Identifier node whose text is set to a temporary variable name generated from the provided flags.
Creates a synthesized node (kind 69), sets its text to a temporary variable name generated from flags, and returns the resulting node.
createTempVariable(flags) creates a synthesized node (kind 69), sets its text to makeTempVariableName(flags), and returns the resulting node.
Creates and returns a synthesized node (kind 69) as a temporary variable by calling `ts.createSynthesizedNode(69)` and `makeTempVariableName(flags)`, with no conditional checks.

Determines whether to indent between two nodes by checking real-node line differences or synthesized newline starts, then writes a newline and returns true, otherwise optionally writes a value and returns false.

Checks whether to indent based on parent not synthesized with node1/node2 on different lines or node2 starting a new synthesized line, then indents/writes line and returns true; otherwise optionally writes a fallback value and returns false.
Checks whether nodes should be split onto a new indented line (real nodes differ lines or synthesized node starts new line), writes fallback text otherwise, and returns true/false accordingly.
Checks whether real nodes span different lines or a synthesized node starts on a new line, returning true to increase indent/write line, otherwise false and writes the provided value.

Emits exponentiation code: for `**=` it handles element/property access by creating temporary references (and parenthesizing) before assigning `Math.pow(lhs, rhs)`, otherwise emits `Math.pow(left, right)`.
Emits exponentiation code by converting `**`/`**=` into `Math.pow`, handling element/property access left sides with temporary assignments and optional parentheses, and returns nothing.

Emits exponentiation as `Math.pow`; if operatorToken.kind is 60, it rewrites element/property accesses with temporaries and optional parentheses to preserve evaluation order, otherwise emits direct `Math.pow(left,right)`.

Emits code for exponentiation assignment using `Math.pow`, handling element/property access left-hand sides with synthesized nodes and temporary assignments, otherwise emitting a direct `Math.pow(left, right)` expression.
Returns false if the declaration should be hoisted; otherwise determines var/let/const (let/const only in ES6+), emits the keyword with optional start position formatting, and returns true.
Returns false if `shouldHoistVariable(decl, true)` is true; otherwise selects var/let/const token kind (with languageVersion/decl checks), emits or writes it, and returns true.
Returns false if `shouldHoistVariable(decl, true)` is true; otherwise selects var/let/const token kind (with languageVersion checks), emits or writes it, and returns true.
Returns false if `shouldHoistVariable(decl, true)` is false; otherwise emits token kind 102/108/74 plus space, or writes `var`/`let`/`const`, then returns true.
Emits an assignment, optionally prefixed by “, ”, wrapping exported source-level names in an export function call, and writes either module member or direct name assignment to value.
Emits an assignment string, optionally prefixed by “, ”, wraps exported names with an export function call, emits module member names for variable/binding declarations, and returns nothing.
Emits an assignment string, optionally prefixed by “, ”, wraps exported names with an export function call, emits module member names for variable/binding parents, and returns nothing.
Emits an assignment expression string, optionally prefixed with ", ", by writing an export-function call with the name, module member name, assignment target, and value.
Creates a temporary variable, records its declaration when in-place definition is disallowed, emits an assignment of the expression (optionally comma-prefixed), and returns the identifier.

Creates a temporary variable identifier, records its declaration when in-place temp definitions are disallowed, emits an assignment of the expression (optionally comma-prefixed), and returns the identifier.
Creates a temp variable identifier, records its declaration when temp variables cannot be defined in place, emits assignment from expression with optional leading comma, and returns the identifier.
Creates a temporary variable for the expression, records its declaration, emits an assignment using the comma-before-assignment flag, and returns the temporary variable identifier.
Returns the original expression if it is an Identifier and reuse is allowed; otherwise creates a temporary variable assignment, increments emitCount, and returns that identifier.
Returns `expr` unchanged when `expr.kind === 69` and reuse is allowed; otherwise assigns `expr` to a temp variable, increments `emitCount`, and returns that identifier.
Returns `expr` unchanged when `expr.kind === 69` and reuse is enabled; otherwise assigns `expr` to a temp identifier, increments `emitCount`, and returns that identifier.
Returns `expr` unchanged when it is an identifier and reuse is allowed; otherwise creates and returns a temporary identifier via `emitTempVariableAssignment(...)`.
