Creates markup for a property by ignoring invalid values, handling boolean/overloaded-boolean attributes, quoting acceptable values, conditionally setting generic attributes, returning empty string or null otherwise.
Registers a bubbled event listener on the given element using the handler name and top-level type, returning null if element is missing, otherwise the listener registration result.
Returns null if `element` is falsy; otherwise attaches an event listener via `EventListener.listen(element, handlerBaseName, dispatchEvent.bind(null, topLevelType))` and returns that call’s result.
trapBubbledEvent returns null if element is falsy; otherwise it returns EventListener.listen(element, handlerBaseName, dispatchEvent.bind(null, topLevelType)).
Returns null if element is missing; otherwise attaches a listener on element for handlerBaseName that dispatches topLevelType-bound events, and returns the EventListener.listen result.

Creates and returns an update queue object initialized with the given baseState, NoWork expirationTime, null first/last/callbackList, and false force-update/initialization (plus isProcessing false in development).
Creates and returns an update queue object initialized with baseState, NoWork expirationTime, null first/last/callbackList, false hasForceUpdate/isInitialized, and sets isProcessing to false.
Creates and returns an update queue object initialized with baseState, NoWork expirationTime, null first/last/callbackList, false hasForceUpdate/isInitialized, and sets isProcessing to false.
Creates and returns an update queue object initialized with the provided baseState, NoWork expirationTime, null first/last/callbackList pointers, and false hasForceUpdate/isInitialized flags.

Initial-mounts a class component instance by validating pending props, setting props/state/refs/context, marking async components, running componentWillMount with queued state updates, and returning nothing.

Initializes a class component instance for mounting, validating pending props, setting props/state/context/refs, handling async-component and lifecycle checks, processing queued updates, and returning nothing.

mountClassInstance initializes a class component instance for mounting, requiring pending props, setting props/state/refs/context, optionally enabling async updates, running componentWillMount with queued updates, and returning nothing.

mountClassInstance validates the class instance, requires pending props for initial mount, gets unmasked/masked context, calls componentWillMount when defined, processes the update queue, and returns nothing.

Schedules a root update, enforcing nested-update limits, updating or inserting root priority, avoiding reentrancy, flushing immediately for unbatched/sync cases, otherwise scheduling deferred async work, and may return early.

Schedules a root’s work, guarding against excessive nested updates, updating scheduled-root links and remaining expiration time, then returns early when rendering/batching, otherwise runs sync work or schedules async callbacks.

Schedules work for a root, guarding nested-update overflow, updating root scheduling/expiration state, returning early when rendering or batching, and triggering synchronous or deferred callbacks otherwise.

`requestWork` exits early if rendering or batching updates are in progress; otherwise it enforces an invariant, performs synchronous root/work processing, starts a callback timer, and schedules deferred async work.
Returns false when no deadline exists or remaining time exceeds `timeHeuristicForUnitOfWork`; otherwise marks `deadlineDidExpire` true and returns true.
`shouldYield` returns false if `deadline` is null or `deadline.timeRemaining()` exceeds `timeHeuristicForUnitOfWork`; otherwise it sets `deadlineDidExpire` to true and returns true.
`shouldYield` returns false if `deadline` is null or `deadline.timeRemaining()` exceeds `timeHeuristicForUnitOfWork`; otherwise it sets `deadlineDidExpire` to true and returns true.
Returns true only when a deadline exists and its remaining time is not greater than the unit-of-work heuristic; otherwise returns false.
Deletes a node property value by using its mutation method, resetting required properties to false or empty string, or removing the mapped/raw attribute when no property info exists.

Deletes a node property by name: if property info exists it may call a mutation method, reset required properties (boolean to false, otherwise ''), or remove its attribute; otherwise removes name directly.

Deletes a node property/attribute by name: gets propertyInfo, optionally calls its mutationMethod(undefined), then clears required properties (false/''), removes mapped attributes, or removes the raw named attribute.
Deletes a property value from a node by retrieving property info, applying mutationMethod with undefined, and removing both the mapped attribute name and the original name.
Updates a DOM element’s properties by diffing custom-component status between old/new props, then for input/textarea/select tags runs respective wrapper updates and returns nothing.

Updates a DOM element’s properties by checking custom-component status for previous and next props, applying DOM updates, then running tag-specific wrappers for input, textarea, or select, returning nothing.
Computes previous and next custom-component status, updates DOM properties accordingly, then for tags input, textarea, or select runs specific wrapper updates, returning nothing.

Updates a DOM element’s properties by handling input/textarea/select tags, checking previous and next custom-component status, applying DOM updates, and running wrapper/value synchronization with no return value.
Asynchronously runs code in a Worker, validating code is a string, options is an object, and interval > 0, then resolves with profiler report or rejects on error.

Asynchronously validates `code` is a string, normalizes/validates `options` and `interval>0`, then runs a worker with profiling and returns a Promise resolving to `probe.report(start,end)` or rejecting on error.
Validates `code` is a string, `options` an object, and `interval` ≥1 (with defaults), then returns a Promise profiling a worker and resolving report(start,end) or rejecting on error.
Validates that code is a string, options is an object, and interval (default 125) is >0, then runs a Worker with profiling and returns a Promise resolving report or rejecting on error.
Initializes an ExponentialBackoffStrategy by calling BackoffStrategy, setting current and next delays and default factor, validating provided options.factor is greater than 1, and storing it.
Initializes an ExponentialBackoffStrategy by calling BackoffStrategy, setting delays and default factor, and if options.factor is provided, validates factor > 1 then assigns it; returns nothing.
Initializes an exponential backoff strategy by calling the base constructor, setting delay fields and default factor, and if options.factor is defined, validates factor>1 then assigns it.
Initializes an exponential backoff strategy by invoking the base BackoffStrategy with options, retrieving the initial delay, and asserting options.factor is greater than 1.
Initializes a Backoff event emitter with the provided strategy, sets retry/backoff counters and delay defaults, timeout ID to -1, and binds the backoff handler.

Constructs a Backoff EventEmitter, stores the provided backoffStrategy, initializes retry/backoff counters and timeout ID (-1/0 defaults), binds onBackoff_ to this.handlers.backoff, and returns nothing.
Backoff initializes an EventEmitter-based instance, stores the provided backoffStrategy, sets retry/timeout state fields to -1 or 0, and returns the constructed object with a bound backoff handler.
Initializes a Backoff instance by invoking EventEmitter on this object and binding its onBackoff_ handler, without explicit conditions, asynchronous behavior, errors, or return value.
Initializes a FunctionCall event emitter, validating fn, args, and callback types, then stores them with default retry/backoff settings and returns a pending-state instance.
Initializes a FunctionCall event-emitter instance, validates fn and callback are functions and args is an array, sets internal retry/state fields, and returns nothing.
Initializes a FunctionCall event-emitter instance after validating fn and callback are functions and args is an array, then sets internal fields and returns nothing.
Initializes a FunctionCall event emitter, validating that fn and callback are functions and args is an array, and returns no explicit value.

Initializes a Channel with default capped Mongo collection options (autoIndexId, size, non-strict), sets connection/name/state fields, then creates and listens on the channel and removes listener limits.

Initializes a Channel with default options, forcing capped/autoIndexId true and strict false, setting default size if missing, assigning instance fields, then calling create().listen() and setMaxListeners(0).

Initializes a Channel instance by defaulting options, enforcing capped/autoIndexId/size/strict values, setting instance fields and default name, starting create().listen(), and calling setMaxListeners(0), returning nothing.
Initializes a Channel by creating and listening on it, then sets unlimited listeners with setMaxListeners(0), using the calling context as this and returning nothing.

Initializes a Connection by defaulting options.autoReconnect to true, using uri as db if it has collection, otherwise connecting via MongoClient and emitting connect/error events, then setting destroyed/channels.

Initializes a Connection by defaulting options and autoReconnect, using uri.collection directly or MongoClient.connect otherwise, emitting connect/error events, and setting destroyed=false and channels={} (no return value).

Initializes a Connection by defaulting options and autoReconnect, using uri.collection directly or MongoClient.connect otherwise, emitting connect/error events, and setting destroyed false and channels to {}.
Creates a MongoDB connection using `MongoClient.connect`; if connection fails it emits `error`, otherwise stores `db`, emits `connect`, and forwards database `error` events.

Creates or returns a Draggable instance for a target, reusing cached instances by resetting state and updating options, otherwise initializing properties, optional droppable setup, limits, and idle state.
Creates or reuses a Draggable for target: if not called with `new` it returns a new instance, otherwise resets cached instance or initializes and configures one.
Draggable acts as a constructor/factory: if not called with `new` it returns a new instance, otherwise reuses cached target instances or initializes, updates, and returns `this`.
Creates or reuses a Draggable for a target: if not called with `new` it recurses, returns cached instance when present, otherwise initializes, updates, caches, and returns nothing.

ConjunctionMap stores values keyed by conjunction arrays, ignoring undefined values on add, and get returns the first mapped value whose stored conjunction has equal length and contains all queried conjuncts.

Creates a ConjunctionMap with add/get methods: add ignores undefined values and stores conjunction/value pairs, while get returns the first stored value whose conjunction length and members exactly match.
Creates a conjunction-to-value map where add ignores undefined values, stores each conjunction as a LiteralTreeMap with its size, and get returns the first matching value or undefined.
ConjunctionMap is a function with no inputs, conditions, calls, async behavior, error handling, or specified return value.

sortTimables splits conjunction items into early and later arrays by marking time-dependent variables from comparison functors and Timables with differing start/end variables, then checking Timable range membership.
Sorts conjunction terms into early and later arrays by timability, time-range inclusion, and dependency on tracked time variables, returning `[earlyConjuncts, laterConjuncts]`.

sortTimables partitions conjunction into early and later conjuncts by checking Timable status, range inclusion at forTime, and dependent start/end time variables, returning [earlyConjuncts, laterConjuncts].
Iterates conjunction twice to collect Timable conjuncts in range at forTime, skipping duplicates by start-time key and tracking dependent variables, then returns two arrays of grouped timables.
Creates and returns a function that builds a program-arguments predicate from `programArgs`, adds it to `program` facts, and returns a resolved Promise containing the updated `program`.
`createProgramArgsUpdaterFunc(programArgs)` returns a function that builds a program-args predicate from `programArgs`, adds it to `program.getFacts()`, and returns `Promise.resolve(program)`.
`createProgramArgsUpdaterFunc` returns a function that builds a program-arguments predicate from `programArgs`, adds it to `program.getFacts()`, and returns `Promise.resolve(program)`.
Creates a function that builds a predicate from programArgs, adds it to a program’s facts, and returns a resolved Promise containing the updated program.

Processes current-time observations by adding actions, rejecting any whose pre/post constraint checks fail on cloned program states, propagating unended observations to next time, and returning active observations.

Processes current-time observations by validating each action against constraints before and after state updates, removing and warning on failures, scheduling ongoing observations for next time, and returning active actions.

Processes current-time observations by collecting actions, rejecting and warning on constraint failures in cloned programs, scheduling ongoing observations for nextTime, and returning the activeObservations map.

Returns current active observations if none exist at the current time; otherwise validates each observed action against constraints, keeps valid ones, reschedules ongoing observations, and returns activeObservations.
Recursively selects candidate actions across goal trees, accepting candidates only if pre- and post-constraint checks pass, and returns a merged LiteralTreeMap of selected actions.
Recursively explores goal trees’ candidate actions, keeping branches only when pre- and post-action constraint checks pass, and returns a LiteralTreeMap union of literals from selected action sets.
Recursively explores candidate actions across goalTrees, pruning branches when pre/post constraint checks fail, and returns a LiteralTreeMap of accumulated literals after all levels are processed.
Calls `recursiveActionsSelector` with an empty action list, `_program`, and depth `0`, and returns whatever result that recursive selection process produces.

performCycle increments time, updates program state from executed actions, records pending observations/actions, processes rules and goals, selects next actions/observations, updates cycle trackers, and returns a resolving Promise.

Advances time, updates and sets program state, processes rules/goals and cycle observations, then returns a Promise resolving after updating next-cycle actions/observations and last-cycle executed actions/observations.

performCycle increments time, clones and updates program state, records pending actions/observations, processes rules and goals, selects next-cycle actions/observations, updates tracking fields, and returns a resolved Promise.

Performs one cycle by cloning/updating program state, recording pending actions/observations, processing rules and goals, selecting next actions plus cycle observations, updating executed/last sets, and returning a resolving Promise.
Calls `func` with `thisObj` as its context and a copied array of `args`, returning whatever value `func.apply` produces.
Applies `func` with `thisObj` as context and arguments converted from `args` via `Array.prototype.slice.call`, returning the result of `func.apply`.
applyArgs returns func.apply(thisObj, Array.prototype.slice.call(args)), invoking func with thisObj as context and a sliced array copy of args as arguments.
Applies `func` with `thisObj` as context and `args` converted to an array via `Array.prototype.slice.call`, returning the result of that function call.
Returns the original string if its length is at least the target length; otherwise prepends padChar repeated to reach the target length and returns the result.
Returns `str` unchanged if `str.length` is at least `length`; otherwise returns `padChar` repeated `length - str.length` times prepended to `str`.
padStart returns str unchanged if str.length is at least length; otherwise it returns padChar repeated (length - str.length) times concatenated before str.
Returns the original string if its length is at least the target length; otherwise returns the string left-padded with repeated padChar to reach that length.
Creates an SM2Curve instance, returning a new one when called without `new`, and otherwise initializes it by invoking `elliptic.curve.short` with the provided parameters.
SM2Curve acts as a constructor/factory: if called without an SM2Curve instance it returns `new SM2Curve(params)`, otherwise it calls `elliptic.curve.short.call(this, params)`.
SM2Curve acts as a constructor wrapper: if called without an SM2Curve instance, it returns `new SM2Curve(params)`; otherwise it calls `elliptic.curve.short.call(this, params)`.
Initializes an SM2Curve instance, ensuring constructor invocation with `new` by recursively calling itself otherwise, then invoking the parent short Weierstrass curve constructor with `params`.

Creates an SM2KeyPair instance from string/byte/object public keys and string/BN private keys, deriving a missing public key, validating keys unless both were prevalidated, and returning the instance or throwing errors.
SM2KeyPair constructs/returns an instance, parses and validates public/private keys (string, byte array, BN/x-y BN object), derives pub from pri when missing, and throws on invalid keys.
Constructs an SM2KeyPair (with or without `new`), parses/validates public and private keys by accepted types, derives missing public key from private key, and throws on invalid keys.
Initializes an SM2KeyPair, enforcing BN-based public x/y and private key validity, deriving missing keys from strings/bytes/hex or multiplication, and throwing on invalid keys.
Creates and returns a through2 object stream transform that, for each target, instantiates StaticI18n with target, options, and stream, then calls translate with the callback.
`gulpStaticI18n(options)` returns a `through.obj` transform stream that, for each target, creates `StaticI18n(target, options, this)` and calls `build.translate(cb)`.
`gulpStaticI18n(options)` returns a `through.obj` transform function that, for each `target`, creates `new StaticI18n(target, options, this)` and calls `build.translate(cb)`.
Creates and returns a through.obj transform stream that, for each target, instantiates StaticI18n with target, options, and stream, then calls translate(cb).

Initializes a View by creating and appending a div wrapper, storing model/state, injecting styles, and registering document/window event handlers with touchstart-or-click selection based on touch support.

Initializes a View by creating and assigning a wrapper div, storing model and isShowing=false, setting wrapper id from config.name, appending/injecting styles, adding touchstart-or-click, keyup, readystatechange, and pageshow handlers; returns nothing.

Initializes a View by creating and appending a div wrapper, setting model/state, injecting styles, and adding event listeners, choosing touchstart when ontouchstart exists, otherwise click; returns nothing.
Creates a div wrapper, appends it to config.parent, injects styles into head, and registers touch/click, keyup, readystatechange, and pageshow event handlers, returning nothing.
Constructs a Product by parsing quantity, amount, and href fields in data, storing normalized data with null-initialized option, discount, amount, and total properties, then invoking Pubsub.
Initializes a Product by parsing data.quantity, data.amount, and data.href, storing data and null defaults for internal fields, then invoking Pubsub.call(this) and returning nothing.
Initializes a Product by parsing data.quantity, data.amount, and data.href via parser methods, storing data and null-initialized internal fields, then invoking Pubsub.call(this), returning nothing.
Initializes a Product by parsing quantity, amount, and href from data, then invoking Pubsub with this context; it has no explicit conditions or return value.
Initializes a Cart with default items/settings, invokes Pubsub and Storage, loads persisted data, replaces settings if present, and re-adds each saved item when items exist.
Cart initializes `_items` and default `_settings`, invokes `Pubsub.call` and `Storage.call`, then if `load()` returns data, applies saved settings and re-adds each saved item.
Initializes a Cart by resetting items/settings, invoking Pubsub and Storage with name/duration, loading persisted data, then applying loaded settings and re-adding each loaded item if present.
Initializes a Cart by invoking Pubsub and Storage with this, loading existing data, then iterating through all items to add each one; it returns nothing.
Decrements remaining attempts after a rejected promise; if none remain it throws the error, otherwise logs a retry message and recursively calls `retryPromise` with updated attempts and arguments.

onRejected decrements attemts_left, throws the received error if it drops below 1, otherwise logs remaining retries and returns module.exports.retryPromise.apply(undefined, [attemts_left, promiseFunction].concat(promiseFunctionArguments)).

Decrements `attemts_left`, throws `error` if it drops below 1, logs remaining retries, then returns `module.exports.retryPromise.apply(undefined, [attemts_left, promiseFunction].concat(promiseFunctionArguments))`.
Handles a failed retry by throwing the error if attempts_left is below 1; otherwise logs remaining retries and returns retryPromise called with attempts_left, promiseFunction, and arguments.
For commit or tag objects, it tries up to three added message newlines and all 30-minute timezone offsets to match a hash, applying matching offsets/message and returning true, else false.
For commit or tag objects only, it tries date offsets from -720 to 690 (three message variants), and returns true after updating value when hash matches, otherwise false/undefined.
fixDate returns early unless type is commit or tag, then tries date offsets -720..690 (step 30) across three message-newline passes, returning true on hash match, else false.
Returns undefined unless type is "commit" or "tag"; otherwise it clones value, tests timezone offsets from -720 to 690 in 30-minute steps, and returns true on hash match, else false.

GoogleLogin acts as a constructor/factory, returning a new instance when not called with `new`, and returns Promises resolving to `Auth` tokens or rejecting on login/oauth errors (special-casing 403).
Creates a GoogleLogin instance when not called with `new`, defines proxy/login helpers, and returns Promises resolving to auth tokens or rejecting on Google login/oauth errors (including 403).

GoogleLogin acts as a constructor/factory, returning a new instance when not called with `new`, and defines proxy/login methods that return Promises resolving to `Auth` or rejecting on errors (especially 403).
Creates a GoogleLogin instance, and if called without `new` (not an instance), it recursively calls and returns `GoogleLogin()`; otherwise it returns nothing.
Initializes a Random object by storing the provided seed and constants, then precomputes mq as floor(modulus/multiplier) and mr as modulus modulo multiplier.
Initializes a Random instance with the given seed, sets multiplier and modulus constants, and computes mq=floor(modulus/multiplier) and mr=modulus%multiplier, returning nothing.
Initializes a Random object by setting multiplier (16807), modulus (0x7fffffff), and seed, then computing mq=floor(modulus/multiplier) and mr=modulus%multiplier, returning nothing.
Initializes a random generator with the given seed and computes the floor of modulus divided by multiplier, without explicit conditions, asynchronous behavior, errors, or return value.
Calculates a human-readable relative time from a timestamp, returning undefined for invalid, future, or 31+ day differences, otherwise phrases from “just now” to “weeks ago.”
Computes elapsed time from a timestamp, returns undefined if day difference is NaN, negative, or ≥31, otherwise returns a relative string from “just now” to “weeks ago.”
Computes relative time from a timestamp, returning undefined if day difference is NaN, negative, or ≥31, otherwise phrases like “just now,” “minutes/hours/days/weeks ago,” or “Yesterday.”
Converts a timestamp to a relative date string, returning undefined if day difference is NaN, negative, or at least 31, otherwise “just now” through “weeks ago.”
Processes a socket’s requestQueue by returning early if absent, replaying only own queued entries via socket.request with original arguments, then clearing requestQueue by setting it to null.
runRequestQueue gets socket.requestQueue, returns immediately if absent, iterates own queue entries, calls socket.request.apply(socket, requestArgs) for each, then sets socket.requestQueue to null.
Processes `socket.requestQueue` if present by iterating its own properties, calling `socket.request.apply(socket, queue[i])` for each safe key, then sets `socket.requestQueue` to `null`.
Processes each own-property entry in `socket.requestQueue` by calling `socket.request` with its arguments, returning `undefined` immediately if `requestQueue` is missing.
Initializes options, immediately calls `cb()` if `window` is undefined, otherwise injects a script from `opts.url` and returns callback response via `window._sailsIoJSConnect` after cleanup.
Initializes opts, immediately calls cb and returns if window is undefined, otherwise injects a script with opts.url and sets window._sailsIoJSConnect to remove it and callback with response.
Initializes opts, returns cb() if window is undefined, otherwise injects a script from opts.url, defines window._sailsIoJSConnect to remove the script and invoke cb(response).
Initializes a JSONP request by immediately calling cb, then creating and appending a script element to head, but if window is undefined it just calls cb and returns.

Validates and converts a parameter value by type: parses integers/numbers with NaN checks, validates formatted date/date-time strings with moment, throws descriptive errors, otherwise returns the original value.
Validates and parses parameter values by type/format: parses integers or numbers (throwing on NaN), validates string date-time/date formats with moment, and returns parsed or original value.
Validates a parameter value by type/format: parses integers or numbers (throwing on NaN), validates string date-time/date formats with moment, and returns parsed numeric or original value.

Validates a parameter by parsing integers/numbers and checking date-time/date string formats, throwing descriptive errors on parse/format failures, and returning parsed numeric values or the original value.

Builds a kebab-cased yargs option from a parameter declaration, mapping integer to number and applying description/type/enum/default/required/conflicts, then coerces values via validateParameterValue, including per-item array validation.

Builds a yargs option from a parameter declaration, conditionally setting metadata (description, type, enum/default/required/conflicts), mapping integer to number, adding coercion validation, and returning nothing.

Builds a kebab-cased yargs option from a parameter declaration, conditionally setting metadata fields, then returns yargs.coerce validation for array items or single values via validateParameterValue.
Converts a parameter name to kebab-case, registers it as a yargs option, and adds coercion that validates either each array item or a single value, returning validated results.
Iterates over each own property in configDeclaration, applies parameterDeclarationToYargs to yargs with each parameter name and declaration, and returns the modified yargs object.
Iterates over each own property in configDeclaration, calls parameterDeclarationToYargs(yargs, parameterName, parameter) for each, and returns the updated yargs object.
configDeclarationToYargs iterates over each own property in configDeclaration with _.forOwn, calls parameterDeclarationToYargs(yargs, parameterName, parameter) for each entry, and returns yargs.
Iterates over each entry in configDeclaration, applies parameterDeclarationToYargs to add each parameter to yargs, and returns the updated yargs object.
Parses mapped input bytes into 24-bit n-grams, skipping repeated mapped spaces and zero mappings, counts n-gram hits via fixed-table search, and returns confidence capped at 98.

NGramParser initializes parser state and methods, binary-searches n-grams, skips repeated mapped spaces, counts hits/ngrams while parsing bytes, and returns 98 if hit ratio exceeds 0.33, else floor(ratio*300).

NGramParser initializes n-gram parsing state and methods, binary-searches n-grams, counts hits while skipping repeated spaces, and parse returns 98 if hit/ngram ratio exceeds 0.33, else floor(ratio*300).
NGramParser takes an n-gram list and a byte map as inputs, performs no explicit conditions or calls, and has no specified return value.
Collects a parent element’s children into scenarios and templates, storing elements without an .html src as templates, and returns an object containing scenarios and templates arrays.

collectScenariosFromElement iterates parentElement children, wrapping each in angular.element, and for each child stores media plus either src or template index depending on whether src exists and ends with .html, returning scenarios and templates arrays.
Iterating over parentElement.children, it builds scenarios and templates, checking whether each child’s src exists and ends with .html, then returns {scenarios, templates}.
Collects a parent element’s children into indexed scenarios and templates, checking each child’s src attribute for absence or non-.html match, and returns {scenarios, templates}.
Returns the requested attribute value, prioritizing node HTML for `translate` and attribute lookup otherwise, with fallback to the other source and finally an empty string.
extractValue(attr, node) checks whether attr equals 'translate' and returns node.html() or getAttr(attr) or '', otherwise returns getAttr(attr) or node.html() or ''.
extractValue(attr, node) returns node.html, getAttr(attr), or '' when attr is 'translate'; otherwise it returns getAttr(attr), node.html, or '' in that order.
Returns node HTML or the attribute value for a given attr, prioritizing HTML when attr is 'translate', otherwise prioritizing the attribute, and defaulting to an empty string.
Removes a listener from an object’s event, asserting object and event name exist, normalizing function-only arguments, removing one or all matching listeners, and returning nothing.

Removes listener(s) from an object’s event, asserting object and eventName exist, normalizing function-only arguments, deleting matching action triples, optionally calling didRemoveListener, and returning nothing.

Removes listener(s) from an object event, asserting obj and eventName exist, normalizing function target/method arguments, deleting matching action triples, optionally calling didRemoveListener, and returning undefined.
Removes listeners for an object event by asserting object and event name exist, returning undefined if no actions, and iterating backward to remove matching target/method listeners.

Temporarily suspends a matching event listener action on an object, normalizes function-only target/method arguments, executes callback with target context, then always unsuspends and returns Ember.tryFinally’s result.

Suspends a matching listener action during callback execution, normalizing function-only target/method inputs, toggling SUSPENDED when actionIndex !== -1, and returning Ember.tryFinally(callback.call(target), finalizer cleanup).

Suspends a matching listener action during callback execution by normalizing `method/target`, checking `actionIndex !== -1` to set/clear `SUSPENDED`, and returns `Ember.tryFinally(tryable, finalizer)`.
Temporarily suspends an event listener by finding its action index for the given target and method, executing a tryable block, then always running a finalizer via Ember.tryFinally.
If the object isn’t destroying, it initializes dependency-tracking state, invokes `iterDeps(propertyDidChange, obj, depKey, seen, meta)`, and then clears global tracking when this call is top-level.

Handles dependent-key changes by returning early if `obj.isDestroying`, initializing/resetting shared `DID_SEEN` tracking only at top level, invoking `iterDeps(propertyDidChange, obj, depKey, seen, meta)`, and returning nothing.

Handles dependent-key changes by returning early if `obj.isDestroying`, initializing/resetting shared `seen` tracking only at top level, invoking `iterDeps(propertyDidChange, obj, depKey, seen, meta)`, and otherwise returning nothing.
Handles dependent-key invalidation by returning undefined if the object is destroying; otherwise it iterates dependencies via iterDeps(propertyDidChange, obj, depKey, seen, meta) and returns nothing.

Sets a property value, asserting valid/global keys and non-destroyed objects, delegating dotted or missing-object paths to setPath, handling descriptors/unknown or watched properties, and returning the value.

Sets a property value, asserting valid/global path usage, key presence, and non-destroyed objects; delegates dotted/absent-object keys to setPath, otherwise updates descriptors/watchers/unknown properties, then returns value.
Sets a property value, handling string-path shorthand, assertions, path keys via setPath, descriptors/unknown properties, watched-property change notifications, and returns the assigned value.
Sets a property value on an object or path, asserting valid/global targets and non-destroyed objects, delegating dotted paths to setPath, and returning the assigned value.
Resolves all input promises, validates that `promises` is an array and `filterFn` is a function, then returns a promise for values whose corresponding filter results are truthy.
Filters an input promises array by resolving all values, validating promises is an array and filterFn is a function, then returning a promise of values passing filterFn.
Filters resolved promise values by an async predicate: validates promises is an array and filterFn is a function, throws TypeError otherwise, and returns a promise of filtered values.
Resolves all promises, validates that promises is an array and filterFn is a function, then maps filterFn over promises and returns a promise of values with truthy filter results.
Initializes a Container with a parent reference, children list, inherited resolver/default no-op resolver, fresh injection maps, and inheriting dictionaries for registries, caches, and options.
Initializes a Container with a parent and empty child/injection objects, using parent resolver if present (else no-op), and creating inheriting dictionaries from corresponding parent stores.

Constructs a Container with a parent, using parent-provided resolver/registries/caches/options when parent exists, otherwise defaults (empty function/object/array), and returns the initialized instance.
Creates a Container by initializing inheriting dictionaries from each corresponding parent property only when parent exists, and returns no explicit value.

Initializes a read-only, cacheable reduce computed property that asserts dependent keys and Ember.Array dependencies, recomputes observers/items for changed dependent arrays, and returns the instance meta’s reduced value.

Initializes a read-only, cacheable reduce computed property, asserting dependent keys/arrays, recomputing and updating array observers when dependencies change, and returning the instance meta’s computed value.

ReduceComputedProperty initializes computed-property state and hooks, asserts dependent arrays are Ember arrays and keys exist, conditionally recomputes/updates observers, and returns instance metadata’s getValue result.
Configures the current computed property as read-only and cacheable by invoking `readOnly()` and `cacheable()` on `this`, without explicitly returning a value.
Creates an ArrayOperation object by assigning the operation type (RETAIN, INSERT, or DELETE), count, and items to the instance and returns the initialized object instance.
ArrayOperation initializes an object by assigning the provided operation, count, and items arguments to this.type, this.count, and this.items, then returns the constructed instance implicitly.
Initializes an ArrayOperation object by assigning the provided operation, count, and items arguments to this.type, this.count, and this.items, returning no explicit value.
ArrayOperation takes operation, count, and items as inputs, performs no checks or calls, and has no specified return value.
Creates an ArrayOperationMatch object by assigning the provided operation, index, split, and rangeStart values to corresponding properties on this instance.
ArrayOperationMatch initializes an object by assigning the provided operation, index, split, and rangeStart arguments to corresponding this properties, returning the constructed instance implicitly.

ArrayOperationMatch initializes an object by assigning the provided operation, index, split, and rangeStart arguments to this.operation, this.index, this.split, and this.rangeStart, returning the instance.
ArrayOperationMatch takes operation, index, split, and rangeStart as inputs, performs no checks or calls, and has no specified return value.
Builds helper arguments by resolving bound hash options and ID-typed normalized properties via `Ember.Handlebars.get`, then appends `options` and returns `fn.apply(context, args)`.
Builds helper arguments by resolving own bound hash options and each normalized property (resolving `"ID"` types via `Ember.Handlebars.get`), appends options, then returns `fn.apply(context, args)`.

Builds arguments for `fn.apply(context, args)` by resolving own `boundOptions` and each normalized property (`ID` via `Handlebars.get`, otherwise path), appends `options`, and returns the call result.
Builds an argument list from normalized properties and bound options, checking own properties in loops, then invokes and returns `fn.apply(context, args)`.

Binds a property for template rendering by normalizing its path, choosing display/inverse templates via shouldDisplay/valueNormalizer, registering observers for property/children, or directly pushing escaped output for non-objects.

Binds a property for rendering by normalizing its path, choosing grouped/object or primitive handling, selecting fn/inverse via shouldDisplay (optionally normalized/preserved context), registering observers, and returning rendered output.

Binds a property for Handlebars rendering: if `this` is an object it sets up grouped or bound-view templates, observers (including child properties), otherwise pushes escaped property output to `data.buffer`.

Binds a property to a Handlebars view by normalizing paths, getting and normalizing values, checking display conditions, creating/appending a bound child view, registering observers (including child properties), and pushing escaped output.
Adds a didInsertElement hook to EachView that asserts the morph start and end elements share the same parent node, returning via Ember.assert’s pass/fail check.
Adds a didInsertElement hook to Ember.Handlebars.EachView that asserts morph start and end element IDs resolve to nodes sharing the same parentNode, returning the reopen result.
_addMetamorphCheck reopens Ember.Handlebars.EachView with a didInsertElement hook that asserts this.morph.start and this.morph.end elements have the same parentNode, returning the reopen call result.
Adds an EachView didInsertElement hook that asserts the start and end metamorph tags share the same parent node, warning about browser-corrected invalid HTML when they differ.

Converts an object into a property descriptor, validating object type, callable-or-undefined get/set, and disallowing mixed accessor/data fields, then returns the normalized descriptor or throws TypeError.
Converts an object into a property descriptor, validating object type, callable-or-undefined get/set, and disallowing mixed accessor/data fields, then returns the normalized descriptor object.
Converts an object into a validated property descriptor, checking object type, optional fields, callable get/set, and disallowing mixed accessor/data attributes, then returns the descriptor object.
Converts an object to a property descriptor, throwing TypeError if input isn’t an object, getter/setter aren’t callable or undefined, or data and accessor fields coexist, then returns {}.
Converts attributes to a property descriptor, then copies each non-standard attribute onto it as a writable, enumerable, configurable own property, and returns the descriptor.
Converts attributes to a property descriptor, then for each non-standard attribute name adds it to the descriptor as a writable, enumerable, configurable value property, and returns the descriptor.
Converts attributes to a property descriptor, adds each non-standard attribute as a writable, enumerable, configurable value property on it, and returns the resulting descriptor.

normalizePropertyDescriptor converts attributes to a property descriptor, then for each non-standard attribute in attributes defines it on desc as writable, enumerable, configurable data properties, and returns desc.

Determines whether a property descriptor update is valid, rejecting non-extensible additions and forbidden non-configurable changes, and otherwise returning true for empty, equivalent, generic, or allowed descriptor transitions.

Checks whether a property descriptor update is valid against extensibility/current descriptor rules, returning false on forbidden configurable/enumerable/writable/value/get/set changes, otherwise true.

Checks whether a proposed property descriptor is compatible with current/extensible state, rejecting forbidden configurable/enumerable/writable/value/get/set changes, and returns true if compatible, otherwise false.

Determines descriptor compatibility by checking extensibility, descriptor emptiness/equivalence, configurability/enumerability, descriptor type transitions, writable/value/get/set constraints, returning false on violations and true otherwise.
Creates a zero-argument method that, when called on a direct proxy, recursively invokes itself on the proxy target; otherwise it calls and returns the primitive on this.
Creates a zero-argument wrapper method that checks whether `this` maps to a direct proxy handler and returns `builtin.call(handler.target)` or otherwise `primitive.call(this)`.
`makeUnwrapping0ArgMethod` returns a wrapper that gets `this`’s handler from `directProxies`; if found, it calls `builtin` on `vHandler.target`, otherwise calls `primitive` on `this`.
Creates a zero-argument method that, when called, unwraps direct proxies via their handler target and invokes the primitive on that target or on this if unwrapped.
Assigns each own property from `obj` onto `global` if defined (otherwise `this`), iterating keys and copying values directly to that root object.
`load(obj)` selects `global` when defined and non-null (otherwise `this`), copies each own enumerable property from `obj` onto that root object, and returns nothing.
`load(obj)` selects `global` when defined and non-null (otherwise `this`), then copies each own enumerable property from `obj` onto that root object, returning nothing.
Iterates over an object’s enumerable properties, checks each with hasOwnProperty, and performs a dynamic operation involving typeof global without returning a value.
Adds unsaved related records to `data` by, when `record` exists, filtering `record.get(key)` for items with `isNew` and pushing them via `pushObjects`.
If record is truthy, it gets record.get(key), filters items where isNew is truthy, and pushes those objects into data using pushObjects; otherwise returns nothing.
addUnsavedRecords checks whether record is truthy, then pushes into data all items from record.get(key) filtered by the 'isNew' property, returning nothing explicitly.
Adds all newly created (`isNew`) records from `record.get(key)` to `data` by filtering and pushing them with `pushObjects`.
Recursively creates and returns a new object by copying each property, deep-cloning values that are truthy objects and directly assigning all other values.
deepClone iterates over an object's properties, recursively cloning each property when its value is truthy and typeof value is "object", otherwise copying it directly, and returns the clone.
deepClone iterates over each property of object, recursively cloning values when they are truthy and typeof value === 'object', otherwise copying them directly, and returns clone.
Recursively clones an input object by iterating its properties, deep-cloning each property value based on its type, and returns the resulting clone object.

Initializes an Inflector with provided or default rule sets, ensuring uncountable and irregular pairs exist, creating rule containers, loading uncountable and irregular mappings, and returning the instance.
Inflector initializes a rules object from ruleSet defaults, ensuring ruleSet, uncountable, and irregularPairs exist, then loads uncountable and irregular mappings into this.rules and returns nothing.

Initializes an Inflector rules object from ruleSet defaults, ensuring uncountable and irregularPairs exist, setting plural/singular arrays and empty maps, then loading uncountable and irregular rules.
Initializes inflection rules by loading uncountable words and irregular pairs from the provided rule set, without explicit conditions, asynchronous behavior, errors, or return value.

Parses an ampersand-separated key-value string into an object, decoding components, skipping undefined keys, assigning true for missing values, and aggregating repeated keys into arrays before returning the object.
Parses an '&'-separated key=value string, decoding keys/values when defined, defaulting missing values to true, aggregating repeated keys into arrays, and returns the resulting object.
Parses an '&'-separated key=value string, decoding defined keys/values, defaulting missing values to true, aggregating repeated keys into arrays, and returns the resulting object.
Parses a '&'-separated key-value string, decoding keys/values, ignoring empty or undefined keys, assigning true for missing values, aggregating duplicate keys into arrays, and returns the object.
Compiles each node by collecting/applying directives, recursively compiles children unless terminal or childless, and returns a composite linker when any node/child linker exists, otherwise null.

Compiles each node by collecting directives, applying them when present, recursively compiling nonterminal nodes with children, and returns a composite linker function if any link functions were found, else null.

Compiles each node by collecting/applying directives, recursively compiling children unless terminal or childless, tracks any link functions, and returns a composite linker function or null if none found.

Iterates through nodeList, collecting and applying directives per node with priority/ignore checks, recursively compiling child nodes with transclusion, storing link functions, and returning compositeLinkFn if any link exists, otherwise null.
Returns a wrapper link function that groups the initial element via `groupScan(element[0], attrStart, attrEnd)` and then calls `linkFn` with scope, grouped element, attrs, and controllers.
Creates a wrapper that, when invoked, replaces element with groupScan(element[0], attrStart, attrEnd) and returns linkFn(scope, element, attrs, controllers).
Creates and returns a wrapper link function that rescans element[0] with groupScan using attrStart and attrEnd, then invokes and returns linkFn(scope, element, attrs, controllers).
Returns a wrapper link function that groups elements between attrStart and attrEnd using groupScan, then invokes linkFn with scope, grouped element, attrs, and controllers.

Replaces the first removable element with `newNode`, updates `$rootElement` if it contains that element, replaces in the parent if present, removes remaining elements, and mutates `elementsToRemove` to `[newNode]`.
Replaces the first element in elementsToRemove with newNode, updates $rootElement if present and matching, replaces in parent if available, removes remaining elements, and returns nothing.
Replaces the first removable element with newNode, updates $rootElement if it contains that element, replaces in parent if present, moves/removes remaining elements, and returns nothing.

Replaces a contiguous sequence in `$rootElement` matching `elementsToRemove` by finding the first matching element, removing matched nodes into a fragment, and calling `parent.replaceChild(newNode, firstElementToRemove)`.
Parses an array declaration until `]`, collecting element expression functions, tracking whether all are constant, and returns an extended evaluator function producing the evaluated array.

Parses an array declaration by collecting element expression functions until ']', tracks whether all elements are constant, and returns an extended evaluator function with literal and constant metadata.

Parses an array declaration by collecting element expression functions until ']', tracking whether all elements are constant, and returns an extended evaluator producing the computed array with literal/constant flags.
Parses an array declaration by repeatedly reading comma-separated element expressions until ‘]’, then returns an extended literal function that evaluates each element and returns the resulting array.
Determines whether a URL is same-origin by parsing string inputs and returning true only when its protocol and host exactly match the current origin URL.
Checks whether a request URL is same-origin by resolving it when it is a string, then returning true only if its protocol and host equal originUrl’s.
`isSameOrigin` resolves `requestUrl` when it is a string (otherwise uses it directly), then returns whether both its `protocol` and `host` exactly match `originUrl`’s.
Determines whether a request URL is same-origin by resolving it and returning true only when its protocol and host exactly match originUrl’s protocol and host.
Recursively traverses a node and its collected child nodes, calling opt_onEnter before descending when provided, and opt_onLeave after visiting children when provided.
Recursively traverses a node tree by collecting child nodes, optionally calling opt_onEnter before visiting children and opt_onLeave after, and returns no explicit value.
Traverses a node tree recursively, optionally calling opt_onEnter before visiting collected child nodes and opt_onLeave afterward, and returns no explicit value.
Traverses a node tree recursively, calling opt_onEnter on each node before visiting collected child nodes and calling opt_onLeave on each node afterward.
Initializes a Client by logging creation, setting type to 'client', generating a UUID id, setting browser based on WebSocket.Server undefined, and invoking Base constructor.
Creates a Client by logging creation, setting `this.type` to `'client'`, assigning `this.id = uuid()`, setting `this.browser` based on `WebSocket.Server === undefined`, and calling `Base.call(this)`.
Client logs creation, sets this.type to 'client', assigns this.id from uuid(), sets this.browser to whether WebSocket.Server is undefined, and calls Base.call(this), returning nothing.
Initializes a Client instance by logging “new Client”, generating a UUID, and invoking Base.call(this), with no input parameters or explicit return value.

Creates a Connection with unique id, socket, parent, and responseHandlers, then binds browser-specific message/close/error handlers if parent.browser is truthy, otherwise Node-style message/close/error listeners.

Initializes a Connection by logging parent type, assigning id/socket/parent/responseHandlers, then if parent.browser sets socket onmessage/onclose/onerror handlers, otherwise registers message and one-time close/error listeners.

Creates a Connection by logging parent.type, assigning id/socket/parent/responseHandlers, then if parent.browser exists sets socket onmessage/onclose/onerror handlers, otherwise registers message, close, and error listeners via on/once.
Initializes a Connection by logging the parent type, generating a UUID, binding message/close/error handlers, and registering socket listeners for message, close, and error events.
Creates a mark-constructor that builds a mark from provided attributes, flattens arguments, applies the mark to nodes not already containing it, and returns flattened nodes with tag metadata.
Creates a mark-builder that applies `type.create(takeAttrs(attrs,args))`, flattens args, adds the mark only when not already in each node’s marks, and returns `{flat: nodes, tag}`.
Creates a mark-applier function that builds a mark from attrs/args, flattens args, adds the mark only to nodes lacking that mark type, and returns `{flat: nodes, tag}`.
Returns a function that creates a mark from `type` and extracted attributes, flattens schema arguments, applies the mark to nodes lacking it, and returns `{flat, tag}`.

Creates and returns a promise for a legacy socket request, applying optional timeout handling, normalizing response fields, and resolving on non-error status or rejecting when status is outside 200–399.

Creates a deferred socket request from config, optionally logs/debugs, handles numeric or promise-like timeout cancellation, normalizes response/jwr fields, and returns a promise resolved on success or rejected on error.

Sends a legacy socket request using config method/url/data, optionally logs debug info, applies numeric or promise-like timeout cancellation, normalizes response/error status, and returns a deferred promise.

Creates a deferred promise, logs the request, schedules timeoutRequest via $timeout and optionally config.timeout.then when timeout is promise-like, invokes socket legacy method, and returns defer.promise.
Reads a file, finds `bootstrap(...)` to extract a component reference, matches corresponding `import { ... } from '...'` patterns, and returns `{name, path}` or `null` if unmatched.
Reads a file, extracts the bootstrap(...) component reference, searches matching import patterns, and returns `{name, path}` from regex captures, or `null` if bootstrap/import parsing fails.

Reads a file, extracts the bootstrap component reference, regex-matches its import (including spaced/aliased variants), and returns `{name,path}` from match groups or `null` when markers/matches are missing.
Reads a file to locate a `bootstrap(` call and comma; if either index is missing returns null, otherwise regex-searches data and returns `result(r)` only when `r` exists with length > 1.

fixTsConfig loads ../../tsconfig.json if present, initializes compilerOptions when missing typeRoots, ensures exclude contains node_modules and platforms, then writes the formatted JSON back to the file.
Loads ../../tsconfig.json if present, ensures compilerOptions/typeRoots and exclude exist, adds missing node_modules and platforms exclusions, then writes and returns the updated tsConfig object.

Loads ../../tsconfig.json if present, ensures compilerOptions/typeRoots exist with defaults, initializes exclude, adds missing node_modules and platforms exclusions, then writes the updated JSON to disk.
fixTsConfig checks whether tsFile exists, loads its config, adds missing 'node_modules' and 'platforms' entries to exclude, then writes the updated JSON back to tsFile.
Checks whether `../../references.d.ts` exists and already references `typescript/lib/lib.d.ts`; if not, writes two TypeScript reference paths to that file, otherwise leaves it unchanged.
`fixRefFile` reads `../../references.d.ts` if it exists, and if it lacks `typescript/lib/lib.d.ts`, writes two reference-path lines to that file, returning nothing.
fixRefFile checks whether ../../references.d.ts exists, reads it, and if it lacks 'typescript/lib/lib.d.ts', writes two reference-path lines to that file in UTF-8.
Checks whether `refFile` exists, reads its contents, looks for `'typescript/lib/lib.d.ts'`, and writes `fix` to `refFile` in UTF-8; it returns nothing.
Loads ../../package.json if it exists, otherwise logs an error and returns; then sets NativeScript iOS/Android versions and required devDependencies, and writes the updated JSON file.
Loads ../../package.json if it exists, otherwise logs a missing-file message and returns; then sets NativeScript metadata/devDependencies and writes the updated JSON back to disk.
Loads ../../package.json if it exists, otherwise logs an error and returns; then sets NativeScript metadata and required devDependencies, and writes the updated JSON back to disk.
Checks if packageFile exists; if not, returns undefined; otherwise requires packageFile, logs a missing package.json warning, and rewrites packageFile with formatted JSON content.
Checks for ../../../package.json, logs an error and returns if missing; otherwise ensures scripts exists, adds NativeScript iOS/Android start and livesync commands, and writes updated JSON back.

fixAngularPackage checks whether ../../../package.json exists, logs and returns early if missing, ensures packageJSON.scripts exists, adds four NativeScript start scripts, and writes updated JSON to disk.

fixAngularPackage loads ../../../package.json if it exists, otherwise logs an error and returns; ensures packageJSON.scripts exists, sets four NativeScript start scripts, then writes formatted JSON back.
Checks if `packageFile` exists; if not, returns undefined, otherwise loads it, logs a warning about a missing main `package.json`, and rewrites the file with formatted JSON.
Checks whether ../../app/main.ts exists and lacks “MagicService”; if so, overwrites it with a predefined NativeScript Angular bootstrap module, otherwise leaves it unchanged.
Checks whether ../../app/main.ts exists, reads it, and if it lacks “MagicService,” overwrites it with a predefined NativeScript Angular bootstrap template; returns nothing.
fixMainFile reads ../../app/main.ts if it exists, and if its content lacks “MagicService”, writes a predefined AppComponentModule bootstrap template to that file; it returns nothing.
Checks if `mainFile` exists, reads its contents, looks for `'MagicService'`, and writes `fix` to `mainFile` in UTF-8; it has no explicit return value.
`fixGitIgnore` reads `../../../.gitignore` if it exists, checks whether `ignorePattern` is absent, and if so appends it with a newline and writes the file.
Reads ../../../.gitignore if it exists, checks whether ignorePattern is absent (indexOf === -1), appends a newline plus ignorePattern, and writes the updated content back.
fixGitIgnore reads ../../../.gitignore if it exists, checks whether ignorePattern is absent (indexOf === -1), and appends it with a newline; otherwise it returns nothing.
Checks if the ignore file exists, reads its contents, and if the given ignore pattern’s index is evaluated, writes an updated UTF-8 ignore file with fix content.
Displays final NativeScript help by logging welcome text, a usage-guide URL, and iOS/Android run command options to the console, then returns nothing.
displayFinalHelp logs a formatted NativeScript welcome/help message with setup guide and iOS/Android run commands, performs no conditional checks, and returns undefined.
displayFinalHelp logs a formatted NativeScript help message with usage-guide and iOS/Android run-command instructions, performs no conditional checks, and returns undefined.
Displays final NativeScript help by logging usage-guide and iOS/Android run-command instructions to the console, with no conditions checked and no return value.
Validates input as TileJSON by accepting an object directly or parsing a JSON string, returning false for non-object/non-string or parse errors, otherwise returning validation result.
Validates input by accepting an object directly or parsing a string with jsonlint.parse, returning false for non-object/non-string or parse errors, otherwise tilejsonValidateObject.validate(tj).
`validate` accepts `str`, uses it directly if `typeof str === 'object'`, parses it with `jsonlint.parse` if a string, otherwise returns false, then returns `tilejsonValidateObject.validate(tj)`.
Validates a string by parsing it as JSON and running tilejsonValidateObject.validate on the result, returning false if input isn’t a string or parsing/validation throws.
For an association name, it resolves the class, clears model[name] to null and returns "continue" if no data, otherwise loads/localizes hasOne or maps hasMany entries.

Processes one association name by resolving its class and associated data, setting model[_name] to null when missing, or to loaded/local hasOne object or hasMany array, returning "continue" only when missing data.

For association `_name`, it resolves `klass`, reads `associated[_name]`, sets `model[_name]=null` and returns `"continue"` if missing, otherwise maps `hasOne`/`hasMany` data via `klass.load` or `klass.local`.
If associated[_name] is missing it returns "continue"; otherwise it resolves the class and processes associated[_name] via load/local, iterating arrays to push transformed items into others.
Creates and throws a new Error prefixed with “GraphQL Error:” using the first error’s message, attaching the original errors array and data as rawError and rawData.
Creates and throws an `Error` with the first `errors[0].message` prefixed by “GraphQL Error:”, attaching the original `errors` and `data` as `rawError` and `rawData`.
Creates and throws an `Error` with the first `errors[0].message` prefixed by “GraphQL Error:”, attaching `errors` as `rawError` and `data` as `rawData`.
Creates and throws a new `Error` with the first GraphQL error message (`errors[0].message`) prefixed by “GraphQL Error:”, and does not return a value.

Creates a ZIP file from source paths, adding files directly and directories/symlinks under dstPath (or false if missing), and returns a Promise resolving on close or rejecting on errors/invalid paths.

Creates a ZIP at zipFile from srcList, defaulting dstPath to false, adding files directly and directories/symlinks via archive.directory, and returns a Promise resolving on close or rejecting on errors/invalid paths.
Creates a ZIP at zipFile from srcList, defaulting missing dstPath to false, adding files or directories/symlinks, rejecting invalid paths/errors, and returning a Promise resolved on output close.
Creates a level-9 ZIP at zipFile from srcList, adding files directly and directories/symlinks under dstPath, resolving on output close and rejecting on non-ENOENT warnings, errors, or invalid paths.
Executes a shell command synchronously, defaults verbose to true unless explicitly false, logs stdout as a string when verbose, and returns the command’s stdout buffer.
Executes `cmd` synchronously via `execSync`, defaults `verbose` to true unless explicitly false, logs `stdout.toString()` when verbose, and returns the resulting `stdout`.
Executes cmd with execSync, defaults verbose to true unless explicitly false, logs stdout.toString() when verbose is truthy, and returns the stdout value.
Executes the given command synchronously, logs its stdout as a string, and returns the stdout buffer, regardless of the verbose parameter.
Attempts to lstat a path, reads and returns UTF-8 content if it is a file, ignores ENOENT/name-too-long lstat errors, otherwise rethrows, and returns the input path.
Reads a path’s UTF-8 contents if lstatSync says it is a file; on errors, rethrows unless message includes ENOENT or “name too long, lstat”, otherwise returns input path.
`fileToString` lstat-checks a path, reads and returns UTF-8 file contents if it is a file, rethrows non-ENOENT/non-“name too long, lstat” errors, otherwise returns the input path.
`fileToString` returns a file’s UTF-8 string content if `lstatSync` confirms it is a file; on caught `ENOENT`/“name too long, lstat” errors it returns `file`, otherwise rethrows.
Loads two YAML files using YAML_FILES_SCHEMA, merges their parsed objects into a new object with later values overriding earlier ones, and returns the merged YAML string.
mergeYamls reads file1 and file2, safely loads each YAML using YAML_FILES_SCHEMA, merges obj1 and obj2 into a new object, and returns the merged object as YAML text.
mergeYamls reads two files, safely loads each YAML using YAML_FILES_SCHEMA, merges obj1 and obj2 into a new object, and returns the merged object as YAML text.
Loads two YAML files using YAML_FILES_SCHEMA, merges their parsed objects into a new object, and returns the merged result serialized back to YAML.
Resolves and requires a Kes override module path, rethrowing errors if the file exists but fails to load, logging when absent, and returning the loaded module or undefined.
Resolves an override module path from `kesFolder` and `kesClass` (default `'kes.js'`), requires it, rethrows load errors if the file exists, logs if missing, and returns `KesOverride`.
loadKesOverride resolves a path from kesFolder and kesClass, requires it, rethrows errors if the file exists, logs if missing, and returns the loaded module or undefined.
Resolves the override path from `kesFolder` and `kesClass`, requires and returns `KesOverride`, and if an error occurs while checking existence, logs that no override was found.
Determines which Kes class to use by checking options.kesClass, then options.kesFolder or .kes, then template folder for overrides, returning the first loaded override or default Kes.
Determines a KES class override by checking options.kesClass, then options.kesFolder or cwd/.kes, then cwd/template if needed, and returns the override or the default Kes.
Determines a KES class by checking options.kesClass, then options.kesFolder or cwd/.kes, then cwd/template when no override exists, returning KesOverride or fallback Kes.
Determines a KES class by checking overrides from `options.kesClass`, then `.kes`, then `options.template` (defaulting to `/path/to/nowhere`), and returns the found override or `Kes`.
Logs `e.message` if present, otherwise logs `e`, then terminates the process with exit code 1.
The `failure(e)` function logs `e.message` if present, otherwise logs `e`, then calls `process.exit(1)`, terminating the process with exit code 1.
`failure(e)` logs `e.message` if present, otherwise logs `e`, then calls `process.exit(1)`, terminating the process without returning a value.
Logs the error’s message and the full error object, then terminates the process with exit code 1.
Returns the first valid string bucket from `config.buckets.internal` or `config.system_bucket`, checking each exists and is a string, otherwise returns `undefined`.
Retrieves `buckets.internal` from `config`, returning it if it exists and is a string; otherwise checks `system_bucket` with the same condition, else returns `undefined`.
Returns `config`’s `buckets.internal` if it exists and is a string; otherwise checks `system_bucket` with the same condition, returning that string or `undefined`.
Returns `config.system_bucket` if it exists and is a string; otherwise returns `config.buckets.internal` if it exists and is a string, else `undefined`.

buildNestedCfs sequentially processes config.nested_templates, creating nested configs with parent stack/bucket and removed template/deployment, uploads each nested CF to set its URL, and returns a Promise resolving config or failure.

Builds nested CloudFormation templates when `config.nested_templates` exists, sequentially uploads each via `KesClass`, sets each nested template URL, and returns a promise resolving to `config` or failure.

buildNestedCfs checks for config.nested_templates, then serially builds and uploads each nested template, setting defaults like bucket when missing, and returns updated config or Promise.resolve(config).

Builds nested CloudFormation templates when `config.nested_templates` exists, compiling each with limited concurrency, setting bucket/metadata, uploading via `KesClass`, updating template URLs, and returning resolved `config` or failure-handled promise.

buildCf determines a Kes class, creates Config (rejecting on constructor errors), builds nested configs, then executes the matching cmd action on Kes, warning for deprecated create/update/upsert, otherwise logging invalid choices.

buildCf determines a Kes class, rejects if Config(options) throws, then builds nested configs and executes a cmd-specific kes action (with deprecation warnings for create/update/upsert), returning that result.

buildCf determines KesClass, rejects with caught Config(options) construction errors, then builds nested config and executes cmd-specific kes stack/template actions (with deprecation warnings for create/update/upsert).
buildCf resolves config and a Kes class, then executes the cmd-specific stack action (with deprecation warnings for create/update/upsert), logging invalid commands and rejecting on errors.
buildLambda checks for a provided cmd, then creates and configures a Kes instance to run updateSingleLambda(cmd), reporting success or failure; otherwise it reports “Lambda name is missing.”

buildLambda checks whether cmd exists; if so, it builds config and Kes instances, updates one lambda, and returns utils.success(result) or utils.failure(error), otherwise utils.failure(Error("Lambda name is missing")).

buildLambda checks whether cmd exists; if so, it builds config and kes instances, updates one lambda, and returns utils.success(result) or utils.failure(error), otherwise utils.failure(Error("Lambda name is missing")).
Creates a Kes instance from options and cmd, invokes updateSingleLambda(cmd), returning success or failure via handlers, and triggers failure with “Lambda name is missing” when applicable.
Builds a CloudFormation-style JSON response from event/context data, sends it via HTTPS PUT to event.ResponseURL, logs status/headers or errors, and always calls context.done().
Builds a CloudFormation-style JSON response from event/context data, logs it, PUTs it to event.ResponseURL via HTTPS, and calls context.done on success or request error.
sendResponse builds and logs a CloudFormation-style JSON response, parses event.ResponseURL, sends it via HTTPS PUT with content-length headers, and calls context.done on response or error.

Validates a string entity name and thenable promise, validates options, initializes entity lifecycle, and returns a thunk that wires dispatch/state, triggers load, and resolves/rejects via lifecycle handlers.
Creates and returns a shallow copy of the action object with each key from keys assigned to the corresponding value at the same index in values.

generateAction clones the action object, iterates through keys with their indexes, assigns each corresponding values[index] to generatedAction[keys[index]], and returns the resulting generatedAction object.
generateAction clones action into generatedAction, iterates keys with forEach, assigns generatedAction[keys[index]] = values[index] for each index, and returns the updated generatedAction object.
Creates and returns a shallow copy of `action`, then assigns each `keys[index]` property on it to the corresponding `values[index]` using `forEach`.
Generates a random number between min (inclusive) and max (exclusive), then returns it as a string rounded to roundTo decimal places using toFixed.
Returns a Number rounded to `roundTo` decimals by generating `Math.random() * (max - min) + min`, i.e., a random delay between `min` and `max`.
