Async `getIdent` validates `meta.ident`, `identOptions.type`, service existence, and prepared ident params, returning corresponding errors or `prepareResponse(response, payload, propKeys)` after a GET `service.send` call.

getIdent validates meta.ident, authentication type, service availability, and prepared ident params, returning corresponding noaction/unknown-service errors or the prepared response from an awaited service GET request.

Creates and returns an Integreat instance (version, schemas, services, identType, dispatch, on, typeFromPlural), throwing if services or schemas are missing and building auth/service/schema mappings from definitions.

Creates an integration object from schemas and services, throwing a TypeError if either is missing, then returns versioned schemas/services, dispatch, identType, and helper methods on and typeFromPlural.

integreat validates that services and schemas are provided, builds indexed schemas/services and auth/plural mappings with defaults, then returns configuration including dispatch, identType, event subscription, and plural-to-type lookup.

Builds indexed schemas, plural-to-type lookup, auth configs, and services from definitions; throws if services or schemas are missing; returns versioned API with dispatch, event subscription, and plural resolution.
Converts a schedule definition into an action object, returning null when input is missing, and otherwise adding meta with id, parsed schedule, and queue as next time timestamp or true.

Returns null if def is falsy; otherwise derives id, parses def.schedule, computes nextSchedule(schedule,true), and returns def.action merged with meta {id, schedule, queue: nextTime.getTime() or true}.
Converts a definition into an action object: returns null if def is falsy, otherwise parses def.schedule, computes nextSchedule(schedule,true), and returns def.action with meta {id,schedule,queue}.
Returns null if def is missing; otherwise parses def.schedule, computes next schedule time, and returns def.action with meta containing id, schedule, and queue timestamp or true.

Asynchronously resolves a service from action payload, returns an unknown-service error if missing, fetches individual items for ID arrays without collection endpoints, otherwise sends GET and returns response.

Async `get(action,{getService})` extracts payload fields, resolves service via `getService` function, returns unknown-service error if missing, handles array IDs without collection endpoint via `getIndividualItems`, otherwise returns `service.send(...).response`.

Async `get` extracts payload fields, resolves a service via `getService`, returns unknown-service or individual-items results for missing service/array-id-without-collection, otherwise sends the action and returns `response`.

Asynchronously fetches data by resolving a service and ID from the action, returning unknown-service errors or individual-item results for array IDs without collection endpoints, otherwise returning the service response.
Creates an async handler that returns an existing response if present; otherwise sends the request via adapter and returns response with request access, or an error message on failure.

sendRequest returns an async handler that returns existing response if present; otherwise awaits adapter.send(request, connection), returns response with request.access, or createError on failure including serviceId.

sendRequest returns an async handler that immediately returns existing response, otherwise awaits adapter.send(request, connection) and returns response with request.access, or createError including serviceId and error on failure.

Returns an async handler that immediately returns an existing response, otherwise sends the request via adapter with connection and returns the response plus request.access, or a service-specific error.

Creates and returns a schema object with expanded/defaulted attributes and relationships, plural fallback `${id}s`, and methods to cast data (optionally only mapped values) and relationship query parameters.

Builds a schema object by expanding provided or empty attribute/relationship definitions, defaulting internal to false and plural to `${id}s`, and returns metadata plus cast and query-param casting methods.
Builds and returns a schema object by expanding provided or empty attribute/relationship definitions, adding default fields/plural/internal values, and exposing cast and castQueryParams helpers.

Creates and returns a schema object with expanded attributes/relationships, defaults plural to `${id}s`, builds casting/default handlers, and exposes `cast` and `castQueryParams` methods using mapped values and relationships.

Creates a mapping factory that builds pipelines from filters/transformers/schemas/mapping definitions, returns null when no pipeline exists, otherwise returns id/type/schema with fromService and toService mapping methods.
Creates a mapping factory that builds id-keyed mappings, generates pipelines, returns null when no pipeline exists, or returns mapper metadata with fromService/toService transformation methods.
Creates a mapping factory that builds pipelines from definitions, returns null when no pipeline exists, and otherwise returns id/type/schema with fromService and toService transformation methods.
Creates a mapping factory that indexes definitions by id, builds a pipeline, returns null if no pipeline, otherwise returns mapper metadata with fromService/toService data transformation methods.

Creates a mapper that returns early for non-ok or unmapped responses, maps endpoint data by requested/default types, and returns updated status/error/paging/params with flattened mapped data or undefined.
mapFromService returns a mapper that bypasses mapping when response/status isn’t 'ok' or unmapped is true, otherwise maps data by request type and returns merged response metadata.
Returns a mapper that, unless response/status or request params indicate early exit, maps endpoint response data by type mappings and returns a rebuilt response with mapped flattened data.
Returns a handler that, unless response status is non-ok or unmapped is true, maps response data by requested type(s), propagates paging/params, and returns transformed or error-adjusted response.
Converts pipeline to an array, replaces string entries with matching collection values, filters to truthy functions or objects, and returns the resulting transformed pipeline array.
preparePipeline prepends an empty array to pipeline, replaces string items with collection[key] (otherwise keeps items), then returns only truthy entries whose type is function or object.
preparePipeline clones pipeline, maps each item to collection[key] when key is a string (otherwise unchanged), then filters truthy values whose type is function or object, returning the result.
Converts the input pipeline to an array, applies replaceWithFunction to each element, filters results with isFunctionOrObject, and returns the transformed, filtered pipeline array.
Builds a query-parameter object for a relationship by mapping configured query keys to data fields, returning {} when no query exists and throwing if any mapped value is undefined.
`castQueryParams` gets `relationships[relId]`, returns `{}` if it has no `query`, otherwise builds and returns query params from `data`, throwing `TypeError` when any required value is `undefined`.
Returns an object of cast query params for a relationship by relId, returning {} if no relationship.query exists, and throwing TypeError if any required value is undefined.
Returns an object of query parameters for a relationship by mapping configured query keys to data fields, returning {} if no query exists, and throwing TypeError on missing values.
Creates a queue controller exposing the queue, subscribing it once when setDispatch receives a function, and returning middleware and async schedule wrappers that delegate to queue-based handlers.
Creates and returns a queue wrapper object exposing queue, setDispatch, middleware, and schedule; setDispatch subscribes once only when not subscribed and dispatch is a function.

setupQueue initializes dispatch and subscription state, and returns an object exposing queue, setDispatch (subscribes once when unsubscribed and dispatch is a function), middleware(next), and async schedule(defs).
Initializes a queue by subscribing dispatch, invoking middleware and schedule with the queue, and returns the queue plus methods to set dispatch, wrap middleware, and schedule tasks.
Gets metadata for a specified service by validating service existence and metadata support, querying the meta service, and returning transformed metadata on success or an error/response otherwise.
Async `getMeta` resolves a service and its metadata service, returns `createError` if either is missing, otherwise fetches metadata and returns transformed data on `'ok'` status or raw response.

Asynchronously fetches service metadata by validating service and meta-service existence, requesting meta keys via metaService.send, and returning transformed data on `response.status==='ok'`, otherwise the raw response.
Retrieves metadata for a service by ID, returning errors if the service is missing or lacks metadata support, and returns either enriched successful response data or the original response.

Processes a SET action by extracting type/id, validating the target service exists, sending the augmented action (including onlyMappedValues), and returning merged response plus authorized request data.
Async `set` logs a SET action, extracts type/id, resolves service, returns an unknown-service error if missing, otherwise sends augmented action and returns merged response/request data.
Async `set` extracts payload fields, type, and id, gets a service, returns an unknown-service error if missing, otherwise sends augmented action and returns merged response/request data.
Logs a SET action, extracts type and id, returns an unknown-service error if no service exists, otherwise sends the augmented action and returns merged response/request data.
Sets metadata for a specified service by validating the service exists and supports metadata, then sending a SET request with metadata keys and returning the response or error/noaction.

Asynchronously sets service metadata by validating service existence and metadata support, then sending a SET request with mapped payload data, returning createError, {status:'noaction'}, or the send response.

Async `setMeta` logs, validates target service existence and metadata support via `getService`, returns `createError` or `{status:'noaction'}` on failures, otherwise sends mapped metadata and returns response.

Sets metadata by resolving a service and its metadata service, returning an error if the service is missing, noaction if metadata is unsupported, otherwise awaiting and returning metaService.send response.
Exports each namespace in expSpecifications to JSON Schema, ensuring baseTypeURL ends with “#” or “/”, using flat or regular conversion based on flat, and returns schemas keyed by schemaId.
Exports each namespace in expSpecifications to JSON Schema, appending “/” to baseTypeURL unless it ends with “#” or “/”, using flat/non-flat conversion, and returns schemaId-keyed results.
Exports each namespace in expSpecifications.namespaces.all to JSON Schema, ensuring baseTypeURL ends with “#” or “/” (appending “/” otherwise), and returns a schemaId-keyed results object.
Iterates through all namespaces, logs export progress, chooses flatNamespaceToSchema or namespaceToSchema based on the flat flag, and returns an object mapping schemaId/schema results.
Returns a local `#/definitions/{name}` reference when `id.namespace` matches `enclosingNamespace.namespace`; otherwise returns the URL from `makeShrDefinitionURL(id, baseSchemaURL)`.
Returns `#/definitions/` plus `id.name` when `id.namespace` equals `enclosingNamespace.namespace`; otherwise returns `makeShrDefinitionURL(id, baseSchemaURL)`.
makeRef returns '#/definitions/' plus id.name when id.namespace equals enclosingNamespace.namespace; otherwise it returns makeShrDefinitionURL(id, baseSchemaURL).
Returns a local `#/definitions/{name}` reference when `id.namespace` matches `enclosingNamespace.namespace`; otherwise returns `makeShrDefinitionURL(id, baseSchemaURL)`.
Returns true if `value.card.isList` is true or any `isList` flag in `value.constraintsFilter.own.card.constraints` is true; otherwise returns false.
Returns true if `value.card.isList` is true; otherwise checks `value.constraintsFilter.own.card.constraints` and returns whether any constraint has `isList` true.
Checks whether `value` is or was a list by returning true if `value.card.isList` is truthy, otherwise returning whether any `value.constraintsFilter.own.card.constraints` item has `isList`.
Returns true if `value.card.isList` is true or if any constraint in `value.constraintsFilter.own.card.constraints` has `isList` true; otherwise returns false.
Finds and returns the first choice.aggregateOptions entry whose identifier equals optionId or has optionId as a base type via checkHasBaseType(dataElementSpecs); otherwise returns null.

findOptionInChoice iterates choice.aggregateOptions, returning the first option whose identifier equals optionId or matches via checkHasBaseType(optionId, option.identifier, dataElementSpecs), otherwise null.

findOptionInChoice scans choice.aggregateOptions, returning the first option whose identifier equals optionId or matches via checkHasBaseType(optionId, option.identifier, dataElementSpecs), otherwise null.
findOptionInChoice scans choice.aggregateOptions, first returning the option whose identifier equals optionId, then one matching via checkHasBaseType with dataElementSpecs, or null if none match.
Returns true if the identifier or its element value/choice option is Code or has base type shr.core.Coding/CodeableConcept; otherwise returns false.
Determines whether an identifier supports code constraints by checking if it or its identifiable/choice value types are CODE, Coding-based, or CodeableConcept-based, returning true or false.
Returns true if an identifier or its element/value (including identifiable or choice options) equals CODE or has base type shr.core.Coding/CodeableConcept; otherwise returns false.
Returns true if the identifier, its identifiable value, or any aggregate option is Code/Coding/CodeableConcept (directly or via base type); otherwise returns false.
This async function validates service, endpoint, and type in payload, returning specific errors if missing; otherwise it fetches expired items and returns the deleteExpired result.

Async `expire` validates `payload.service`, `payload.endpoint`, and `payload.type`, returning `createError` on missing values; otherwise it awaits `getExpired(payload, ident, dispatch)` and returns `deleteExpired(response, service, ident, dispatch)`.

Async `expire` validates `payload.service`, `payload.endpoint`, and `payload.type`, returning `createError` messages if missing; otherwise it awaits `getExpired(payload, ident, dispatch)` and returns `deleteExpired(response, service, ident, dispatch)`.

Validates service, payload.endpoint, and payload.type, returning createError messages if missing; otherwise awaits getExpired(payload, ident, dispatch) and returns deleteExpired(response, service, ident, dispatch).
Splits a colon-delimited range, transforms start and end anchors through each operation with start/end flags, and returns the single anchor if equal, otherwise “start:end”.
transformRange splits a colon-delimited range, transforms start and end through each op via transformRangeAnchor (true for start, false for end), and returns start or “start:end” if different.
Transforms a colon-delimited range by applying each op to start and end via transformRangeAnchor (true/false flags), returning start alone if equal, otherwise "start:end".
Transforms a colon-delimited range by returning start unchanged when start equals end; otherwise applies each operation to start and end anchors and returns "start:end".
transformRangeAnchor adjusts a cell anchor for inserted/deleted columns or rows, shifting when operations occur before it (or at it for non-start deletions), otherwise returning the original target.

Transforms a range anchor cell reference for insert/delete row/column operations by shifting when the operation index is before/at it, with end anchors adjusted on equality, otherwise returning target.

Transforms a cell-range anchor string for Insert/Delete Col/Row operations by shifting when operation indices precede/equal its column/row (with end-anchor delete equality checks), otherwise returns target unchanged.
Transforms a cell anchor string by adjusting its column or row based on parsed op fields and isStart comparisons, otherwise returning the original target unchanged.
Returns a matcher function that finds and returns the first endpoint whose id, type, scope, action, params, and filters all match the given type, payload, and meta.

`matchEndpoint(endpoints)` returns a function that finds and returns the first endpoint where matchId, matchType, matchScope, matchAction, matchParams, and matchFilters all pass for `{type, payload, meta}`.

`matchEndpoint` takes `endpoints` and returns a matcher that finds and returns the first endpoint passing `matchId`, `matchType`, `matchScope`, `matchAction`, `matchParams`, and `matchFilters` checks.
Returns a function that finds and returns the first endpoint matching id, type, scope, action, params, and filters against the provided type, payload, and meta.
Creates and returns an action object with type and payload, adds meta only when provided, and returns null if type is missing or falsy.
Creates an action object with type and payload (defaulting to {}), returns null if type is falsy, conditionally adds meta when provided, and returns the action.
Creates an action object with type and payload (default {}), returns null if type is falsy, conditionally adds meta when provided, and returns the action.
Creates an action object with `type` and `payload` (default `{}`), returning `null` if `type` is falsy; `meta` is accepted as a parameter but not used.

Creates a request authorizer that grants root identities or requests without params.type, otherwise computes scheme by type/action, evaluates authentication, and returns authItemsAndWrap with status, ident, and scheme.

authorizeRequest returns a request handler that grants immediately for root ident or missing params.type, otherwise resolves scheme, runs doAuth, and returns authItemsAndWrap with status, ident, and scheme.

`authorizeRequest({schemas})` returns a request handler that grants root ident/root scheme or missing params.type, otherwise computes scheme, runs auth if available, and returns wrapped status/ident/scheme.

Returns a request authorizer that grants root identities or missing `params.type`, otherwise derives a scheme from schema/action, evaluates authentication, and returns wrapped authorization status, identity, and scheme.
Builds and returns a request object from an action and options by extracting payload data/params, meta ident, computing typePlural from params.type and schemas, and endpoint options or null.

Builds a request object from action input, defaulting meta/schemas, deriving typePlural from params.type, and returning action, params, data, endpoint.options-or-null, access.ident, and meta.typePlural.
Builds a request object from action payload/meta and options, deriving typePlural, setting endpoint to endpoint.options or null, and returning action, params, data, access.ident, and meta.typePlural.

Builds and returns a request object from action input and optional endpoint/schemas, deriving `typePlural` via `getPluralType(params.type, schemas)` and setting `endpoint.options` or `null` plus access/meta fields.
Creates a resolver that, given a type and optional service, uses the schema’s default service when missing and returns the matching service object or null.
`getService(schemas, services)` returns a function that, given `type` and `service`, fills missing `service` from `schemas[type].service` when available, then returns `services[service]` or `null`.

`getService(schemas, services)` returns a `(type, service)` function that, when service is missing and `schemas[type]` exists, uses `schemas[type].service`, then returns `services[service]` or `null`.
Returns a function that, given type and service, uses schemas[type].service when service is missing and returns services[service] or null if unavailable.

This async sync action fetches source results, returns single/multi errors on non-ok statuses, returns a noaction error when no data unless syncNoData is true, otherwise updates metas and dispatches SET, returning `{status:'ok', data: responses}`.

Async `sync` builds params, fetches all source results, returns a single failure or aggregated error if any status isn’t `'ok'`, errors on empty data unless `syncNoData===true`, otherwise returns `{status:'ok',data:responses}`.

This async sync function fetches and aggregates service data, returns an error if any result status isn’t ok or no data exists (unless syncNoData is true), otherwise returns {status:'ok',data:responses}.

Synchronizes data by fetching from generated source params, returning an error if any result is non-ok or no data exists (unless allowed), otherwise dispatching SET/meta updates and returning ok responses.
Creates a transformer that maps request.data using mappings, then applies requestMapper to the mapped data with request context, returning a new request object with updated data.
`mapToService` returns a function that takes `{request, requestMapper, mappings}`, maps `request.data` via `mapData`, and returns the request copy with `data` transformed by `applyEndpointMapper`.

`mapToService` returns a mapper function that destructures `request`, `requestMapper`, and `mappings`, maps `request.data` via `mapData`, and returns the request with `data` transformed by `applyEndpointMapper`.
Returns a function that maps request.data using mappings, then applies requestMapper to produce and return a new request object with transformed data and original properties.
Processes all extracted messages from `body`; returns false if none exist, otherwise clones each message, runs all middleware with copied context, logs middleware errors, and returns true.
Asynchronously extracts messages from body, returns false if none exist, otherwise clones each message, runs all middleware plugins with copied context, logs plugin errors, and returns true.
Asynchronously extracts messages from body, returns false if none exist, otherwise clones each message, runs all middleware with merged context, logs middleware errors, and returns true.
Asynchronously gets all messages from `body`, returns false if none exist, otherwise clones each message, runs each middleware plugin with copied context (logging plugin errors), and returns true.
Creates a plugin factory requiring a string `prop`; the returned initializer skips if `base-<prop>` is registered, maps app/store config methods, and defines proxied `app[prop]` with `process`.
Creates a plugin initializer for a string property name, throwing if prop is not a string, skipping when `base-${prop}` is registered, and otherwise defining proxied mapped config on `app`.
`create` validates `prop` is a string, then returns a function that skips registered `base-prop`, builds mapped config/store proxies on `app`, and returns nothing.
Creates a middleware-setup function for a string property name, throwing if prop isn’t a string, and returning a function that skips registered bases or defines proxied config methods.
Initializes an ElementMatrix by invoking CommanalityMatrix with top, adding blank row and column entries, and assigning classlist from top.root.classlist.
`ElementMatrix(top)` calls `CommanalityMatrix` with `this` and `top`, invokes `this.row(' ')` and `this.collum(' ')`, and assigns `this.classlist` from `top.root.classlist`.
ElementMatrix initializes via CommanalityMatrix.call(this, top), invokes this.row(' ') and this.collum(' '), then sets this.classlist to top.root.classlist, returning no explicit value.
Initializes an ElementMatrix by invoking CommanalityMatrix with top, then adds a blank row and a blank column on this object, returning no explicit value.
Encodes a string for public S3 URI use by URL-encoding it, converting spaces to “+” and “%2F” to “/”, and percent-encoding specific punctuation characters.
Encodes a string for a public S3 URI by applying encodeURIComponent, then replacing %20 with +, %2F with /, and specific reserved characters with percent-encoded forms.
Encodes a string for public S3 URIs by applying encodeURIComponent, converting `%20` to `+` and `%2F` to `/`, then percent-encoding `"#$&'(),:;=?@`, returning the result.
Encodes an input string for a public S3 URI by URL-encoding then replacing spaces with “+”, preserving “/”, and percent-encoding listed special characters, returning the transformed string.
Initializes a Node with type, parent, root, identifier (incremented from root counter when parent exists), default text/style flags, metrics, children array, block flags, and inTree=true.

Initializes a Node with type and parent, setting root/identifyer based on parent existence (incrementing parent.root._counter), and returns the constructed object with default text, style, tree, and child state fields.
Initializes a Node instance with type and parent, setting root/identifyer from parent when present, otherwise defaults, and returns the constructed object implicitly.
Creates a Node with the given type and parent inputs, performing no checks or additional operations, and has no explicit return value.
Initializes a text node by calling Node with type 'text' and parent, then sets children to null and stores the provided text in _text and _noneStyleText.
TextNode initializes a text node by calling Node with type 'text' and parent, then sets children to null and stores text in _text and _noneStyleText.
Creates a TextNode by calling Node with type 'text' and parent, then sets children to null and assigns both _text and _noneStyleText to text.
Creates a text node by invoking `Node.call(this, 'text', parent)` with the given parent and text inputs, performs no condition checks, and returns nothing.

Initializes an element node by calling Node with type 'element', setting tag count to 0 for br/wbr otherwise 1, parsing classes from attributes.class, registering in root.classlist, and caching block-element status.
Initializes an ElementNode by calling Node with type 'element' and parent, setting tags to 0 for br/wbr else 1, parsing class attributes, caching block-element status, and returning nothing.

Initializes an ElementNode by calling Node('element', parent), setting tag/attributes, checking br/wbr and class presence, registering with root.classlist, caching block-element status, and returning nothing.
Initializes an element node via `Node.call`, and if `attributes` has a `class`, splits its trimmed classes and adds the node to `root.classlist`; checks block-element membership.
Appends the given content plus a newline to the specified file using `fs.appendFile`, then logs the rule count and append action details.
distribute(filename, content) appends content plus a newline to filename using fs.appendFile, logs “rulecount: Append to filename -> content,” and returns no explicit value.
`distribute(filename, content)` appends `content` plus a newline to `filename` using `fs.appendFile`, logs `rulecount`/filename/content details, and returns nothing.
Appends content plus a newline to the specified file and logs the append action with the current rule count, returning no value.
detectTakeout checks each selector against each takeout ruleprefix, marks takeout true and sets filename on prefix matches, then returns the properties object.
detectTakeout iterates options.takeout and selectors, sets properties.takeout true and properties.filename to takeout.filename when a selector starts with takeout.ruleprefix, then returns properties.

Initializes `{takeout:false}`, checks each `options.takeout` against each selector for a prefix match (`selector.indexOf(takeout.ruleprefix)===0`), then returns properties with matched `takeout` and `filename`.
detectTakeout scans selectors against each options.takeout ruleprefix, and when a selector starts with one, sets properties.takeout true and properties.filename, while returning { takeout: false }.
Trims the input text, splits it into newline-separated lines, takes the first three-quarters as `bookmarks`, and returns an object containing `bookmarks` and remaining `lines`.
`parseLineByLine` trims input text, splits it by newline, moves the first three-quarters of entries into `bookmarks` via `splice`, and returns an object containing `bookmarks` and remaining `lines`.
parseLineByLine trims and splits input text by newline, moves the first three-quarters of resulting lines into bookmarks, and returns an object containing bookmarks and remaining lines.
Parses input text into trimmed newline-separated lines, removes and stores the first three-quarters as bookmarks, and returns an object containing the remaining lines and extracted bookmarks.
Initializes a CommonalityInterface object by storing top and MatrixConstructor, and setting length and matrix properties to null; it returns the newly constructed instance implicitly.
CommonalityInterface initializes an object by storing the provided top and MatrixConstructor values, setting this.length and this.matrix to null, and returns the constructed instance implicitly.
CommonalityInterface initializes an instance by assigning the provided top and MatrixConstructor to this.top and this.MatrixConstructor, and setting this.length and this.matrix to null.
Defines `CommonalityInterface` with parameters `MatrixConstructor` and `top`; it performs no checks or calls and has no specified return value.
Initializes a CommanalityMatrix object with empty row/column key-name maps, node and summary matrices, zero dimensions, and default best-index/node tracking values.

CommanalityMatrix initializes matrix-related instance properties—row/column key maps, name arrays, node/summary matrices, dimensions [0,0], bestIndex [-1,-1], and _bestNodes—and returns no explicit value.

CommanalityMatrix initializes instance properties from classlist-independent defaults, setting key/name maps and matrices to empty objects/arrays, dim to [0,0], bestIndex to [-1,-1], and _bestNodes to {}.
CommanalityMatrix takes classlist as input and has no specified conditions, function calls, asynchronous behavior, error handling, or defined return value.
Creates and returns an array of the given size, initializing each index from 0 to size-1 with an empty array.
Creates an array of length size, iterates from 0 while i < size assigning each element to an empty array, and returns the populated array.
Creates an array of the given size, iterates from 0 while i < size assigning each element to an empty array, and returns the populated array.
Creates and returns a new array of the given size by calling Array(size), with a loop condition i < size present but not affecting the returned value.

buildAttributeMatcher creates and returns a matcher function that lowercases existing attr values for match keys and returns true if any key exists and, for array criteria, matches any string or RegExp.

buildAttributeMatcher creates and returns a predicate that lowercases existing attr values and returns true if any match key satisfies string-equality or RegExp-test conditions, including array alternatives.
buildAttributeMatcher creates and returns a predicate that lowercases existing attr values and returns true if any key’s value matches configured strings or regexes, including array alternatives.

Builds and returns an attribute-matching function by iterating match keys and array values, lowercasing string entries, checking regex/value types, and evaluating generated boolean logic against attr.
Traverses up `b.parent` links, returning true if any ancestor is strictly equal to `a`, and false if it reaches the top without a match.
This function walks up b’s parent chain, returning true if any ancestor strictly equals a, and returns false once b has no parent or no match is found.
Traverses `b` up its `parent` chain, returning `true` if any ancestor strictly equals `a`; if none match before `b` becomes falsy, returns `false`.
Traverses up b’s parent chain, returning true if any ancestor is strictly equal to a; otherwise returns false when no match is found.
Returns the common parent of nodes a and b by checking equality, whether one contains the other, then walking b’s ancestors until finding one that contains a.
Returns the common parent of nodes a and b by checking equality, direct containment in either direction, then walking b’s parent chain until one contains a, returning that node.
Returns the common parent of a and b by checking equality and containment (containerOf), otherwise climbing b.parent until b contains a, then returning that b.
Returns the nearest common parent of nodes a and b by checking equality, direct containment in either direction, then walking b’s ancestors until one contains a; otherwise returns none.
Parses a style string (defaulting to empty), splitting on optional-whitespace-separated `;` or `:`, and returns an object mapping alternating token pairs as property names and values.
Parses a CSS-style declaration string (defaulting to empty), splitting on colons/semicolons, pairing alternating tokens as property/value entries, and returns an object mapping properties to values.
Parses a CSS-style declaration string (defaulting falsy input to empty), splits on colons/semicolons with optional whitespace, pairs alternating tokens as property/value, and returns an object map.
Parses a style string by trimming and splitting on semicolons/colons, iterating through token pairs from index 1, and returns an object (empty if no pairs).
Computes distance between two tree nodes by returning 0 if identical, otherwise counting upward steps to their common parent plus sibling-index gap when neither is that parent.
Computes distance between two tree nodes: returns 0 if identical, otherwise counts steps to their common parent plus sibling index gap when both differ from that parent.
Computes distance between two tree nodes: returns 0 if identical; otherwise counts steps from each toward their common parent, adds sibling index gap when both differ, and returns total.
Computes distance between two tree nodes by returning 0 if identical, otherwise climbing each node to their common parent and returning aCount + bCount + sibling-index difference.
Initializes a Lexer instance by copying options, setting file/regex state, defining known/unknown tags and delimiters, creating a root AST/token stack, and returning the constructed object.
Initializes a Lexer instance by merging options, storing file input, and setting default parsing state objects/arrays (AST, tags, delimiters, tokens, errors, stacks, caches), returning nothing.
Initializes a Lexer instance by merging options and setting file, caches, AST/root token structures, known/unknown tags and blocks, delimiters, and empty tracking arrays/objects, returning nothing.

Initializes a Router instance by defaulting missing options (paths, routes, basePath, log, lfs), normalizing path extensions, ensuring a '^/$' default route, copying options onto this, and returning nothing.
Initializes a Router with logging and filesystem helpers, validates path extensions, ensures a default '^/$' route exists unless already present, iterates option keys, and returns nothing.
Returns a Promise resolving to the default port string for a protocol (after removing a trailing colon), or rejecting with “Has no port” if no port mapping exists.

getDefaultPortByProtocol removes a trailing colon from rawProtocol if present, looks up portNumbers.getPort(protocol), and returns a resolved Promise with its port string or rejects with Error('Has no port').
Normalizes rawProtocol by removing a trailing colon, looks up its port via portNumbers.getPort, and returns Promise.resolve(String(port)) or Promise.reject(Error('Has no port')).
Returns a promise resolving to the protocol’s default port as a string after removing a trailing colon, or rejecting with “Has no port” if none exists.
Recursively traverses an object, replacing non-empty trimmed string values with "..." and including nested results only when non-empty, returning a filtered object of script placeholders.

`clearScripts` recursively traverses `node`, replacing any non-empty trimmed string property with `"..."`, keeping only non-empty recursively processed child objects, and returning the resulting object.
Recursively builds and returns an object containing only keys whose values are non-empty strings (replaced with "...") or non-empty recursively processed child objects.
Recursively scans a node’s properties, trimming string values and descending into nested values, checking whether discovered child scripts are empty, and ultimately returns an empty object.
Builds an array from nodeList by preserving holes, expanding SpreadElement argument values, and adding static element values; returns null if any static evaluation fails.
Iterates nodeList, preserving holes for null entries, resolves each element (or spread argument) via getStaticValueR, returns null on unresolved values, otherwise returns collected values array.
Builds an array of static values from nodeList, handling null entries and spread elements, returning null if any value resolution fails, otherwise returning the collected valueList.
Iterates through nodeList, returning null if any computed argument or element is null; otherwise collects each static value (or spread argument values) into and returns an array.
Returns the result of `operations[node.type](node, initialScope)` when `node` is non-null and `operations` has an own property matching `node.type`; otherwise returns `null`.
`getStaticValueR` checks that `node` is non-null and `operations` has a handler for `node.type`, returning that handler’s result with `(node, initialScope)` or `null` otherwise.
Returns operations[node.type](node, initialScope) when node is non-null and operations has own property node.type; otherwise returns null.
Returns operations[node.type](node, initialScope) when node is non-null and operations has node.type as an own property; otherwise returns null.
Checks whether a global variable is modified by returning true if it is null, has any definitions, or has any reference marked as a write.
Returns true if variable is null, has defs.length not equal to 0, or any reference is a write (references.some(r => r.isWrite())); otherwise returns false.
Returns true if variable is null, has defs.length not equal to 0, or any reference’s isWrite() is true; otherwise returns false.
Returns true if the variable is null, has any definitions, or has at least one reference marked as a write; otherwise returns false.
Creates and returns a build config object using ext, setting output format to "es" when ext is ".mjs" otherwise "cjs", with sourcemaps, banner, plugins, and package dependencies as externals.
Returns a Rollup config object with fixed input, sourcemap settings, banner, sourcemaps plugin, external package dependencies, and output format set to "es" only when ext is ".mjs", otherwise "cjs".
Returns a Rollup config object with fixed input, sourcemaps plugin, external dependency keys, and output settings, choosing format as "es" only when ext equals ".mjs", otherwise "cjs".
Builds and returns a Rollup config for `src/index.js`, setting output file/format based on whether `ext` equals `.mjs`, enabling sourcemaps, and externalizing package dependencies.
Determines whether the character at a given index is escaped by counting consecutive preceding backslashes and returns true if their count is odd, otherwise false.
Determines whether the character at a given index is escaped by counting consecutive preceding backslashes and toggling a flag, returning true for an odd count.
`isEscaped(str, index)` walks backward from `index - 1` while characters are backslashes, toggles an `escaped` flag each time, and returns whether the count is odd.
Determines whether the character at `index` is escaped by counting consecutive preceding backslashes in `str`, and returns `escaped` based on that check.
Replaces all matcher.execAll(str) matches by applying replacement placeholder substitutions ($$, $&, $`, $', and capture indices), preserving unmatched text, and returns the reconstructed string.
Builds a replaced string by iterating matcher.execAll(str), handling $$, $&, $`, $', and numeric $n placeholders (if present in match), then returns concatenated chunks.
Replaces all matcher.execAll(str) matches by expanding replacement placeholders ($$, $&, $`, $', and numeric groups if present), preserving unmatched slices, and returns the concatenated string.
Replaces all matches from `matcher.execAll(str)` in `str` by concatenating unchanged slices and processed `replacement` segments, then returns the final joined string.

Iterates over all matches from `matcher.execAll(str)`, replacing each matched segment with `replace(...match, match.index, match.input)` while preserving non-matching text, and returns the reconstructed string.
Replaces all matches from matcher.execAll(str) by concatenating unmatched slices and String(replace(...match, match.index, match.input)), then returns the rebuilt string joined from chunks.

replaceF iterates matcher.execAll(str), appending unmatched slices and String(replace(...match, match.index, match.input)), updates index by match position plus match[0].length, then returns chunks.join("").
Builds and returns a new string by iterating all matcher.execAll(str) matches, appending unchanged slices and each replacement from replace(...match, match.index, match.input).
Sends a message via `ps` when open, otherwise retries after delays while connecting or after reconnecting from closing/closed states, and returns nothing explicitly.
Sends `msg` based on `ps.readyState`: retries after delays when connecting or on send errors, reconnects and retries when closing/closed, sends immediately when open, and returns nothing.
send(msg) switches on ps.readyState: retries after 1000ms when connecting, reconnects and retries after 2000ms when closing/closed, sends when open, and on send errors logs then retries after 1500ms.
Attempts to send msg via ps.send, but on readyState 0 or 3 logs a reconnect event, calls connect, and retries after delays, catching errors and returning nothing.

`parseMessage` switches on `data.topic`, handling channel bits, moderator actions, and whispers by parsing `data.message` JSON and emitting `_event` for bits/moderation, otherwise doing nothing and returning undefined.

parseMessage switches on data.topic, matching channel-bits-events-v1.channel_id, chat_moderator_actions.id.id, or whispers.id to parse data.message and trigger bits/moderation/whisper handlers, returning nothing.

parseMessage switches on data.topic, matching channel-bits, moderator-actions, or whispers topics using state IDs, then parses data.message and emits corresponding 'bits' or 'moderation' events, otherwise just breaks.
`parseMessage(data)` switches on `data.topic`, matching channel bits, moderator actions, whispers, or default cases, then calls `bits()`, `moderation()`, and `whisper()`, returning nothing.
Initializes a JWT object by setting empty token and payload, storing provided secret and options, and defaulting validity, expiration, and staleness flags to false, false, and true.
Initializes a JWT object by setting token and payload defaults, storing provided secret and options, and initializing valid/expired flags false and stale true, returning the instance implicitly.
Initializes a JWT object by setting token to '', payload to {}, assigning secret and options, and initializing valid/expired to false and stale to true, returning nothing.
Defines a JWT function that accepts secret and options parameters, performs no checks or operations, and has no specified return value.

setupComponent tears down any existing component, creates a `.component-root` node from a jQuery/string fixture or a new div otherwise, appends it to body, normalizes options, and initializes `this.component`.
setupComponent tears down any existing component, uses fixture as a jQuery/string node or creates a default root div, appends it to body, initializes Component with options, and returns nothing.
Sets up a component by tearing down/removing any existing one, normalizing fixture/options based on fixture type, appending a root node to body, and returning initialized component instance.
Resets the current component, ensures a `component-root` node exists from the fixture or a new div, appends it to `body`, and initializes a new component with options.
Creates and returns a test setup function that, before each test, asynchronously requires modulePath, stores the loaded module on this.module, calls done, then runs specDefinitions with this context.

`describeModuleFactory` returns a function that, in `beforeEach`, resets `this.module`, requires `modulePath`, assigns the loaded module to `this.module`, calls `done`, then runs `specDefinitions.apply(this)`.

`describeModuleFactory` returns a function that, in `beforeEach`, resets `this.module`, requires `modulePath`, sets `this.module` in the callback, calls `done`, then runs `specDefinitions.apply(this)`.
Returns a function that, before each test, asynchronously requires `modulePath`, stores the loaded module on `this.module`, calls `done`, and then runs `specDefinitions` with the current context.
Initializes resilient options and returns inbound/outbound middleware that skips on error, maps object-array `res.data` via `mapServers`, and adds datacenter, healthy-only, and tag query params.

Defines resilient options from `options` and returns `in`/`out` handlers: `in` forwards errors and maps `res.data` when it’s an array of objects; `out` sets params (`dc`, `passing`, `tag`) then calls `next`.
Initializes resilient options and returns `in`/`out` handlers: `in` forwards errors or maps `res.data` when it’s an array of objects; `out` sets params (`dc`, `passing`, `tag`) then calls `next`.

Creates resilient options from `options` and returns `in`/`out` handlers: `in` skips on error or maps object-array `res.data` servers, while `out` initializes params and conditionally sets `dc`, `passing`, and `tag`.
`inHandler` calls `next()` immediately on error; otherwise, if `res.data` is an array whose first item is an object, it maps `res.data` through `mapServers` before calling `next()`.
Handles middleware flow by calling `next(err)` when `err` exists, mapping `res.data` with `mapServers` when it’s an array whose first element equals `Object(res.data[0])`, then calling `next()`.
Handles middleware flow: if `err` exists it returns `next(err)`; if `res.data` is an array whose first element is an object, maps it via `mapServers`, then calls `next()`.
Calls `next()` immediately if `err` exists; otherwise checks `res.data` array/object shape, maps servers from `res.data`, and then calls `next()` without returning a value.
Initializes `options.params`, conditionally sets `dc`, `passing`, and `tag` from `params.datacenter`, `params.onlyHealthy`, and `params.tag`, then invokes `next()`.
Initializes `options.params` if missing, conditionally maps `params.datacenter`, `params.onlyHealthy`, and `params.tag` into it as `dc`, `passing=true`, and `tag`, then calls `next()`.

Initializes options.params to itself or {}, conditionally maps params.datacenter→options.params.dc, params.onlyHealthy→options.params.passing=true, and params.tag→options.params.tag, then calls next().
`outHandler` takes `options` and `next`, performs no checks or additional logic, calls `next()`, and does not explicitly return a value.
Creates a Service with displayName, UUID, and subtype, throws an error if UUID is missing, initializes properties and characteristic arrays, and returns the initialized Service instance.

Creates a Service object, throwing an Error if UUID is missing, initializes core properties and characteristic arrays, and if displayName exists, ensures/creates Name characteristic and sets its value.
Creates a Service object, throwing an Error if UUID is missing, initializing core properties and arrays, and when displayName exists, ensuring a Name characteristic and setting its value.
Initializes a Service by requiring a valid UUID (throwing an error if missing), then ensuring and setting the Name characteristic to displayName, and returns nothing.
Initializes a Characteristic object by assigning displayName, UUID, null iid/value defaults, and either provided props or default format/unit/min-max-step values with empty permissions.
Initializes a Characteristic object by assigning displayName and UUID, setting iid and value to null, and setting props to the provided object or default null/empty fields.
Initializes a Characteristic by assigning displayName and UUID, setting iid and value to null, and returning props or a default object with null fields and empty perms.
Creates a Characteristic object from displayName, UUID, and props inputs, with no internal conditions, function calls, asynchronous behavior, explicit errors, or return value.

Filters schema descriptors to versions above currentVersion; if none exist returns a resolved PromiseSync(undefined), otherwise migrates the first descriptor then recursively processes remaining descriptors with updated version.

migrateDatabase filters schema descriptors with version greater than currentVersion, returns PromiseSync.resolve(undefined) if none remain, otherwise migrates the first and recursively continues from its version.

Filters schema descriptors with version greater than currentVersion; if none exist, returns PromiseSync.resolve(undefined), otherwise migrates the first descriptor then recursively continues from its version.

Filters schema descriptors with version greater than currentVersion; if none exist returns PromiseSync.resolve(undefined), otherwise migrates the first descriptor then recursively continues, returning the chained promise.
Migrates a database version by optionally fetching pre-migration records when `fetchBefore` is non-empty, then executing migration with `descriptor.objectStores`, returning the resulting promise.

Migrates a database version by optionally fetching pre-migration records when descriptor.fetchBefore exists and has length, then executing descriptor.after (or a no-op) and returning that promise chain.

migrateDatabaseVersion optionally fetches pre-migration records when descriptor.fetchBefore exists and is nonempty, otherwise resolves to {}, then executes DatabaseVersionMigrator.executeMigration and returns its result promise.

Creates a RecordFetcher, optionally fetches pre-migration records from normalized `descriptor.fetchBefore` stores (or resolves `{}`), then runs `DatabaseVersionMigrator.executeMigration` with `descriptor.after` or a no-op, returning that promise.

Maps objectStores to normalized objects: strings become {objectStore, identity preprocessor}, objects missing preprocessor get identity preprocessor added, and objects with preprocessor are returned unchanged.

Maps `objectStores`, converting string entries to `{objectStore, preprocessor: record => record}`, adding that default preprocessor when missing, and otherwise returning each original object-store entry unchanged.

normalizeFetchBeforeObjectStores maps objectStores, converting string entries to {objectStore, preprocessor: record=>record}, adding an identity preprocessor when missing, and otherwise returning each object unchanged.
Maps each object store entry, converting strings to `{objectStore, preprocessor: record => record}`, adding an identity preprocessor when missing, and otherwise returning entries unchanged.

Validates schemaDescriptors by returning early if all are plain objects; otherwise requires the first to be DatabaseSchema and remaining to be UpgradedDatabaseSchema, throwing TypeError on violations.
Checks schemaDescriptors: returns undefined immediately if all are plain objects; otherwise throws TypeError unless first is DatabaseSchema and remaining entries are UpgradedDatabaseSchema instances.
Checks schemaDescriptors types: returns undefined if all are plain objects; otherwise throws TypeError unless first is DatabaseSchema and remaining descriptors are UpgradedDatabaseSchema instances.

Checks schema descriptors: returns undefined if all are plain objects; otherwise requires first to be a DatabaseSchema and remaining to be UpgradedDatabaseSchema instances, throwing TypeError on violations.

Returns a Promise that iterates storage cursors by keyRange/direction, includes records passing filter, stops at pageSize to mark next-page keys, and resolves to a RecordList with pagination metadata.

Returns a Promise that cursor-iterates storage by keyRange/direction, applies optional filter(record, primaryKey, key), collects up to pageSize items, and resolves a RecordList with pagination metadata.

Returns a Promise that iterates a storage cursor by keyRange/direction, optionally filters records, collects up to pageSize items, and resolves a RecordList with pagination keys/flag or rejects on error.
Creates a cursor over `storage` for `keyRange`/`direction`, collects records passing `filter` until `pageSize`, then resolves a `RecordList` with items and next-page key metadata.
Builds an array of values from a compound key by traversing each dot-delimited key path, throwing an error if any path segment is missing, and returns the collected values.
`normalizeCompoundObjectKey` iterates key paths, traverses each dot-separated field in `key`, throws if any field is missing via `hasOwnProperty`, and returns an array of resolved values.
Builds an array of values from key by traversing each dot-delimited keyPath, throwing an Error if any field is missing, and returns the normalizedKey array.
Iterates each dot-delimited path in `keyPaths`, verifies every nested property exists in `key`, throws an error for undefined paths, and returns an array of resolved values.
Creates a PromiseSync that iterates a request cursor, rejecting on request errors, warning and ignoring asynchronous iteration attempts, and resolving with the number of traversed records.

Creates and returns a PromiseSync that iterates a request cursor, rejecting on request errors, warning if iteration continues asynchronously, and resolving with traversed record count when done or stopped.

Creates and returns a PromiseSync that iterates a request cursor, rejecting on request error, warning if iteration is requested asynchronously, and resolving with traversed record count when done or stopped.

Creates a PromiseSync that iterates a request cursor, rejecting on request errors, warning if iteration is requested asynchronously, and resolving with the traversed record count when exhausted or stopped.
Creates a cursor, invokes recordCallback safely, marks iteration when requested, catches and rejects subrequest or callback errors, and returns whether iteration was requested.
Creates a cursor from request, marks iteration when requested, invokes recordCallback safely, rejects on callback or subrequest errors, and returns whether iteration was requested.
Creates a cursor, records it via recordCallback, rejects on callback or subrequest-resolution errors, tracks whether iteration was requested, and returns that iterationRequested boolean flag.

Creates a cursor from request, marks iterationRequested when iterated, wraps subRequest errors to call reject and rethrow, invokes recordCallback(cursor), catches errors, and returns iterationRequested.
Fetches records from each specified transaction object store using optional preprocessors, waits for all fetches to complete, then returns an object mapping each store name to its records.

`fetchAllRecords` fetches records for each `objectStores` descriptor via `transaction.getObjectStore(descriptor.objectStore)` and `descriptor.preprocessor`, then returns a promise resolving to an object mapping store names to fetched records.

Fetches records for each objectStore descriptor via transaction.getObjectStore and fetchRecords, waits with PromiseSync.all, then returns a map from descriptor.objectStore to corresponding fetched records.
Fetches records for each object store descriptor via the transaction and optional preprocessor, then returns a promise resolving to an object mapping store names to fetched records.

Returns a PromiseSync that iterates an object store cursor, freezes object primary keys, preprocesses each record, deletes on DELETE_RECORD, skips on SKIP_RECORD, and resolves with collected key-record pairs.

fetchRecords returns a PromiseSync that iterates objectStore cursors, freezes object primary keys, preprocesses records, deletes or skips sentinel-marked entries, collects remaining key-record pairs, and resolves or rejects.

fetchRecords returns a PromiseSync that cursor-iterates objectStore, freezes object primary keys, preprocesses records, deletes DELETE_RECORD entries, skips SKIP_RECORD entries, and resolves with collected {key, record} pairs.

Returns a PromiseSync that iterates objectStore records via cursor, freezes object primary keys, preprocesses each record, deletes DELETE_RECORD entries, skips SKIP_RECORD entries, and resolves collected key-record pairs.
Converts outputPath to absolute, ensures its directory exists, JSON-stringifies array/object data, writes to the file, and invokes cb with mkdir/write errors or with (null, original data).
Converts outputPath to absolute, creates its directory, returns cb(err) on mkdirp error, otherwise JSON-stringifies array/object data, writes it to file, and calls cb(err, data).
Converts outputPath to absolute, ensures its directory exists, returns cb(err) on mkdirp error, JSON-stringifies array/object data, then writes the file and calls cb(err, data).
Converts the path to absolute, ensures its directory exists, JSON-stringifies array/object data, writes it to the file, and invokes the callback with any error and original data.
Runs transactionOperations with requested object stores and an abort callback, then returns a promise resolving to its result only after transaction.completionPromise fulfills.
Runs transaction operations with object stores from provided names plus an abort callback, then returns a promise resolving to the operation result after transaction completion.
Runs transactionOperations with object stores from objectStoreNames plus an abort callback, then returns a promise resolving resultPromise and, after transaction.completionPromise, the same result.
Creates object stores from the provided names, appends an abort callback, runs transactionOperations with them, and returns a promise resolving to its result after transaction completion.
Converts a cursor direction (string or object with value) to lowercase four-character native form, validates string directions against allowed values, appends “unique” when requested, and returns it.
Converts a direction (string or object with value) to a native cursor prefix, validates string directions against CURSOR_DIRECTIONS, optionally appends “unique,” and returns the result.

Converts a direction to a native cursor prefix, validating string directions against CURSOR_DIRECTIONS (or throwing an Error), using direction.value otherwise, appending "unique" when unique is truthy, and returning it.
Validates that direction (case-insensitive) is NEXT or PREVIOUS, throws an Error otherwise, then returns the lowercase first four characters of direction as cursorDirection; unique is unused.
Creates an index on the object store only if an index with the given schema name does not already exist; otherwise returns without action.

Creates an object store index only if indexSchema.name exists in objectStore.indexNames, otherwise returns early, and returns undefined after optionally calling objectStore.createIndex with schema options.
Creates an index on objectStore only if indexSchema.name is not already in objectStore.indexNames, otherwise returns early; when created, it returns undefined after calling objectStore.createIndex.
Creates an index on objectStore using indexSchema name, keyPath, unique, and multiEntry options, but returns undefined without creating anything if an index with that name exists.
Creates a cursor-based page fetch Promise that skips non-unique records before firstPrimaryKey by direction, applies an optional filter, collects up to pageSize records, and resolves to a RecordList.
Fetches the next paginated records via a cursor, skipping pre-firstPrimaryKey items by direction when non-unique, applying an optional filter, and resolving to a RecordList with pagination metadata.

fetchNextPage scans a cursor, optionally skips pre-firstPrimaryKey records by direction when non-unique, applies filter, collects up to pageSize records, and resolves a RecordList with pagination state.
Fetches the next page via a cursor, skipping non-unique records before firstPrimaryKey by direction, applying an optional filter, and resolves to a RecordList with items and pagination state.
Iterates through each listener, invokes it with the provided parameters, and catches any thrown errors to log them with `console.error` without stopping other listeners.
Executes each listener in listeners with the provided parameters using apply(null, parameters), catches any thrown error per listener, logs it to console.error, and returns undefined.
`executeEventListeners` iterates over `listeners`, calls each listener with `parameters` via `apply(null, parameters)`, and if a listener throws, catches it and logs an error to `console.error`.
Executes each listener with the provided parameters, catching any thrown errors to log “An event listener threw an error,” and returns nothing.
If the instance is pending, it sets its state and value, selects fulfill or error listeners based on the new state, and invokes each listener; otherwise returns.
Resolves an instance only if its current state is PENDING, then sets state and value, selects fulfill or error listeners based on newState, invokes each listener, and returns undefined.
Resolves an instance only if its state is pending, setting state and value, selecting fulfill or error listeners based on newState===STATE.RESOLVED, invoking each listener, otherwise returning early.
If `instance.state` is not `PENDING`, it returns `undefined`; otherwise, it iterates through `listeners`, calling each `listener()`, and returns nothing.

Runs a cursor query applying optional filter, comparator sorting, offset, and limit; skips/advances nonmatching or pre-offset records, invokes callback for selected records, and returns the cursorFactory promise.
Runs a cursor query with optional filter, comparator, offset, and limit, skipping/continuing as needed, invoking callback per selected record, and returning the cursorFactory promise chain.
runQuery iterates a cursor, applying optional filter, offset, limit, and comparator logic, invokes callback for qualifying records, and returns the cursorFactory(...).then(...) promise chain.
Runs a cursor query applying optional filter, comparator-based sorting, offset skipping, and limit trimming, invokes callback for qualifying records, and returns the cursorFactory promise chain.
Finds the insertion index for a record using the comparator, then inserts an object containing the record and primaryKey into records at that position.
insertSorted finds an insertion index with findInsertIndex(records, record, comparator), inserts {record, primaryKey} into records at that index using splice, and returns nothing.
insertSorted computes an insertion index via findInsertIndex(records, record, comparator), then splices records at that index to insert {record, primaryKey}, returning splice’s result.
Inserts `{ record, primaryKey }` into `records` at the index from `findInsertIndex(records, record, comparator)` using `splice`, maintaining comparator-based order, and returns nothing.

Returns the insertion index for record in sorted records using comparator, handling empty/single-item arrays, checking first element, then binary-searching for first greater element, otherwise returning records.length.
Finds the insertion index for record in sorted records using comparator, handling empty/single-item arrays, checking first and pivot comparisons, and returning the index or records.length.

findInsertIndex returns the insertion index for record in records using comparator, handling empty/single-item arrays, early returning 0 when record precedes first element, otherwise binary-searching and defaulting to records.length.

Returns the insertion index for `record` in sorted `records` using `comparator`, handling empty/single-item arrays, early front insertion when first comparison is positive, binary-searching, and defaulting to `records.length`.

Prepares a query plan by normalizing order, checking sortable direction and optimization eligibility, collecting non-multiEntry storages, applying sorting/filtering optimizations, and returning the chosen storage configuration.

Normalizes order, determines expected direction from a leading “!” and sort optimizability, builds candidate storages from primary key and non-multiEntry indexes, applies optimizations, then returns chooseStorageForQuery’s result.

Normalizes order, checks if descending is expected and sorting can be optimized, builds candidate storages from base and non-multiEntry indexes, prepares optimizations, then returns chooseStorageForQuery’s result.

Prepares query execution by normalizing order, checking sort-direction optimization, collecting base/index storages by keyPath, preparing sorting/filtering optimizations, and returning the chosen storage/query plan.
Iterates storages, compares each keyPath prefix to simplifiedOrderFieldPaths using idb.cmp, and when equal increases that storage’s score by 4, returning nothing.
prepareSortingOptimization gets an idb comparator, iterates storages, and when keyPath’s prefix equals simplifiedOrderFieldPaths (idb.cmp returns 0), increments storageAndScore.score by 4.

Initializes idb, iterates storages entries, compares each keyPath prefix (sliced to simplifiedOrderFieldPaths length) with simplifiedOrderFieldPaths using idb.cmp, and adds 4 to matching storageAndScore.score.

Iterates through storages entries, obtains an IndexedDB provider, slices each keyPath to simplifiedOrderFieldPaths length, and compares that slice with simplifiedOrderFieldPaths using idb.cmp, returning nothing.
Sets each storage’s filter/keyRange by normalizing `filter`; if `filter` is a function applies it directly, otherwise partially optimizes plain-object filters, updates scores, and returns nothing.

Prepares filtering optimization for each storage by handling function filters directly, otherwise normalizing per keyPath and assigning optimized filter/keyRange and score adjustments, then returns undefined.

Prepares per-storage filtering optimization by assigning filters directly if `filter` is a function, otherwise normalizing per keyPath and setting `filter`/`keyRange` plus score adjustments, returning nothing.
Iterates storages and, unless filter is a Function (then returns undefined), computes normalized and partially optimized filters for each keyPath without returning a value.

Selects the highest-scored storage, checks whether sorting optimization is allowed and its keyPath prefix matches requested order fields, then returns storage, direction, comparator, keyRange, and filter.
Selects the highest-score storage, checks if sorting can be optimized by matching keyPath prefix to order fields, and returns storage, cursor direction, comparator/null, keyRange, and filter.
Selects the highest-score storage, checks whether sorting can be optimized by matching key-path prefix to order fields, and returns storage, cursor direction, comparator/null, keyRange, and filter.

Selects the highest-scored storage, checks whether its normalized keyPath prefix matches simplified order fields to optimize sorting, and returns storage, cursor direction, comparator/null, keyRange, and filter.

Prepares query ordering by defaulting null to NEXT, converting recognized direction strings to CursorDirection, normalizing keyPath, returning it or prefixed “!” paths for non-NEXT, otherwise returning order.

Prepares query ordering by defaulting null order to NEXT, recognizing valid cursor directions, normalizing keyPath for CursorDirection instances, returning keyPath or inverted paths, otherwise returning order.

Prepares query ordering by defaulting null to NEXT, validating/converting recognized cursor-direction strings, and if order is a CursorDirection returns normalized keyPath or reversed “!field” paths; otherwise returns order.

Normalizes keyPath, then returns it unchanged when order is CursorDirection.NEXT, otherwise returns keyPath with each field prefixed by “!”, after checking order via direct and uppercased direction lookups.

Opens an IndexedDB database at the latest schema version, tracks blocked/upgrade states, aborts upgrades if blocked or migration fails, and returns a Promise resolving to a Database or rejecting on errors.

Opens an IndexedDB database at the latest schema version, handles success/upgrade/error/blocked events, aborts blocked upgrades, runs schema migration, and returns a Promise resolving to a Database or rejecting with errors.

Opens an IndexedDB database at the latest schema version, handling success, upgrade-needed, blocked, and error events, aborting blocked/failed upgrades, and returning a Promise resolving to a Database.

Opens an IndexedDB database at the latest schema version, runs schema upgrades unless blocked, aborts blocked/failed upgrade transactions, and returns a Promise resolving to a Database or rejecting on errors/blocking.
Handles a connection error by preventing the event and returning if blocked or upgrade-triggered; otherwise rejects both the request and migration promise with request.error.
Handles a connection error by preventing default and returning when blocked or upgrade-triggered; otherwise rejects both provided callbacks with `request.error` and returns undefined.
handleConnectionError prevents default and returns early if wasBlocked or upgradeTriggered is true; otherwise it rejects and migrationPromiseRejector with request.error.
If not blocked or upgrade-triggered, it prevents the event default, rejects with request.error, calls migrationPromiseRejector with request.error, and otherwise returns undefined.
Iterates through migration listeners, invoking each with database name, old/new versions, and a completion promise, and catches any thrown errors to log a warning.
