Loads a module from a string path, returning undefined if src is missing/non-string or the required value is an error/non-plain object, otherwise merges it into _SETTINGS and returns that merge.
Compares two map-like collections, optionally sorting entries, returns ops.NOP if both empty, full replacement map if either empty, otherwise an ops.Map patch of inserts, deletes, and value diffs.
Compares two maps/collections (optionally sorting first), returns ops.NOP if both empty, otherwise builds and returns an ops.Map patch with insertions, deletions, and nested value-difference patches.
Compares two map-like collections (optionally sorting first), handles empty-size fast paths, computes inserts/deletes/value-diffs by key/value comparison, and returns ops.NOP or a new ops.Map patch.
Compares two map-like collections by sorted elements, returning NOP if both empty, full-map replacement if one empty, otherwise a key-indexed ops.Map of inserts, deletes, or element patches.
Compares two values with defaulted options, returning NOP if equal, DEL/Rpl for undefined cases, specialized map/array/object diffs for compatible objects, otherwise a replacement operation.

Compares `a` and `b` after defaulting `options`, returning `ops.NOP`, `ops.DEL`, `new ops.Rpl(b)`, or delegated array/map/object comparison results based on equality, undefined, and type/constructor checks.
Compares `a` and `b` with defaulted options, returning `ops.NOP`, `ops.DEL`, `new ops.Rpl(b)`, or delegated array/map/object comparison results based on equality, undefined, and type checks.
Compares `a` and `b`, returning `ops.NOP` if equal, `ops.DEL`/`ops.Rpl(b)` for undefined cases, otherwise delegating by `options.map` or constructor checks, defaulting to `ops.Rpl(b)`.
Converts a JSON-like object into an ops operation, returning existing ops instances or NOP for undefined, dispatching by object.op, recursively mapping nested data, or wrapping raw values in Rpl.
Converts input into an ops operation by returning existing ops.Op, ops.NOP for undefined, constructing specific ops by object.op (recursively for collections), else defaulting to new ops.Rpl(object).

fromJSON returns existing ops.Op instances or ops.NOP for undefined, otherwise decodes object.op into specific ops constructors (recursively mapping data for Mrg/Map/Arr), defaulting to Rpl or throwing unknown-op errors.
fromJSON returns an existing Op unchanged, maps undefined to NOP, decodes known op names into corresponding ops (recursively for Mrg/Map/Arr), defaults missing op to Rpl(object), otherwise throws.
Returns `func.apply(self, array(args))` when `func` is a function; otherwise returns `func` unchanged.

Returns `func.apply(self, array(args))` if `func` is of type `'function'`; otherwise returns `func` unchanged.
Returns `func.apply(self, array(args))` when `func` is a function (checked via `typeof func === 'function'`); otherwise returns `func` unchanged.
Adds CSS classes to document.body based on device detection: 'mobile' if any mobile, 'android' if Android mobile, and 'tablet' if any tablet is detected.
detectDeviceClass gets document.body, adds 'mobile' if isMobile.any(), 'android' if isMobile.Android(), and 'tablet' if isTablet.any(), and returns nothing.
detectDeviceClass gets document.body, checks isMobile.any(), isMobile.Android(), and isTablet.any(), and adds corresponding 'mobile', 'android', and 'tablet' classes, returning nothing.
detectDeviceClass checks if the device is mobile, Android, or tablet using isMobile/isTablet helpers, and adds corresponding CSS classes to document.body without returning a value.
Processes a view’s string template once, caching metadata and triggering process/fetch events when data exists, then returns template data or undefined based on processing and cache status.

Returns true if `error` is an instance of `GenericError`, `TemplateError`, `CompilerError`, `CustomizationError`, or `ConfigurationError`; otherwise returns false.
Checks whether `error` is an instance of `GenericError`, `TemplateError`, `CompilerError`, `CustomizationError`, or `ConfigurationError`, returning `true` if any match, otherwise `false`.

Returns a callback function that, when invoked with err and data, pushes err to asyncErrors if present, then calls callback(null, data).
`getFetchByStateCallback` returns a callback `(err, data)` that pushes `err` into `asyncErrors` when present, then always calls `callback(null, data)`.
Returns a callback that records any received error in asyncErrors and always invokes the provided callback with null as the error and the received data.
`listAvailables` optionally clears `adaptersCache` when `forceRefresh` is truthy, returns cached entries if present, otherwise reads subdirectories in `__dirname`, caches them, and returns the list.

`listAvailables(forceRefresh)` clears `adaptersCache` when `forceRefresh` is truthy, returns cached entries if nonempty, otherwise caches and returns `fs.readdirSync(__dirname).filter(isDir(__dirname+'/'+name))`.

`listAvailables(forceRefresh)` optionally clears `adaptersCache` when `forceRefresh` is truthy, returns cached entries if nonempty, otherwise caches and returns `__dirname` subdirectories from `fs.readdirSync(...).filter(isDir)`.
Returns cached adapters unless forceRefresh triggers rereading __dirname directories via fs.readdirSync filtered by isDir, then updates and returns adaptersCache.
Retrieves the specified adapter instance, normalizes its configuration path using the provided path, and returns the result of loading that configuration via the adapter’s configLoader.
readConfig gets an adapter instance by name, normalizes the given path for that adapter, and returns adapter.configLoader called with the normalized config path.
`readConfig` gets an adapter instance by name, normalizes the given path with that adapter, and returns `adapter.configLoader(...)` called with the normalized config path.
Retrieves the adapter instance for the given name, normalizes the provided config path for that adapter, and returns the result of loading that configuration via `adapter.configLoader`.
Writes configuration by retrieving the named adapter, normalizing the adapter-specific config path, and returning the result of the adapter’s configWriter with that path and config.
Gets an adapter instance by name, normalizes the given config path for that adapter, and returns the result of calling the adapter’s configWriter with that path and config.
`writeConfig` gets an adapter instance by name, normalizes the config path using that adapter and path, then returns `adapter.configWriter(normalizedPath, config)`.
Retrieves the adapter instance for the given name, normalizes the adapter config path, and returns the result of writing the provided config via adapter.configWriter.
Iterates each file config, filters existing source paths, computes path info and context for each, and renders each source file to its corresponding output file.
`handleFiles` iterates each file config, filters `f.src` with `srcExists`, maps remaining paths to compute `pathInfo` and `context`, then calls `renderFile`; it returns nothing.

`handleFiles` iterates each file, filters `f.src` with `srcExists`, maps remaining paths to compute `pathInfo` and `context`, and calls `renderFile(pathInfo.outfile, filepath, context)`, returning nothing.
Iterates over each file and its existing source paths, computes path info and context from destination and file context, then renders each source to its output file.
For each locale, it registers and runs an async Grunt subtask that resolves a locale-specific translator and calls doTranslations(files, locale, translator), returning no explicit value.

`handleI18nFiles(files)` iterates `options.locales`, registers and runs a locale-specific Grunt async subtask, builds a translator via `options.translateFunction(locale)`, then calls `doTranslations(files, locale, translator)` and returns nothing.

`handleI18nFiles(files)` iterates `options.locales`, registers and runs a locale-specific Grunt subtask that resolves `options.translateFunction(locale)`, calls `doTranslations(files, locale, translator)`, and completes via `done`.
Iterates over each locale, registering and running a Grunt subtask that asynchronously resolves a locale-specific translator and invokes doTranslations on the provided files.
Reads global and template JSON context files with fallbacks to empty objects on read errors, then returns a merged context extending defaults with provided context overriding earlier values.
Reads global and template JSON contexts (falling back to empty objects on read errors) and returns _.extend({}, globalContext, templateContext, options.defaultContext, context).
Reads global and template JSON contexts with try/catch fallbacks to empty objects, then returns _.extend({}, globalContext, templateContext, options.defaultContext, context).
Builds and returns a merged context object by extending global, template, default, and provided contexts, using empty global or template contexts if either JSON file read fails.

Returns an async page renderer that compiles a selected Handlebars template (defaulting to schedule), ensures output directories, writes index.html under url-specific or root output, and rethrows errors.

`render(url)` returns an async page renderer that compiles `page.template` (or `'schedule'`) from configured/default theme/template paths, ensures output directories, writes `index.html`, and rethrows any error.

Returns an async page renderer that selects `page.template` or `schedule`, compiles and renders the template, ensures output directories (special-casing `url !== 'index'`), writes `index.html`, and rethrows errors.

Returns an async page-rendering function that selects `page.template` or `'schedule'`, compiles the corresponding Handlebars file, ensures output directories, and writes `index.html` under `url` or root, rethrowing errors.
Returns true if a function node has an id or its parent is a MethodDefinition or a Property that is a getter, setter, or method; otherwise returns false.
Returns true if a function node has an id, or if its parent is a MethodDefinition or a Property that is a getter, setter, or method; otherwise false.
Returns true if node.id exists, otherwise checks parent.type is MethodDefinition or Property with kind get/set or method true, and returns that boolean.
Returns true if a node has an id, or if its type is MethodDefinition or Property with parent kind get/set or parent.method; otherwise returns false.
Returns `'never'` for named functions, `'ignore'` for arrow functions that are non-async or lack an opening parenthesis after `async`, and `'always'` otherwise.
Returns `'never'` for named functions, `'ignore'` for arrow functions that are non-async or whose first token after one skip isn’t `(`, and `'always'` otherwise.
Returns `'never'` for named functions, `'ignore'` for arrow functions that are non-async or whose second token isn’t an opening parenthesis, and `'always'` otherwise.
Returns `'never'` for named functions, `'ignore'` if the function is non-async or lacks an opening parenthesis after the first token, otherwise returns `'always'`.
Checks spacing before a function’s opening parenthesis unless config is `ignore` or text contains line breaks, and reports/fixes unexpected or missing space for `never`/`always` settings.

Checks function-parenthesis spacing for a node, skipping ignored configs or multiline/commented gaps, and reports/fixes unexpected space for “never” or missing space for “always,” otherwise returning nothing.

Checks a function node’s configured spacing before parentheses, skips ignored or multiline/comment-only gaps, and reports/fixes unexpected space for “never” or missing space for “always,” otherwise returns nothing.
Checks spacing between the token before and opening parenthesis of a function node, returning undefined when config is “ignore” or text has linebreaks, otherwise reporting spacing violations.
Registers each handler in `eventMap` on `eventEmitter` by iterating over `eventMap`’s keys and calling `eventEmitter.on(eventName, handler)` for each, returning nothing.
bindEventMap gets event names from eventMap, iterates through them, registers each handler on eventEmitter via on(eventName, eventMap[eventName]), and returns undefined.
bindEventMap gets all keys from eventMap, maps over each eventName, and calls eventEmitter.on(eventName, eventMap[eventName]), returning the map operation’s resulting array.
Registers each key in `eventMap` as an event on `eventEmitter` by calling `eventEmitter.on(eventName, eventMap[eventName])` for every event name, returning nothing.
Creates and returns a shallow copy of an object’s enumerable properties, but returns an empty object when input is missing, non-object, or an array.
Creates and returns a shallow object clone by copying all enumerable properties from `obj`, but returns an empty object when `obj` is falsy, non-object, or an array.
clone(obj) creates a new object, returns it immediately if obj is falsy, non-object, or an array, otherwise copies all enumerable properties and returns the copy.
Returns an empty object, immediately if input is null, non-object, or an array, and otherwise after iterating through object properties without copying anything.
Initializes an ImpulseBin instance with default CLI/logging settings, creates a long-con console, and sets adapter, options, and provider properties to null for later assignment.
Initializes `ImpulseBin` by setting default commander-related settings, creating a `long-con` console instance, nulling `adapter`, `options`, and `provider`, and returns no explicit value.

ImpulseBin initializes an instance by setting default settings values, creating `this.console` via `require('long-con').create`, and assigning `this.adapter`, `this.options`, and `this.provider` to `null`.
Creates and returns a new object by calling require('long-con').create(), with no inputs, conditions, asynchronous behavior, or explicit error handling.

Reorders a program’s body by moving function declarations—including exported default or named function declarations—to the front, leaving other statements after them, and returns makeProgram of the combined list.
Processes program.body, collecting FunctionDeclaration nodes (including export default/named declarations wrapping functions) before others, and returns makeProgram([...functions, ...body]).
Reorders program.body by hoisting function declarations, including default/named export declarations whose declaration is a FunctionDeclaration, then returns makeProgram([...functions, ...body]).
Iterates through `program.body`, skipping `ExportDefaultDeclaration` and `ExportNamedDeclaration` lines, pushes other lines into arrays, and returns `makeProgram([...array1, ...array2])`.
Extracts and returns a vehicle ID by finding the second table cell’s link href in item and removing the 'Detail.aspx?id=' prefix.
`parseVehicleID($, item)` finds `td` cells in `item`, extracts the second cell’s link `href`, removes `"Detail.aspx?id="`, and returns the resulting vehicle ID string.
parseVehicleID selects all td elements in item, gets the href of an anchor inside the second td, removes "Detail.aspx?id=", and returns the resulting id string.
Extracts and returns a vehicle ID by finding table cells in item, reading the second cell’s link href, and removing the 'Detail.aspx?id=' prefix.
Creates and returns an object containing the input `details` as `results`, the array length as `count`, and the current ISO timestamp as `time`.
`formatDetails` creates and returns an object containing the input `details` as `results`, `details.length` as `count`, and the current ISO timestamp as `time`.
formatDetails(details) creates and returns an object containing results set to details, count set to details.length, and time set to the current date-time in ISO string format.
Creates and returns a result by calling `new Date().toISOString()` using the `details` input, with no conditional checks, asynchronous operations, or error handling.
Builds a detail URL from the given id, requests and parses the page’s `#searchTableResults` rows into an info object, normalizes `stolendate`, and returns the resulting object.
getByID builds a detail-page URL from APP_BASE_URL and id, requests and parses table rows into translated/lowercased keys and trimmed values, standardizes stolendate, and returns the info object.
Builds a detail URL from id, requests and parses the page, maps each result-row span id/text into info using translations fallback, standardizes stolendate, and returns info.
Fetches the detail page for a given id, parses each results-table row span into translated/lowercased info fields, standardizes stolendate, and returns a promise resolving to the info object.
Splits an ampersand-delimited parameter string into key-value pairs, decodes each value (or empty string if missing), merges them into an object, and returns that object.
processParams splits a query-style string on “&”, splits each part on “=”, decodes each value (or empty string if missing), merges key-value pairs into an object, and returns it.
Parses an ampersand-separated parameter string, splitting each item on “=”, decoding the value or defaulting to empty string, merging each key-value into an object, and returning it.
Parses a query-style string by splitting on “&”, decoding each “name=value” pair’s value (defaulting missing values to empty), merging pairs into an object, and returning it.
Creates a Collection instance (even without `new`), initializing `modelType` and `items` from an array or options object, and throws `CollectionException` if `items` isn’t an array.
Initializes a Collection, returning a new instance if called without `new`; sets defaults for `options`, assigns `modelType`/`items`, and throws `CollectionException` if `items` isn’t an array.
Creates a Collection instance, returning new Collection(options) if not called with `new`; defaults options to `{}`, sets modelType/items, and throws CollectionException if items isn’t an Array.
Creates a Collection instance, recursively calling itself if not invoked with `new`, and throws `CollectionException('Items must be an array')` when `this.items` is not an array.
Finds and returns the first item matching a predicate, all properties of an object filter, or any attribute/value equality (modelType attributes or item keys), otherwise returns undefined.
Finds and returns the first item in this.items matching a predicate function, all key-value pairs of a filter object, or any property equal to filter; otherwise returns undefined.
Finds and returns the first `this.items` element matching `filter` by predicate function, full object key-value equality, or any property equality (modelType-aware), otherwise returns `undefined`.
Find iterates this.items and returns the first matching item: by predicate function, all modelType attribute keys matching, any filter key matching, or any item key matching; otherwise undefined.
